game: SubLogic Flight Simulator II, Commodore 64, v1.0 (NTSC)
description: Reverse-engineering knowledge base: the source of truth for names. Addresses are '$XXXX' strings; overlay null = resident memory, otherwise one of coldStart, editor, war, flight, databaseInfo (code/data in the $A7E0 overlay window). See re/README.md for the schema.

regions.name: zeroPage
regions.comment: Zero-page variables. Initial values are copied from the image at $AC02-$ACFF by $ABB0 during cold init; $00/$01 are the CPU port.

regions.name: stack
regions.comment: 6502 stack. Display-list calls (ops 18/09/0A) recurse on it.

regions.name: rowAddressHiTable
regions.comment: Bitmap row base high bytes for rows 0-199. Rows 0-111 ($0200-$026F) are re-based by +$20/-$20 pages every main-loop pass (double buffering); rows 112-199 always point into bitmap A (panel).

regions.name: rowAddressLoTable
regions.comment: Bitmap row base low bytes for rows 0-199 (standard C64 bitmap layout: $4000 + (r>>3)*320 + (r&7)).

regions.name: free0390
regions.comment: All zero on disk; no references found.

regions.name: vertexCacheArea
regions.comment: Runtime: transformed-vertex cache $0400-$07FF (128 x 8 bytes) and the text-mode screen $0400 of the editor and the system/disk-error screens. The bytes loaded here are residue (a screen-code message the game never shows); do not port that content.

regions.name: paletteSources
regions.comment: 16 palette words (fill/sky/ground patterns) that display lists copy into the active colors $0876-$0882 by time of day ($0830/$083C). Initial values must come from the disk image.

regions.name: variables0800
regions.comment: Core state: time/flags $0830-$085C, active colors $0876-$0882, radar height $0888-$088B, horizon list pointer $0890, keyboard slots and queue $0899-$08B0, mode requests $08BA/$08BB, editor-cache state $08BC, prompt key $08C4, pause $08CC, sound enable $08D3, war counters, block request $08FB-$08FF. Snapshot the loaded values as the cold-start state.

regions.name: variables0900
regions.comment: Core state: block cache $0900-$0905, radio search/station data $0920-$0960, user library pointer $0961, current mode $0963, the 65-byte mode record $0964-$09A4, editor extras $09A5-$09AA, engine/fuel $09BE-$09CD, flight state $09D0-$09FF.

regions.name: flightVariables
regions.comment: Flight variables, aircraft constants $0A52-$0A7F (never written by code: pure data), control positions $0AA3-$0ACC (view direction $0ACA). $0ACF is a one-byte code hook (region editorHookRts).

regions.name: editorHookRts
regions.comment: A single RTS executed as the hook editorExitHook (lab coverage: every session that leaves the editor). Its opcode byte also serves as data: the editor reads it at $B6FE.

regions.name: horizonLists
regions.comment: Four 16-byte horizon display lists, one per yaw quadrant: ground moveto/lineto (-8000,500)-(8000,500) rotated per quadrant, then END.

regions.name: polygonBuffers
regions.comment: Polygon structure-of-arrays buffers: 12 arrays of 64 bytes at $0B10 + k*$40. $0B10-$0C8F hold the collected vertices (x, y, z low/high bytes), $0C90-$0E0F the clipper's ping-pong copies; projected vertices reuse $0CD0 (x) / $0D50 (y). The last array ($0DD0) ends at $0E0F. Zero on disk.

regions.name: aeroGainTables
regions.comment: Speed-indexed gain tables read through $19E2: $0E10 elevator->AoA, $0E1A gamma rate, $0E24 turn rate, $0E2E no direct reader, $0E42 rudder.

regions.name: variables0E4C
regions.comment: Sound/IRQ variables $0E58-$0E7E, window palette $0E61-$0E69, course plotter $0E80-$0E87, $DD00 shadow $0E89, disk-error pointer $0E8A.

regions.name: diskErrorLineLead
regions.comment: Start of the 40-character editor disk-error line (copied to screen $07C0 by the editor at $B216).

regions.name: diskErrorTagLeft
regions.comment: NOT PORTED. Three bytes before '** DISK READ/WRITE ERROR **' that are spaces in the original and are overwritten in modified copies. The import restores the spaces.

regions.name: diskErrorLineText
regions.comment: '** DISK READ/WRITE ERROR **' (original SubLogic text).

regions.name: diskErrorTagRight
regions.comment: NOT PORTED. Three bytes after the disk-error text, restored as spaces like diskErrorTagLeft.

regions.name: diskErrorLineTail
regions.comment: Trailing spaces of the disk-error line.

regions.name: free0EB6
regions.comment: Zero on disk.

regions.name: panelMaskAndMarkerTables
regions.comment: Bit masks $0F00-$0F0F (01..80, then MSB-first 80..01 at $0F08) and XOR point-list marker shapes $0F10/$0F1D/$0F30/$0F49.

regions.name: needleAngleState
regions.comment: Angle each XOR needle was last drawn at (altimeter long/short hand, airspeed, VSI); the old needle is erased by redrawing it. The airspeed angle is stored unwrapped (up to 110) and drawn at angle - 88. $0F66 (gauge 4) is unused: the ADF keeps its angle in $E7F6.

regions.name: needleGeometry
regions.comment: Needle centers x $0F67 / row $0F6C (hi-res pixels), type $0F71 (0 = long, else short), and the shape pointer tables $0F76 (long, 23 used) / $0FA6 (short, 23).

regions.name: needleShapes
regions.comment: Needle run-length shapes: per scanline (x offset, run length), ending with a byte with bit 7 set. Reached only through the pointer tables.

regions.name: asiNeedleTableRegion
regions.comment: Airspeed needle positions (88 steps per revolution) indexed by min(V_hi, $5A)/4.

regions.name: rasterTables
regions.comment: Column byte offsets $14DA (160 entries), pixel masks $157A-$1589, fill patterns $158A-$158D.

regions.name: cosineTableRegion
regions.comment: Cosine table, 66 signed words. Port verbatim (entry 25 is a data glitch that must be kept).

regions.name: markerAndFontTables
regions.comment: Marker shapes $1612/$161B, font row expansion $1624, font clear masks $162C/$1630.

regions.name: font3x5
regions.comment: 3x5 font, 59 glyph words for ASCII $20-$5A only (characters $5B-$5F would read code bytes from $16AA).

regions.name: mathLibrary
regions.comment: Q15 multiply, fractional divide, unsigned multiply, sin/cos, 8x8 multiply, shifts, negate, speed-table interpolation. Port literally (truncation errors and biases matter).

regions.name: panelIndicators
regions.comment: Needle drivers $1A0B/$1A32/$1A6A, XOR needle drawer $1A86 (scanline loop $1B4B with self-modified opcodes $1B56/$1B59/$1B87/$1B8D), linear indicators $1B92-$1CE6. Port: Sources/FS2Core/Panel/GaugesNeedles.swift, GaugesMarkers.swift.

regions.name: fuelSelectorShapeRegion
regions.comment: XOR point-list shape (4 points) drawn by $1CF0.

regions.name: panelMarkers
regions.comment: Fuel-selector marker $1CF0 and the XOR point-list plotter $1D01. Port: Sources/FS2Core/Panel/GaugesMarkers.swift.

regions.name: textRenderer
regions.comment: Signed 5-digit print $1D54, text records $1DDE/$1DE2/$1E01, record lists $1E99, window clear $1EAF.

regions.name: free1ECA
regions.comment: All zero.

regions.name: coreVectors
regions.comment: 24 JMP vectors: a stable ABI that the overlays and the resident code call by address (display-list op 0A could call them too; no list on the disk uses it). Keep the addresses.

regions.name: mainLoopCode
regions.comment: Main loop and its 4/8-phase task dispatch on $22.

regions.name: panelTextRecords
regions.comment: OBS1 $2196, DG drawn $2197, tach drawn $2198, OBS2 $2199, then the readout text records $219C-$220F (one table each: DG, compass, COM, NAV1/NAV2, OBS, transponder, tach, clock, DME, lights, carb heat) and the six TO/FROM records $2210-$223F. Port: Readouts (Sources/FS2Core/Panel/Readouts.swift).

regions.name: panelInitAndGetKey
regions.comment: Panel readout redraw at init $2240 and the wait-for-key routine $2250.

regions.name: rasterIrqCode
regions.comment: Two-phase raster IRQ $2285 (screen split, frame tick, keyboard phase, voice-3 pattern player) and the alternate tick-only IRQ $2304. $22B0/$22B5 are immediate operands patched by the main loop and the palette code.

regions.name: patternPlayerState
regions.comment: Voice-3 gate pattern step counter $2308 and working shift register $2309.

regions.name: tickScheduler
regions.comment: Pattern step $230A, polled 10 Hz scheduler $2330/$2348 (key dequeue, engine pitch, repeat, bomb sweep, 5 Hz aero/joystick, 1 Hz sound and clock).

regions.name: keyboardScanCode
regions.comment: Keyboard matrix scan $2418.

regions.name: keyboardTables
regions.comment: Row masks $2472, column selects $247A, matrix-to-code table $2482.

regions.name: keyboardSlots
regions.comment: Held-key slots, press/repeat queueing, release check $2505, CIA1 sampler $2574, queue $25C4/$25DC.

regions.name: displayInitAndJoystick
regions.comment: VIC init $25EB, text-mode IRQ swap $2673 (port: Machine.textModeIrqSwap, Sources/FS2Core/Display/TextMode.swift), joystick action $2688, auto-center $26EC.

regions.name: restoreOneShotFlag
regions.comment: One-shot flag for the RUN/STOP+RESTORE restart.

regions.name: restoreNmiCode
regions.comment: NMI handler: RUN/STOP+RESTORE restart (through the cold-start slot $A7E2).

regions.name: indicatorState2715
regions.comment: Control indicator state: the elevator indicator position ($50-v)>>3 at $2715 (elevatorIndicator) and the aileron indicator value at $2716 (aileronIndicator); $2717 has no known reader or writer.

regions.name: keyDispatchTableRegion
regions.comment: 96 handler words for command codes $00-$5F (default $2CC1 = RTS).

regions.name: keyHandlers
regions.comment: Command dispatcher $27D8 and every in-flight key handler (controls, radios, views, modes, war keys); view capture $2E84.

regions.name: aeroModel
regions.comment: Control-derived coefficient builders $2E92-$2F3F and the 5 Hz aerodynamics update $2F45 (also arms the stall horn).

regions.name: flightIntegrator
regions.comment: Helper $32DF, per-frame integrator $32EE, ground contact/crash $3515, density/auto-level $35BD, refuel/repair/rearm $3614/$3638.

regions.name: slewModel
regions.comment: Slew-mode integrator $3660 and $372B (vector $200C).

regions.name: panelReadouts
regions.comment: Heading/slew $3773, DG $377C (degrees $37EA/$37F5), 3-digit formatter $3804, compass $3823, frequency digits $3896, NAV1/NAV2/COM displays $38BD/$38D9/$3903 with the search renewals $38D4/$38F5, OBS $3923/$3976, clock $39B6/$39D9, DME $3A13, radio gate $3A53, transponder $3A5C. Port: Panel/Readouts.swift, Radio/RadioDisplays.swift.

regions.name: magnetoLabelPointerRegion
regions.comment: Five pointers to the magneto label records O/L/R/B/S at $EE57-$EE67.

regions.name: panelReadouts2
regions.comment: Carb-heat, lights and magneto labels $3A71, tach $3AB9. Port: Panel/Readouts.swift.

regions.name: arcTableRegion
regions.comment: Arctangent table of the nav bearings: 17 words atan(i/16) as binary angles, 0..$2000 (45 degrees), read with linear interpolation by $3E9F.

regions.name: localizerNeedleShapeRegion
regions.comment: Localizer needle XOR point list (14 points: a 2-pixel-wide, 7-row bar), then 2 zero bytes.

regions.name: navInstruments
regions.comment: NAV1/NAV2 CDI tasks $3B32/$3B9B (deviation $3B61, TO/FROM $3D2B, needle $3D84, glideslope and DME $3DA2), OBI drawing $3BAF/$3C1A/$3C3F, glideslope bar $3C5D, TO/FROM records $3C81, station bearing $3C8F with the arctangent $3E46-$3EFB, localizer needles $3D68/$3D71, marker beacons $3EFC, distance $3F38 (vector $2030). Port: Panel/NavInstruments.swift, Panel/NavMath.swift.

regions.name: free3F8A
regions.comment: All zero.

regions.name: bitmapAWindow
regions.comment: Bitmap A, window rows 0-111 (front or back buffer). Loaded bytes are junk that the game clears.

regions.name: panelBitmap
regions.comment: Panel hi-res bitmap, 320x88, character rows 14-24 of bitmap A (disk blocks 6-9). Contains stale digits that $2240 redraws.

regions.name: graphicsRestore
regions.comment: $5F40 restores bitmap mode after a text screen (port: Machine.restoreGraphics, Sources/FS2Core/Display/TextMode.swift); $5F5D prints a hex digit to the text screen (system error, not ported).

regions.name: diskErrorPromptText
regions.comment: 'DISK ERROR - PRESS A TO RETRY OR B TO IGNORE ERROR' (screen text for $5FAB).

regions.name: diskErrorPrompt
regions.comment: Disk-error retry/ignore prompt reached via $732B. Not ported: unreachable in the port, whose block reads cannot fail (the disk is validated at import and read from memory).

regions.name: free5FF1
regions.comment: All zero.

regions.name: bitmapBWindow
regions.comment: Bitmap B, window rows 0-111 (the other buffer). Not loaded.

regions.name: bitmapBPanelRowCopy
regions.comment: Copy of panel character row 14 written by $AB66 so a late raster split on line 112 still shows the panel.

regions.name: free72C0
regions.comment: All zero.

regions.name: stage2Loader
regions.comment: NOT PORTED. SubLogic stage-2 IEC block loader (blocks 0-1) with its API at $7300-$7314 ($7303 fatal error, $7306 open, $7309 read, $730C write, $730F close, $7312 DOS command), sector mask $7473. The lab runs it against its virtual 1541 (IECDrive). The port copies blocks from the imported disk instead and leaves the memory this loader leaves (Scenery.Loader: loaderOpen, loaderRead, loaderClose; the editor's loaderDosCommand and loaderWriteBlock) and charges its time. Exception: the hooks $732E (text mode -> $796C, used by the editor via $2673) and $7331 (color RAM fill -> $794E, used by $25EB) lead to game routines, which are ported.

regions.name: driveStatusCheck
regions.comment: A drive-status check (copy protection). Not ported.

regions.name: stage2Boot
regions.comment: NOT PORTED. Loader overlay table copy $7898 and the stage-2 boot entry $78A2 (loads stage 3, runs the drive-status check, enters the cold-start slot $A7E2).

regions.name: loaderNmiReturn
regions.comment: RTI used as the NMI target in loader contexts ($78A9).

regions.name: systemErrorText
regions.comment: Screen-code text of the 'SYSTEM ERROR' line, copied to $0401 by $791E.

regions.name: systemErrorCode
regions.comment: Fatal 'SYSTEM ERROR' path $791E-$794D (prints error code and caller address, hangs): not ported. Its only game cause, an invalid display-list opcode, makes the port throw Scenery.Fault; the engine ends and the app reports it. Color RAM fill $794E (display init, via $7331) and text-mode setup $796C (editor text screens, via $732E) are game routines and are ported.

regions.name: free79A9
regions.comment: All zero.

regions.name: aiBezelSprites
regions.comment: Four multicolor sprites (pointers $E8-$EB) forming the static attitude-indicator bezel, pitch ticks, bank ticks and aircraft symbol.

regions.name: linkerExportTable
regions.comment: NOT PORTED. Development residue: linker/export address table (about 70 words naming entry points and tables of the $0F00-$1EAF instrument/math library, then $7A00). Never executed; useful as a symbol cross-check.

regions.name: free7B9A
regions.comment: All zero.

regions.name: windowScreenRam
regions.comment: Window screen RAM (rows 0-13): one byte (sky/ground nibbles) filled at runtime by $EC7C from the time-of-day palette.

regions.name: panelScreenRam
regions.comment: Panel cell colors (rows 14-24; high nibble = set bits, low nibble = clear bits), including the lamp cells $7E3D/$7E3E/$7E7B-$7E7D that code rewrites.

regions.name: spritePointers
regions.comment: Unused screen bytes and sprite pointers $7FF8-$7FFB (written as $E8-$EB by $25EB).

regions.name: rendererVectors
regions.comment: 16 JMP vectors of the 3D/raster module ABI; $802A/$802D are radio hooks patched at init ($AA07).

regions.name: radioRecordOps
regions.comment: Display-list ops 1D (NAV/LOC records, $8030), 1E (ATIS records, $8084) and 0D (block load, $80E2).

regions.name: viewMatrixAndHorizon
regions.comment: View matrix $8111, ground base $8324, horizon pass $83A4 (start).

regions.name: horizonLineListRegion
regions.comment: 7-byte display list 'pen 3, 2D line x1 y1 x2 y2, return' whose endpoints $83A4 rewrites each frame; area lists draw it via op 09 through the pointer at $0890.

regions.name: horizonFillCode
regions.comment: Sky/ground fill: whole rows $8504, unrolled row filler $851B, split row $85C0, horizon Bresenham $8623.

regions.name: opcodeHandlerTableRegion
regions.comment: 70 handler words for display-list opcodes $00-$45 ($8778 = invalid).

regions.name: sceneryInterpreter
regions.comment: Interpreter $8742/$8749/$8752 and opcode handlers: calls, compares $8E4A-$8F7A, origins $8BC1/$8BFD, vertex cache ops $8917-$8A04, dashed line $8A43, line-clip driver $8B40.

regions.name: clipAndPolygon
regions.comment: Sutherland-Hodgman polygon clipping, outcodes $93D2/$941B, line clipping $9464-$9644, polygon projection and scan fill $96D4-$990F.

regions.name: rasterPrimitives
regions.comment: Spans $9910/$9996, plot $99FD, Bresenham line $9A1D, dotted plot $9B80, pen ops $9B91/$9B9B.

regions.name: colorMapRegion
regions.comment: Scenery color code 0-15 -> 2-bit pen.

regions.name: penAndProjection
regions.comment: Pen ops $9BE6/$9BF5, span colors $9C93/$9C9C, projection front-end $9D05/$9D21, divide $9D3D.

regions.name: projectionXRegion
regions.comment: TX[i] = floor(5i/8), i = 0..127, plus a 129th byte repeating entry 127.

regions.name: projectionYRegion
regions.comment: TY[i] = floor(7i/16), i = 0..127, plus a 129th byte repeating entry 127.

regions.name: transforms
regions.comment: Projection $9F94, ground (block floating point) transform $9FD0, 3D transform $A1CE.

regions.name: aiLastAttitude
regions.comment: Pitch/bank at the last attitude-indicator redraw.

regions.name: aiPitchTableRegion
regions.comment: Attitude-indicator chord angle offsets indexed by (pitch+$20)/2 (34 bytes).

regions.name: attitudeIndicator
regions.comment: Attitude indicator $A378, row fill $A4A0, span patch target $A4CA.

regions.name: tcWingTableRegion
regions.comment: Turn-coordinator wing line offsets: 16 entries x (dx1, dy1, dx2, dy2).

regions.name: turnCoordinator
regions.comment: Turn-coordinator XOR wings $A532 and $A558 (vectors $8015/$8027).

regions.name: runwayMiniListRegion
regions.comment: Display-list template used by op 03: filled runway rectangle (2F 40 41 41 41 29) and dashed centerline (1B 2B), return.

regions.name: runwayOp
regions.comment: Runway op 03 handler and opJumpAbsolute $A731 (an absolute jump with no opcode slot).

regions.name: freeA73E
regions.comment: All zero.

regions.name: residueA7DD
regions.comment: NOT PORTED. Three stray bytes at the end of the $77E0 load.

regions.name: debugMonitor
regions.comment: On disk: SubLogic's remote debug monitor, never called (installs IRQ/BRK vector $C79A, expansion-port I/O $DE03/$DE06/$DE09, command table $C22B); the code is NOT PORTED. At run time the instrument-mask code ($F35E-$F521) uses the area as the save buffer for the panel pixels of switched-off instruments: the failure-graphics records at $F2E6 point their buffers at $C000, $C11F, $C200, $C2E6, $C411, $C412, $C508, $C52A, $C610, $C621, $C639, $C64D, $C661, $C662, $C6A9 and $C7C0 (lab: the night session with the lights off writes and reads back $C000-$C7D3; the failures session $C2E6-$C60F). Streamed scenery never lands here: the loader's $7327 guard drops every byte a load would store at $C000 and above (scenery-3d.md). The port keeps these bytes as a buffer (memory-faithful).

regions.name: instrumentSaveTail
regions.comment: Last bytes of the instrument save buffer that starts in debugMonitor (record pointer $C7C0; lab: written and read back with the lights off at night).

regions.name: residueC7D4
regions.comment: NOT PORTED. Junk bytes.

regions.name: userModeLibrary
regions.comment: User mode library: 15 x 65-byte records (modes 10-24), filled by $AB88 (every byte of record n = n). Saved/loaded as logical block 64 by the editor (CTRL-Z / CTRL-X).

regions.name: soundStateTableRegion
regions.comment: 11 effect handler words indexed by $0E59.

regions.name: soundDriver
regions.comment: SID effect state machine $CC16 and effect routines $CC46-$CE37 (block $29).

regions.name: gaugeDrivers
regions.comment: Altimeter and MSL altitude $CE84, airspeed target $CF0E, VSI target $CF46, slip ball $CF79. Port: Sources/FS2Core/Panel/GaugesDrivers.swift.

regions.name: freeCFB4
regions.comment: All zero.

regions.name: editorCache
regions.comment: RAM under I/O: $E6D8/$E6DB swap $A7E0-$BCDF with $D000-$E4FF ($01=$30) to cache the editor overlay; the course plotter also records display lists from $D000 (and sets $08BC=2 to invalidate the cache). $E000-$E4FF loads as zeros for this reason. The port keeps both uses in this memory, as the original does (Game/Overlays.swift, Modes/CoursePlotter.swift).

regions.name: engineSound
regions.comment: Engine drone pitch slew $E500 (10 Hz).

regions.name: overlayTableRegion
regions.comment: Overlay (first block, count) pairs.

regions.name: sceneryRootPointer
regions.comment: Sets the display-list PC $8B/$8C from the word at $A7E0 (the loaded overlay's end address = scenery root).

regions.name: tamperHang
regions.comment: Part of the drive-status check (copy protection). Not ported.

regions.name: rootPointerExit
regions.comment: The return of $E565 and the interrupt return used as a disabled-NMI target.

regions.name: blockCacheAndOverlays
regions.comment: Block cache/streaming $E58F (slot semantics must be kept), the overlay trampolines $E5C0-$E5ED and the overlay manager body $E5F6 (falls into $E618).

regions.name: loaderGlue
regions.comment: Disk glue: the root-block load $E618, the synchronous read $E63C (sprites off, $D018/$D016 forced, border counter, interrupts masked), the retry path $E6A6 and fatal error $E6C4 (unreachable with the imported image, not ported), the close helper $E6D2. Ported as direct copies from Machine.diskBlocks that keep every memory effect of SubLogic's loader (Scenery/Streaming.swift, Game/Overlays.swift); the IEC loader $7300-$7834 itself is not ported.

regions.name: editorCacheSwap
regions.comment: $E6D8 copies, $E6DB exchanges $A7E0-$BCDF with the cache $D000-$E4FF ($01 = $30). Port: Machine.swapEditorCacheIn / swapEditorCache (Game/Overlays.swift).

regions.name: windAndAtisJump
regions.comment: $E713 (on to the ATIS teletype $F239), wind drift $E716, wind layer select $E766.

regions.name: adfState
regions.comment: ADF state: face pending $E7F2, found flag $E7F3, frequency $E7F4/$E7F5, needle angle $E7F6, frequency record $E7F7 (154, 115) with the tunable digits $E7FA-$E7FC.

regions.name: adfDme
regions.comment: ADF needle update $E7FE and the ADF bearing readout $E860 (the DME is $3A13/$3DA2). Port: Radio/Adf.swift.

regions.name: adfPanelRecords
regions.comment: Text records of the ADF face drawn over the NAV2 OBI by $E936 (the record list $E886, then the bearing record $E930 (165, 95)).

regions.name: adfAndTuning
regions.comment: ADF face $E936, NDB op-05 hook $E956, ADF digit select $E9A7, ',' and '.' pre-handlers $E9BF/$E9F6 (ADF digits, mixture), digit store $EA2B, ADF search renewal $EA50. Port: Radio/Adf.swift.

regions.name: failureHandlerTableRegion
regions.comment: Eight failure handler words ($EB39-$EB5F).

regions.name: aircraftProblemRecord
regions.comment: Text record (y=50, x=20) 'AIRCRAFT PROBLEM !!!!'.

regions.name: failuresCode
regions.comment: Reality-mode failures and drift $EA84-$EB1B, trim creep $EAE2, failure handlers $EB39-$EB62.

regions.name: slewTextRecords
regions.comment: Slew readout records (y=2, x=20) ' 00000 NORTH ' and (y=2, x=82) ' 00000 EAST '.

regions.name: slewReadoutAndLights
regions.comment: Slew NORTH/EAST readout $EB82, instrument lighting masks $EBA5. Port: Panel/Readouts.swift, Display/TimeOfDay.swift.

regions.name: todThresholdsRegion
regions.comment: Time-of-day thresholds: 4 seasons x 4 x (minute, hour).

regions.name: timeOfDayPalette
regions.comment: Time-of-day selection $EBF2, palette apply $EC41 (window border $22B5, season bit $0884), window color fill $EC7C. Port: Display/TimeOfDay.swift.

regions.name: airframeSilhouetteRegion
regions.comment: Per-view white trapezoid (wing/airframe) descriptors: 8 bytes per entry at index $0ACA x 4 (width - 1, width fraction step, width step, start row, x, x fraction step, x step, rows); the front (0) and down ($40) entries have width 0.

regions.name: viewOverlayPixelLists
regions.comment: OR pixel lists of (offset lo, offset hi relative to the $0200 row base, mask) ending 00 00: war bombsight $ECE1, radar aircraft symbol $ED1F.

regions.name: viewOverlays
regions.comment: $ED3C pixel-list overlays (bombsight, radar symbol) and the airframe dispatch. Port: Machine.drawViewOverlay (Sources/FS2Core/Render3D/ViewOverlay.swift).

regions.name: airframeWalkState
regions.comment: The airframe trapezoid walk state of $ED88 (x and width in 8.8, their steps, row, rows left). Zero on disk; rewritten by every call.

regions.name: airframeCode
regions.comment: $ED88 per-view airframe trapezoid. Port: Machine.drawAirframe.

regions.name: engineSwitchState
regions.comment: Magneto state $EE14/$EE15 and the carb-heat countdown $EE16.

regions.name: engineTables
regions.comment: RPM/50 target by throttle ($EE17) and windmilling RPM/50 by airspeed ($EE37), 32 bytes each.

regions.name: magnetoLabels
regions.comment: Five 4-byte text records for the magneto label O/L/R/B/S.

regions.name: engineModelCode
regions.comment: Engine, thrust, oil and fuel model $EE6B.

regions.name: atisTokenOffsetRegion

variables.name: horizonSavedEyeRel

variables.comment: Copy of point A (outcode, x, y, z, screen x, y) at the last moveto ($88D1, ops 32): op 29 outside a polygon draws the closing line back to it.

variables.comment: Last edge-table index of the polygon being scan-filled ($985F); each row walks the edges from here down to 0.

variables.name: polygonCrossingCount
variables.comment: Crossings on the current scanline minus one ($98CA); the pair loop starts at this index.

variables.name: spanX
variables.comment: Span fill: rightmost x; spans grow leftward.

variables.comment: Altimeter long hand target (1 turn per 1000 ft), 21 - (steps mod 88) wrapped to 0-87, from $CE84; $1A0B redraws both hands when it differs from $0F62.

variables.name: altimeterShortHand
variables.comment: Altimeter short hand target (1 turn per 10000 ft), 21 - (steps mod 880) / 10 wrapped to 0-87, from $CE84.

variables.name: vsiNeedle
variables.comment: VSI needle target from $CF46: $83 - (clamped vertical speed in 1/4 high-byte units), mod 88 (43 = level). $1A6A steps the needle 1 toward it per 5 Hz tick.

variables.name: mainLoopCounter
variables.comment: Main-loop pass counter, incremented at the end of every pass. $22&3 selects the phase tasks, $22&4 the 1-in-8 tasks; also read by the copy-protection code (not ported).

variables.name: polygonOpen
variables.comment: Set by op 2F, cleared by op 29: points go to the polygon arrays instead of being drawn.

variables.name: groundBaseX
variables.comment: Rotated ground-plane base term -y * matrix Y column (x component), recomputed by $8324 when the eye height changes.

variables.name: groundBaseY
variables.comment: Ground-plane base, y component.

variables.name: groundBaseZ
variables.comment: Ground-plane base, z component.

variables.name: vertexCachePtr
variables.comment: Pointer to vertex cache entry $0400 + index*8 ($89E4).

variables.name: groundExponent
variables.comment: Block-floating-point exponent of the last ground point (starts at $40; previous value saved in $0905; reconciled only by op 2B).

variables.name: transformOverflow
variables.comment: Set by $A1CE when a product overflows; the result is halved.

variables.name: jiffyCounter
variables.comment: 60 Hz jiffy counter, incremented by the raster IRQ once per frame. The integrator's dt is ($34 - $08CA) jiffies.

variables.name: originYCache
variables.comment: The eye-relative y of the last origin op (07/24); a different y recomputes the ground base ($8D8F). The horizon pass stores the display-list PC here, so the next origin op recomputes it.

variables.name: loaderMaskByte
variables.comment: Loader: the sector-mask byte being walked (current bit at bit 7).

variables.name: loaderSectorsLeft
variables.comment: Loader: sectors left in the block (4 down to 0).

variables.name: colorFillPtr
variables.comment: Pointer used by the color RAM fill $794E.

variables.name: irqPhase
variables.comment: Raster IRQ phase toggle (LSR: window split at line $20 vs panel split at line $A3).

variables.name: savedCpuPort
variables.comment: The IRQ forces $01=$35 on entry and restores $01 from here on exit.

variables.name: eastPosition
variables.comment: Aircraft/eye position, east axis (scenery X). High word in 256 m units; editor/display East = high word + $4000. Start (Meigs): $011F0000.

variables.name: altitude
variables.comment: Height above the local ground datum (scenery Y). $5F:$60 = whole meters; ground contact at 3 m. Flight code updates only $5E-$60.

variables.name: northPosition
variables.comment: Position, north axis (scenery Z). Display North = high word + $4000. Start (Meigs): $03240000.

variables.name: eyeRelX
variables.comment: Eye minus object origin, x, scaled by the origin op's shift (ops 07/24).

variables.name: eyeRelY
variables.comment: Eye minus object origin, y; forced to >= 1. A change triggers $8324.

variables.name: eyeRelZ
variables.comment: Eye minus object origin, z.

variables.name: viewPitch
variables.comment: Camera pitch = $09DC*$0A64 - gamma (+ $0A0B airborne) + $0A2F*256.

variables.name: viewBank
variables.comment: Camera bank = -phi.

variables.name: viewHeading
variables.comment: Camera heading = psi.

variables.name: effectivePitch
variables.comment: Pitch after mixing with bank for the view direction; the sign of $73 picks the fill color when no horizon is visible.

variables.name: effectiveBank
variables.comment: Bank after view-direction mixing.

variables.name: effectiveYaw
variables.comment: Yaw = heading_hi + view offset in the high byte; the low byte $76 is stale (never refreshed), so yaw resolution is 1.4 deg. Only the radar and down views write $76 (0). (The loader bytes once read as writes of $76 at $75E8/$7607/$7668 are the operands of JSR $7686.)

variables.name: viewMatrix
variables.comment: Rotation matrix: [$78+6j+2i] = coefficient of world axis j (X, Y, Z) for eye axis i; eye-x terms halved and eye-z terms quartered (frustum |x|<=z, |y|<=z gives 53.13 x 28.07 deg).

variables.name: dlPointBClipped

variables.name: displayListPc

variables.name: drawBufferDelta
variables.comment: Added to the window row high bytes each pass ($20 or $E0, EOR $C0) to flip the draw buffer between $4000 and $6000.

variables.name: rowPointer
variables.comment: Current bitmap row/cell pointer for lines and spans.

variables.name: horizonSteps

variables.name: needleTablePtr

variables.name: needleShapePtr
variables.comment: Run-length shape of the needle being drawn by $1A86.

variables.name: rangeRadius

variables.name: markerShapePtr
variables.comment: Pointer to the XOR point list drawn by $1D01.

variables.name: loaderBlock

variables.name: loaderCount

variables.name: rangeDelta
variables.comment: Ops 13/14: the record word minus the eye word ($8EA1); op 28: the address a.

variables.name: dlOperandIndex
variables.comment: Y saved by ops 1A, 25, 23, 28 around their own indexed accesses.

variables.comment: Localizer course stored by the scenery with the localizer ($03AC = 313 deg at Champaign); x $1555 >> 15 gives OBS units for NAV1 when station B is a localizer.

variables.name: zuluOffset
variables.comment: ATIS Zulu hour = clockHours + $0854, minus 24 once when >= 24. Set by the scenery area data (5 in the Chicago area): a poke does not stick.

variables.name: cloudCeiling
variables.comment: Base of cloud layer 1 in meters: the editor's exit stores CLOUD 1 BOTTOMS x $4E >> 8 (feet to meters; $0858/$0859 the tops). The ATIS ceiling is ($0856 x 2150) >> 16 hundreds of feet.

variables.name: cloud1TopsMeters
variables.comment: CLOUD LAYER 1 TOPS in meters: the editor exit stores the record's feet x $4E >> 8.

variables.name: cloud2BottomsMeters
variables.comment: CLOUD LAYER 2 BOTTOMS in meters (editor exit, feet x $4E >> 8).

variables.name: metricWords
variables.units: 7 words, m (ft while the editor runs)
variables.comment: Seven words windToDisplay ($B865) converts: meters x $0348 >> 8 to feet on entry, feet x $4E0C >> 16 back on exit. The first is CLOUD LAYER 2 TOPS in meters (the exit then overwrites it with the record's feet x $4E >> 8); no resident code names the other six.

variables.name: variable0866
variables.comment: Formerly read as the ATIS ceiling multiplier: the composer's multiplier (2150) is a pair of immediate operands at $F1CC/$F1D0, not this byte. No absolute operand in the code names it; its use, if any, is unknown.

variables.name: bombTargetScore
variables.comment: Points of the bomb target the aircraft is over: the WWI detail lists (blocks 49-50) store it with op 25 behind op 13 range boxes (20 or 10 points). bombImpact $AFB9 adds it to the score when the countdown $0AA7/$0AA8 lands and clears it on every countdown pass; no other code writes it. The countdown never runs in this image, so the last stored value stays.

variables.name: fillColor
variables.comment: Active polygon/span color; fill byte = $158A[$9BD6[$0876 & 15]]. Set by area lists from $0800-$081E.

variables.name: paletteActive087A
variables.comment: Active palette entry copied from $0800-$081E by display lists.

variables.name: paletteActive087C
variables.comment: Active palette entry copied by display lists.

variables.name: skyFill
variables.comment: Sky fill selector: 0 or $FF used directly, otherwise pattern $55. $D5 on disk; no direct writer found (scenery).

variables.name: groundFill
variables.comment: Ground fill selector: 0 or $FF used directly, otherwise $AA. $2A on disk.

variables.name: seasonBit
variables.comment: 1 << (season - 1) from $EC41 (0 for season 0); read by the scenery bytecode.

variables.name: lastUserModeEntry
variables.comment: Copy of the USER MODE field $09A5 made by the editor exit ($B781).

variables.name: radarEyeHeight
variables.comment: Eye height in radar mode; ',' doubles the 24-bit value $0889-$088B (a one-bit shift left with a 1 shifted in, bit 23 kept 0) and '.' halves it (a one-bit shift right, then the five low bits of $0889 set).

variables.name: horizonLinePtr
variables.comment: Points at the horizon line list $8458; area lists draw it with '09 90 08'.

variables.name: releaseIndex
variables.comment: keyReleaseCheck ($2505): matrix index of the slot being checked; overwritten with the slot index when a released key's code is >= $80 (CTRL).

variables.name: scanColumnIndex
variables.comment: keyScan: matrix index base of the current column (0, 8, ... $38; $40 after the scan).

variables.name: scanColumnSelect
variables.comment: keyScan: rolling column select $FE..$7F (ROL with carry 1; $FF after the scan).

variables.name: heldKeySlots
variables.comment: Four held-key slots, taken from slot 3 down by keyPress, freed ($80) by keyReleaseCheck; $80 at init ($AAFD). Only slots 3 and 2 auto-repeat. $089E == $3F means RUN/STOP was the first key held (the RESTORE restart condition).

variables.name: scanRow
variables.comment: keyScan: row index within the column (INC per row).

variables.name: scanRowMask
variables.comment: keyScan: row bit mask $01..$80 (ASL per row; 0 after the column).

variables.name: joyPort2Sample
variables.comment: sampleCia1: port 2 ($DC00) read with $DC00 = $FF before the column drive. On the no-joystick path sampleCia1 overwrites it with the row read of the column ($DC01 with the column driven), which keyScan and keyReleaseCheck test.

variables.name: joyPort1Sample
variables.comment: CIA1 sample of port 1.

variables.name: joyPort2Sample2
variables.comment: Second port-2 sample (after the column drive).

variables.name: joyPort1Sample2
variables.comment: Second port-1 sample.

variables.name: releaseSlot
variables.comment: keyReleaseCheck: the slot index saved across sampleCia1.

variables.name: scanPhase
variables.comment: Keyboard phase: DEC each frame; 0 -> full scan $2418, negative -> release check $2505 and reload 3 (4-frame cycle, 15 Hz).

variables.name: keyQueueWrite
variables.comment: Key FIFO write index.

variables.name: keyQueueRead
variables.comment: Key FIFO read index.

variables.name: keyQueue
variables.comment: 8-entry key ring buffer (no overflow check).

variables.name: killCount
variables.comment: Enemies shot down (gunsAndTracers $AF76). From 4 on, warDamage uses its lower thresholds.

variables.name: comFrequency
variables.comment: COM frequency matched by ATIS records (op 1E).

variables.name: hitsTaken
variables.comment: Times an enemy hit the aircraft (enemyUpdate $AB09); printed as HITS, drives warDamage; zeroed by $3638.

variables.name: serviceCount
variables.comment: Incremented by refuel/repair $3638 and by the first war pass; warServiceCheck $AE44 consumes it (reprints AMMO and HITS, every enemy dormant).

variables.name: editorRequest
variables.comment: Editor/text-input mode: E or HOME sets 1; the main loop then calls $A7E8. While set, $27D8 stores keys into $08C4.

variables.name: modeRequest
variables.comment: Mode request for the editor overlay: 1 = reload current mode ('+', crash), 2 = save to a user slot ('S'), 3 = demo (mode 2).

variables.name: editorCacheState
variables.comment: State of the editor copy in RAM under I/O.

variables.name: adfSearchRequest
variables.comment: ADF station search request (copied to $08BE by $8730).

variables.name: adfSearchActive
variables.comment: Per-pass ADF search flag; cleared by END.

variables.name: dgOffset
variables.comment: Directional gyro offset; CTRL-D realigns it, reality mode drifts it (+2).

variables.name: keyDispatchInhibit
variables.comment: When nonzero the 10 Hz tick does not dequeue keys.

variables.name: promptKey
variables.comment: Key delivered in text-input mode; $2250 waits for bit 7.

variables.name: compassHeading
variables.comment: Used by the DG formula ($08C5-$70/$71+$0848+$0846).

variables.name: lastJiffy
variables.comment: Jiffy count at the previous integrator pass; only $32EE updates it (so a pause freezes dt).

variables.name: pauseCount
variables.comment: Nonzero while paused or waiting for a key: suspends the 5 Hz work and the 1 Hz sound tick.

variables.name: failureCountdown
variables.comment: Reality-mode failure check countdown: DEC by $EA84 each phase-3 pass; when it goes negative it is reloaded with 10 and the failure test runs.

variables.name: panelInitFlag
variables.comment: Set to 1 by $AA91 at the cold start; no reader found in the resident code.

variables.name: warScore
variables.comment: War score: +1 per kill, + $0872 per bombed target (addWarScore $AFEE, which resets 1000 and more to 0 and prints it at $08F5).

variables.name: soundEnable
variables.comment: SOUND on/off, copied from the editor's $0964 on exit. 0 makes $CC16 silence the voices.

variables.name: damageLevel
variables.comment: Incremented by warDamage at the top threshold (60 hits, 20 after 4 kills), once per hit from then on.

variables.name: throttleJumpArmed
variables.comment: '/' arms it: the next throttle key jumps to full ($78) or idle (0).

variables.name: warStarted
variables.comment: 0 until the first warMain pass, which sets 1 and runs warFirstPass ($B13E). Only the war overlay touches it.

variables.name: fd00HookRequest
variables.comment: Set by the R handler; in Europe 1917 the main loop then calls JSR $FD00 (an empty hook in this image).

variables.name: blockRequestFlags
variables.comment: Op 0D: bit 7 set makes the next request's destination absolute (no PC added); the op then ANDs it with 3.

variables.name: diskLoading
variables.comment: 1 while $E63C reads blocks (the raster IRQ is masked then).

variables.name: lightsColorSet
variables.comment: Alternate set used by $EBA5 for $0945-$0947; also set to $FF by $3638.

variables.name: bombsRecord
variables.comment: 'BOMBS' text record on the rotating war line.

variables.name: bombCount
variables.comment: Bombs left as an ASCII digit inside the BOMBS record ('5' at war start).

variables.name: scoreRecord
variables.comment: 'SCORE' text record on the rotating war line.

variables.name: blockRequest
variables.units: blk, cnt, dst lo, dst hi, slot
variables.comment: Current op-0D request (dst = opcode address + rel16).

variables.name: blockCacheSlots
variables.comment: Last block loaded per slot 0-3; loading a slot zeroes the higher slots. Cleared after any overlay load.

variables.name: dlCallDepth
variables.comment: Display-list call depth.

variables.name: prevGroundExponent
variables.comment: Previous ground-point exponent (op 2B reconciles).

variables.name: dlPointAClipped
variables.comment: Line driver: point A was clipped (re-project it). Cleared by $8742 and by the driver.

variables.name: clockSeconds
variables.comment: Clock seconds, advanced on CIA1 TOD second edges.

variables.name: quickRepeatWindow
variables.comment: Set to 3 by control/radio keys; decremented at 5 Hz. Within it, elevator steps 16 and radio keys cycle sub-fields.

variables.name: navSearchRequest
variables.comment: NAV retune request (copied to $0921 per pass).

variables.name: navSearchActive
variables.comment: Per-pass NAV search flag; cleared by END.

variables.name: navFoundBits
variables.comment: Op 1D sets bit 0 (match on $0925) or bit 1 (match on $0923).

variables.name: navFrequencyA
variables.comment: Frequency matched by op 1D; data to $0927 (shared with the ADF).

variables.name: navFrequencyB
variables.comment: Frequency matched by op 1D; data to $092F.

variables.name: navStationA
variables.comment: Station data for $0923 (or the ADF via op 05).

variables.name: navStationB
variables.comment: Station data for $0925.

variables.name: comSearchRequest
variables.comment: COM/ATIS search request; a third quick CTRL-C increments it.

variables.name: comSearchActive
variables.comment: Per-pass COM search flag; cleared by END.

variables.name: atisParameters
variables.comment: The 8 parameter bytes of the matched op-1E record: $0939-$093C the runway (a plain number) for wind quadrants 0-3 ($09A3 >> 6), $093D-$0940 the temperature (F) for seasons 1-4 (read as $093C + season).

variables.name: seasonTemperatures
variables.comment: ATIS temperature = $093C[season] + $095F (8-bit); seasons 1-4 read $093D-$0940 (the base byte is the quadrant-3 runway).

variables.name: atisOneShot
variables.comment: Cleared by op 1E; the teletype types the message once per tune.

variables.name: failureMasks
variables.comment: Instrument failure masks ANDed into $FD-$FF; failures clear bits; $3638 resets them to $FF.

variables.name: lightingMasks
variables.comment: Third factor of $FD-$FF; switched by the lights code $EBA5.

variables.name: editorExitKey
variables.comment: E was pressed: incremented by the field input, cleared when a field starts; the field loop then exits through $B559.

variables.name: editorPreviousKey
variables.comment: '-' was pressed ($2D stored): the field loop clears it and moves the cursor up.

variables.name: editorFieldValue
variables.comment: The 24-bit value $B29B parses and $B2D6 prints (the remainder, 0, after printing).

variables.name: editorCursorLine
variables.comment: The cursor line ($02-$2A = lines 1-21) and the index into the screen-line table $AFD4; the field walks leave it at the last field's line.

variables.name: editorPage
variables.comment: The page shown: 0 (SIMULATION CONTROL, AIRCRAFT POSITION) or 2 (ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROL); indexes $A800 and $B01C.

variables.name: editorFieldEdited
variables.comment: Digits typed into the current field (incremented per digit, cleared when a field starts); nonzero makes the field loop accept the page ($B371).

variables.name: editorPrintedDigits
variables.comment: Digits printed by $B2D6 so far (leading-zero suppression).

variables.name: editorDigitCount
variables.comment: Digits in the typing buffer (0-6); DEL takes one back.

variables.name: editorTypedDigits
variables.comment: The digits typed (or read back from the screen by $B813), the last one first, padded with '0'. $B29B ignores bit 7 (the reverse-video screen codes).

variables.name: editorColumn
variables.comment: Editor use of the ATIS pointer's low byte: the column of the next digit relative to the cursor line pointer (5-11 = screen columns 31-37); 11 refuses a seventh digit.

variables.name: atisTextPtr
variables.comment: Points at the ATIS text of the matched record (record + 13).

variables.name: demoActive
variables.comment: Set from $095B at editor exit; any key clears it ($27DD).

variables.name: demoRequest
variables.comment: 'A. DEMO MODE' at startup increments it; the main loop ($2133) then sets $08BB=3.

variables.name: editorDigitScratch
variables.comment: The digit being counted by $B2D6 ('0' + count, may run past '9'); also the direction of $B99A (0 load, 1 store), read on every byte.

variables.name: editorFieldSize
variables.comment: The size (1 or 2) of the field being walked; the low byte of $B2D6's trial subtraction.

variables.name: editorSubtractMiddle
variables.comment: The middle byte of $B2D6's trial subtraction.

variables.name: temperatureOffset
variables.comment: Added to the seasonal temperature.

variables.name: modeLimit
variables.comment: Mode count limit (25).

variables.name: userLibraryPtr
variables.comment: User mode library base ($C800).

variables.name: currentMode
variables.comment: Current mode 0-24; crashes and '+' reload it.

variables.name: modeRecord
variables.comment: Editor parameter block (little-endian, raw display values). Fields below are offsets 00-40. Also the live copy of several settings (slew, reality, war, clock).

variables.name: settingSound
variables.comment: Record +00 SOUND (copied to $08D3 on editor exit).

variables.name: autoCoordination
variables.comment: Record +01 AUTO-COORDINATION: rudder follows ailerons and back.

variables.name: slewMode
variables.comment: Record +02 SLEW: the main loop calls $3660 instead of $32EE.

variables.name: realityMode
variables.comment: Record +03 REALITY: failures, drifts, magneto/mixture effects.

variables.name: recordByte4
variables.comment: Record +04: 1 only in built-in mode 2 (demo); no code references.

variables.name: europe1917
variables.comment: Record +05 EUROPE 1917 (war mode).

variables.name: commRate
variables.comment: Record +06 COMMUNICATION RATE: the teletype waits (256 - rate) mod 256 passes of 606 cycles per character (0 = 256 passes, the slowest; $FF one).

variables.name: settingNorth
variables.comment: Record +07 NORTH (slew writes it live).

variables.name: settingEast
variables.comment: Record +09 EAST.

variables.name: settingAltitude
variables.comment: Record +0B ALTITUDE; $F9C1 converts ($096F+9)*$4E0C>>16 to meters.

variables.name: settingPitch
variables.comment: Record +0D PITCH (raw*360>>16).

variables.name: settingBank
variables.comment: Record +0F BANK.

variables.name: settingHeading
variables.comment: Record +11 HEADING.

variables.name: settingAirspeed
variables.comment: Record +13 AIRSPEED.

variables.name: settingThrottle
variables.comment: Record +15 THROTTLE.

variables.name: settingRudder
variables.comment: Record +17 RUDDER.

variables.name: settingAilerons
variables.comment: Record +19 AILERONS.

variables.name: settingFlaps
variables.comment: Record +1B FLAPS.

variables.name: settingElevators
variables.comment: Record +1D ELEVATORS.

variables.name: clockHours
variables.comment: Record +1F HOURS; also the live clock.

variables.name: clockMinutes
variables.comment: Record +20 MINUTES; live clock.

variables.name: season
variables.comment: Record +21 SEASON (&3 indexes the time-of-day thresholds).

variables.name: cloud2Tops
variables.comment: Record +22 cloud layer 2 tops.

variables.name: cloud2Bottoms
variables.comment: Record +24 cloud layer 2 bottoms.

variables.name: cloud1Tops
variables.comment: Record +26 cloud layer 1 tops.

variables.name: cloud1Bottoms
variables.comment: Record +28 cloud layer 1 bottoms.

variables.name: shear1
variables.comment: Record +2A shear 1 = lower wind layer bound used by $E766.

variables.name: shear2
variables.comment: Record +2C shear 2 = wind layer bound.

variables.name: shear3
variables.comment: Record +2E shear 3 = upper wind layer bound.

variables.name: wind3
variables.comment: Record +30/+32 wind level 3: knots field = turbulence*100 + knots; [3] = direction as 8-bit angle.

variables.name: wind2
variables.comment: Record +34/+36 wind level 2.

variables.name: wind1
variables.comment: Record +38/+3A wind level 1.

variables.name: surfaceWind
variables.comment: Record +3C/+3E surface wind; ATIS reads $09A0-$09A3 and picks the active runway by wind quadrant ($09A3>>6).

variables.name: reliability
variables.comment: Record +40 RELIABILITY: failures trigger when ((N+E) & $FF) < 100 and >= reliability.

variables.name: userModeEntry
variables.comment: USER MODE field: 0-24 recall, 110-124 save to mode n-100, >= 210 ignored.

variables.name: instrumentSettings
variables.comment: First factor of the instrument enable masks $FD-$FF; the war overlay clears radios ($09A7 bit 7).

variables.name: overControlLimiter
variables.comment: OVER-CONTROL LIMITER (editor field, not in the record).

variables.name: adfEnable
variables.comment: ADF ENABLE (editor field, not in the record): NAV2 display becomes the ADF.

variables.name: dmeNoStation
variables.comment: 1 when NAV1 has no station ($3DA2): $3A13 shows blanks.

variables.name: dmeRedraw
variables.comment: Set to 1 by $3DA2 on a change; consumed with LSR by $3A13.

variables.name: dmeTenths
variables.comment: DME tenths of a nautical mile.

variables.name: dmeMiles
variables.comment: DME whole nautical miles.

variables.name: nav1NeedleDrawn
variables.comment: NAV1 localizer needle position as drawn (x 180 + v, row 126).

variables.name: nav1NeedleTarget
variables.comment: NAV1 needle target from $3B32 (15 = centered).

variables.name: nav2NeedleDrawn
variables.comment: NAV2 needle as drawn (row 171).

variables.name: nav2NeedleTarget
variables.comment: NAV2 needle target from $3B9B.

variables.name: glideslopeDrawn
variables.comment: Glideslope bar as drawn (row 126 + v).

variables.name: glideslopeTarget
variables.comment: Glideslope target from $3DA2 (18 = full, above).

variables.name: nav1ToFrom
variables.comment: NAV1 TO/FROM from $3B32.

variables.name: nav2ToFrom
variables.comment: NAV2 TO/FROM from $3B9B.

variables.name: nav1ToFromDrawn
variables.comment: NAV1 TO/FROM as drawn ($FF at cold start).

variables.name: nav2ToFromDrawn
variables.comment: NAV2 TO/FROM as drawn.

variables.name: stationDeltaNorth
variables.comment: North distance station -> aircraft from $3C8F (the war overlay also feeds $3F38 through it).

variables.name: stationDeltaEast
variables.comment: East distance station -> aircraft from $3C8F.

variables.name: engineRpm
variables.comment: Current engine value: slews toward $0E58 by 2 per 10 Hz tick ($E500); tach shows it x50; sets the drone pitch.

variables.name: engineFailureBits
variables.comment: Bits 0-1 cap RPM, bits 2-3 fuel leaks; set by failures and war damage.

variables.name: leftFuelFraction
variables.units: low 16 bits of the left tank
variables.comment: $09C0:$09C1:$09C2 is the left tank as a 24-bit amount; $EE6B adds the negative burn here (only while a burn high byte is negative) and the carry reaches leftFuel, which never goes below 0.

variables.name: leftFuel
variables.comment: Left tank (initial $20 = 32); possibly the high byte of a 16-bit amount.

variables.name: rightFuelFraction
variables.units: low 16 bits of the right tank
variables.comment: $09C3:$09C4:$09C5, as leftFuelFraction for the right tank.

variables.name: rightFuel
variables.comment: Right tank.

variables.name: fuelTankSelect
variables.comment: Selected tank (CTRL-F, ',' '.').

variables.name: fuelFlags
variables.comment: Fuel availability flags compared with the magneto state $EE14/$EE15.

variables.name: engineRunning
variables.comment: 0 = engine stopped.

variables.name: oilTemperature
variables.comment: Ramps +/-$19/256 toward 0, 9 or 18.

variables.name: oilPressure
variables.comment: Ramps +/-$FA/256 toward 0 or 10.

variables.name: altimeterOffset
variables.comment: Altimeter correction added at $CEA6; CTRL-B clears it; reality mode drifts it.

variables.name: altimeterDrift
variables.comment: Drift target chased by $09CE in reality mode.

variables.name: windDriftEast
variables.comment: Per-pass wind drift east, subtracted from $5A-$5D when airborne.

variables.name: windDriftNorth
variables.comment: Per-pass wind drift north.

variables.name: windSurfaceFlag
variables.comment: Incremented by $E766 when the surface layer is selected and shifted right at once: the bit shifted out adds headingOffsetB ($0849) to the wind direction. Normally 0 between calls.

variables.name: verticalDelta
variables.comment: Up delta sin(gamma)*d of the current pass.

variables.name: airDensity
variables.comment: $7FFE - 2.5 * MSL meters (phase 2).

variables.name: aoaProxy
variables.comment: Angle-of-attack proxy = interp($0E10, V) * elevator. Hi byte $09DD: >= $24 or <= -$1A stalls, >= $21 sounds the horn and lights the stall lamp.

variables.name: flightPathAngle
variables.comment: gamma, integrated at 5 Hz by $2F45; reflected past +/-90 deg.

variables.name: bankAngle
variables.comment: phi, integrated per pass by $32EE.

variables.name: liftCoefficient0
variables.comment: Lift coefficient CL0 (aircraft constant).

variables.name: dragCoefficient0
variables.comment: Drag coefficient CD0 (aircraft constant).

variables.name: inducedDragFactor
variables.comment: Induced drag factor k (aircraft constant).

variables.name: cosGamma
variables.comment: cos(gamma) from an 8-bit angle.

variables.name: horizontalStep
variables.comment: cos(gamma) * d of the current pass ($32EE); multiplied by sin/cos of the track for the east/north deltas.

variables.name: cosPhi
variables.comment: cos(phi) from an 8-bit angle.

variables.name: cosTrack
variables.comment: cos of the track high byte.

variables.name: weightCosGamma
variables.comment: W * cos(gamma) ($2F45), subtracted from L * cos(phi)|cos(phi)| for the normal force.

variables.name: slip
variables.comment: $09F3 = aileron/2 - rudder/2 ($09F2 is never written).

variables.name: slipYaw
variables.comment: slip * $0A68 (yaw term).

variables.name: slipRoll
variables.comment: slip * $0A66 (roll term on the left wing).

variables.name: cosPhiSquaredSigned
variables.comment: cos(phi)*|cos(phi)|.

variables.name: gammaRate
variables.comment: interp($0E1A)*normal force (halved unless $0E75); clamped >= 0 on the ground.

variables.name: turnRate
variables.comment: 4*interp($0E24)*sin(phi)*L + $09F4; rudder>>3 on the ground. Also drives the turn coordinator.

variables.name: drag
variables.comment: q*rho*(CD0 + k*(CL_L^2+CL_R^2+slip drag+flap drag*256)) + W*sin(gamma) + $0A74.

variables.name: acceleration
variables.comment: (thrust - drag) * $0A30.

variables.name: rudderGainResult
variables.comment: rudder x $0E42 interpolation; computed and stored, never read by any code (listing scan).

variables.name: eastDelta
variables.comment: sin(track)*cos(gamma)*d of the current pass.

variables.name: netForce
variables.comment: Thrust - drag ($2F45), times $0A30 gives the acceleration.

variables.name: flapDrag
variables.comment: High byte of flaps * $0A6C; enters the drag as $0A0A*256.

variables.name: viewPitchOffset
variables.comment: Added to the view pitch when airborne; no code writes it (listing scan of the resident code and every overlay), so its disk value applies.

variables.name: frameDt
variables.comment: dt = jiffies*$0222 (+ stale $C4 term); $7Fxx when bit 15 is set; wraps for gaps over 120 jiffies.

variables.name: stepDistance
variables.comment: d = V*dt.

variables.name: wasOnGround
variables.comment: On-ground flag of the previous pass (touchdown chirp on 0 -> nonzero).

variables.name: onGround
variables.comment: $FF when altitude < 3 m + 1/256 (set at $3526).

variables.name: heading
variables.comment: psi, integrated per pass: += turnRate*dt.

variables.name: slipDrag
variables.comment: slip * $0A70.

variables.name: aileronCoefficient
variables.comment: aileron * $0A7A (or $0A7C while $0E75).

variables.name: wingLift
variables.comment: Base wing lift coefficient.

variables.name: liftCoefficientLeft
variables.comment: flaps + CL0 - aileron (+ slip roll).

variables.name: liftCoefficientRight
variables.comment: flaps + CL0 + aileron.

variables.name: flapLift
variables.comment: flaps * $0A7E.

variables.name: liftScale
variables.comment: Lift scale (aircraft constant); +$0B in ground effect below 20 m on the high byte.

variables.name: liftTotal
variables.comment: L.

variables.name: liftLeft
variables.comment: 4*q*CL_L.

variables.name: liftRight
variables.comment: 4*q*CL_R.

variables.name: viewPitchBump
variables.comment: One-shot view pitch bump set to $0A51 at first ground contact.

variables.name: inverseMass
variables.comment: 1/mass (aircraft constant).

variables.name: rollScale
variables.comment: Roll scale (aircraft constant).

variables.name: liftDifference
variables.comment: 4 * (liftLeft - liftRight) ($32EE), times rollScale gives the roll term.

variables.name: northDelta
variables.comment: cos(track)*cos(gamma)*d of the current pass.

variables.name: sinGamma
variables.comment: sin(gamma) from the 16-bit angle ($2F45, 5 Hz); used for W*sin(gamma), the vertical step and the vertical speed.

variables.name: sinPhi
variables.comment: sin(phi) from the 16-bit angle ($2F45); feeds the turn rate.

variables.name: sinTrack
variables.comment: sin of the track high byte.

variables.name: weightSinGamma
variables.comment: W * sin(gamma) ($2F45), added to the drag.

variables.name: slipTrackOffset
variables.comment: slip * $0A6A, added to the heading for the track when airborne.

variables.name: thrust
variables.comment: (RPM*256 * $07D0) * density.

variables.name: normalForce
variables.comment: L*$09F8 - W*cos(gamma).

variables.name: airspeed
variables.comment: Single airspeed scalar (no separate ground speed). Overflow sets $64xx; negative clamps to 0. ASI clamps at $5A.

variables.name: verticalSpeed

routines.name: mulZeroPage
routines.inputs: A = destination, X = first operand, Y = second operand (zero-page addresses of Q15 words)
routines.outputs: zp[A] = zp[X] * zp[Y] via $16C9; A = low, X = high, Y = destination
routines.sideEffects: $A5 = destination; $C4:$C5 = zp[X] (then as $16C9 leaves it); $C6:$C7 = |zp[Y]|; $A7, $A8 as $16C9
routines.comment: Addressing quirks at the end of page 0: zp[X] is read with zp,X (high byte wraps to $00), zp[Y] with abs,Y (Y = $FF reads $0100), the low result byte is stored with abs,Y and the high byte with zp,Y (wraps). 55 cycles (56 when Y = $FF) + $16C9. Port: Machine.mulZeroPage(a:x:y:).

routines.name: mulQ15
routines.outputs: A = low, X = high of ~(m*n)>>15; Y = $C5 ^ $C7 (unchanged on the zero shortcut); carry not used by callers
routines.sideEffects: $C4/$C5 = shifted-out remains of ~|m|; $C6:$C7 = |n| ($7FFF for -32768); $A7 = result low byte; $A8 = unnegated high byte (negative products only). Zero shortcut writes nothing.
routines.comment: Inverted-bit shift-add: works on ~|m| (m = -32768 stays $8000 = |m| 32767). Bit 0 of |m| starts the 8-bit accumulator at the value left in A (|n| high byte, but $80 instead of $7F for n = -32768); bits 1-5 add only |n|'s high byte, bits 6-14 add all of |n| into A:$A7; bit 15 ignored. Error vs m*n/32768: -1.95..+1.97 LSB. Vectors (lab): mul(1000,1000)=29 in 336 cycles, mul(546,10000)=166, mul(32767,32767)=32765. Cycles 17/24 (either operand 0), else 271-454: 39 + sign handling + 8/9 + 10/12 per bit 1-5 + 15/30 per bit 6-14 + 12/29. Port: Machine.mulQ15().

routines.name: mulQ15AX
routines.comment: Stores A/X in $C6/$C7 and enters $16C9: 9 cycles + $16C9. The war overlay also calls it ($AD45, $AD5E, $AD7C, $AD9D, $ADBC, $ADE3). Port: Machine.mulQ15AX(a:x:).

routines.name: mulQ15Chain
routines.sideEffects: $C6:$C7 = n, then as $16C9; the product overwrites $C4:$C5 for the next multiply
routines.comment: 24 cycles + $16C9. Port: Machine.mulQ15Chain(a:x:).

routines.name: divQ15
routines.inputs: A = high, X = low dividend n; $C6:$C7 = divisor d
routines.outputs: $C4:$C5 = ~n/d*32768 (bit 0 always 0); Y = 0; A = sign byte (n_hi ^ d_hi) for a positive quotient, else the quotient high byte; X = remainder high byte from the last step that saved it
routines.sideEffects: $C6:$C7 = |d| (negated in memory); $A7 = remainder low byte; one stack byte pushed and pulled
routines.comment: 15 non-restoring steps on the 16-bit remainder A:$A7 (sign test = bit 15, so |d| >= $4000 can overflow it), then a doubling: resolution 2 LSB. Valid for |n| < |d|. If the doubling sets bit 15 (|n| >= |d|) both bytes are DECed separately: $8000 -> $7FFF, other values lose 257. Vectors (lab): div(100,300)=10922 in 728 cycles, div(1000,2000)=16384 in 697. 692-771 cycles. Port: Machine.divQ15(a:x:).

routines.name: asr16
routines.outputs: X:A >> 1 (arithmetic); Y = original low byte; carry = bit shifted out
routines.comment: 20 cycles. Port: Machine.asr16(a:x:).

routines.name: mulU16
routines.outputs: $C8-$CB = m*n (exact 32-bit); A = $C9, X = $CA (bits 8-23); N/Z from X (tested at $3309); Y unchanged
routines.sideEffects: $C4:$C5 = 0; $C6:$C7 = n; carry = bit 7 of the old $C9 (unused)
routines.comment: 16-step right-shift multiply; the stale $C8:$C9 is shifted out, so the product is exact. 635 + 16 cycles per set bit of $C4:$C5. The editor overlay calls it 24 times ($B40C-$B962, the mode-record conversions). Port: Machine.mulU16(a:x:).

routines.name: cos8
routines.outputs: A = low, X = high (Q15), Y, carry as $18D0
routines.comment: Clears X (no low byte) and enters $18D0: 5 cycles + $18D0. Callers at $A3CB, $A3F6 and $E7C2 pass the returned carry into $1961/$196D. Also called by the war overlay ($AD69). Port: Machine.cos8(a:).

routines.name: sin8
routines.outputs: A = low, X = high (Q15), Y, carry as $18D0
routines.comment: Clears X and enters $18CD: 5 cycles + $18CD. Also called by the war overlay ($AD32). Port: Machine.sin8(a:).

routines.name: cos9
routines.inputs: Y = angle high byte; A bit 7 = half step (angle low byte $80)
routines.outputs: A = low, X = high (Q15), Y, carry as $18D0
routines.comment: Keeps only the half-step bit as the low byte (X = $80 or 0), the angle high byte in A, and enters $18D0: 9 cycles + $18D0. A half step gives the average of two adjacent entries. Port: Machine.cos9(a:y:).

routines.name: sin9
routines.inputs: Y = angle high byte; A bit 7 = half step
routines.outputs: A = low, X = high (Q15), Y, carry as $18D0
routines.comment: The same setup as cos9, then falls into $18CD: 6 cycles + $18CD. Port: Machine.sin9(a:y:).

routines.name: sin16
routines.inputs: A = angle high byte, X = low byte
routines.outputs: A = low, X = high (Q15), Y, carry as $18D0
routines.comment: Subtracts a quarter turn ($40) from the high byte (8-bit wrap), then falls into $18D0: sin(t) = cos(t - $4000). 4 cycles + $18D0. Vector (lab): sin($1234) with A=$12, X=$34 = 14156. Port: Machine.sin16(a:x:).

routines.name: cos16
routines.inputs: A = angle high byte, X = low byte (16-bit binary angle)
routines.outputs: A = low, X = high (Q15); Y = table index or result low byte; carry (callers chain it into $1961/$196D): clear for an exact entry, the averaged-out bit, the interpolation's high-add carry, or set only for a 0 result in the second quadrant
routines.sideEffects: $BE/$BF (second quadrant: the unnegated value; average: $BE = low sum; interpolation: entry i); interpolation also $C4-$C7, $A7, $A8 via $17EF
routines.comment: Bit 15 set: the angle is negated ($8000 -> $7FFF). High byte $40-$7F: -cos($8000 - t) through a call of $1911. Otherwise it branches to $1911. Vector (lab): cos($1900) = 26489 (entry 25 glitch), 33 cycles. 33-514 cycles. Port: Machine.cos16(a:x:).

routines.name: cosFirstQuadrant
routines.inputs: A = angle high byte 0-$40, X = low byte
routines.outputs: A = low, X = high (Q15); Y = 2*A (or the result low byte after an interpolation); carry
routines.sideEffects: X = $80: $BE = low byte of the entry sum; other X: $BE:$BF = entry i, $C4:$C5 = entry i+1 - entry i, then $17EF ($C4-$C7, $A7, $A8)
routines.comment: Table lookup at $158E + 2*A. X = 0: the entry (23 cycles). X = $80: (t[i] + t[i+1]) >> 1 with the 16-bit sum's carry dropped before a logical LSR (48 cycles). Else t[i] + $17EF(t[i+1] - t[i], (X >> 1) << 8), so X = 1 adds nothing (85 cycles + $17EF). +1 cycle per read that crosses into page $16 (index >= $70/$72). Entry 65 ($1610) is never read. Port: Machine.cosFirstQuadrant (internal).

routines.name: mul8Half
routines.inputs: X = x, Y = y (signed bytes), carry (bias, see $196D)
routines.outputs: Y:A = $196D result >> 1 (arithmetic); X as $196D; carry = bit shifted out
routines.sideEffects: as $196D; one stack byte pushed and pulled
routines.comment: x*y for a positive product; -|x*y| - c for a negative one (-|x*y| - 1 when x >= 0 > y). 31 cycles + $196D. Port: Machine.mul8Half(x:y:carry:).

routines.name: mul8x8
routines.inputs: X = x, Y = y (signed bytes), carry (the bias bit when x >= 0 and y >= 0)
routines.outputs: Y:A = +/-(2*|x|*|y| + c); X = x (positive) or the low byte (negative); carry set for a positive product, else set only for a zero magnitude
routines.comment: Shift-add over the inverted bits of |y|; -128 counts as 127 for both operands. c = the caller's carry when x >= 0 and y >= 0, 1 when x >= 0 > y (left by a subtract of 1), 0 when x < 0: 1x1 = 3 with carry set and 2 with carry clear, 0 x (y < 0) = -1. 119-152 cycles. Port: Machine.mul8x8(x:y:carry:).

routines.name: negate16
routines.comment: Two's-complement negate. 23 cycles, 24 when the low byte is 0. Port: Machine.negate16(a:x:).

routines.name: interpBySpeed
routines.outputs: $C5:$C4 = t[i]*256 + 2*$1961(x = f*8, y = t[i+1] - t[i]) with i = $0A4D >> 4, f = $0A4D & 15; A = $C5; X, Y as $1961; carry out of the high-byte add (used by $2FA4)
routines.comment: The difference is an 8-bit wrapping subtraction (steps over 127 interpolate the wrong way). The incoming carry of $196D is 0, so only falling steps get the bias (-1/2 LSB of the 8.8 result per half step). Reads t[0..16]. 79 cycles (+1 per table read crossing a page) + $1961. Port: Machine.interpBySpeed().

routines.name: updateAltimeterNeedles
routines.sideEffects: When $1F != $0F62: erases the long then the short hand, stores $20 -> $0F63 and draws it, stores $1F -> $0F62 and draws it (all via $1A86). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Only the long hand is compared, so a short-hand change alone waits for the next long-hand change. Cycles: 17 when unchanged, else 80 + four $1A86 calls. Port: Machine.updateAltimeterNeedles.

routines.name: storeAndDrawNeedle
routines.comment: Shared tail of $1A0B (also reached by fall-through) and $1A6A.

routines.name: updateAirspeedNeedle
routines.sideEffects: $B8 = old angle; erases it, $0F64 = old + ((target - old) >> 2 arithmetic, +1 unless negative), draws it (angles >= 88 drawn at angle - 88 by $1A61). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: 5 Hz tick. Never overshoots; an 8-bit difference over 127 turns the other way. Cycles: 14 disabled, 26 settled, else 68 (69 for a negative step) + 8 per $1A61 (9 when the angle is >= 88) + two $1A86 calls. Port: Machine.updateAirspeedNeedle.

routines.name: drawAirspeedNeedleWrapped
routines.comment: Also the fall-through end of $1A32.

routines.name: updateVsiNeedle
routines.sideEffects: When different: erases, moves the angle 1 toward the target (unsigned compare), stores $0F65 and draws (via $1A2B). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: 5 Hz tick; does not test $FD (a failed VSI's needle still settles on the frozen target). Cycles: 18 settled, else 60 (up) / 63 (down) + two $1A86 calls. Port: Machine.updateVsiNeedle.

routines.name: drawNeedle
routines.sideEffects: Panel bitmap (XOR). $0A8C = A, $0A8D = X, $94/$95 = shape table, $96/$97 = shape, $A5/$A7 = mirrored origin (then the row), $E8 = last x, $E9 = end index, $9A/$9B = row base, $0A8E = 0; patches $1B56/$1B59/$1B87/$1B8D. Does not write $0F62. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: 88 steps per turn (0 = 3 o'clock, 22 = up, counterclockwise). Quadrant by angle: < $16 right/up index a; < $2C left/up $2C - a; < $42 left/down a - $2C; else right/down $58 - a. Right: x = (cx - 1) + dx, runs drawn rightward; left: x = (cx + 1) - dx, leftward; up: rows from cy + 1 decreasing; down: from cy - 1 increasing. Shape: (dx, run) per scanline until a byte with bit 7 set; byte (x & $F8) of the row ^= $0F08[x & 7] (x is 8 bits). Cycles: 88 + 3 (long) / 12 (short) + quadrant 95/100/92/85 (right-up/left-up/left-down/right-down) + per scanline 67 + 44 x run, +1 at rows >= 56 (every panel row), +1 per (zp),Y read across a page. Port: Machine.drawNeedle.

routines.name: needleRightHalf
routines.sideEffects: Plants the rightward forms: $1B87 increments X, $1B56/$1B59 clear the carry and add ($96),Y; $E8 = $A5 + $FE; $A5 decremented.
routines.comment: 39 cycles with the RTS.

routines.name: needleLeftHalf
routines.sideEffects: Plants the leftward forms: $1B87 decrements X, $1B56/$1B59 set the carry and subtract ($96),Y; $E8 = $A5 + $EC; $A5 incremented.
routines.comment: 39 cycles with the RTS.

routines.name: needleUpperHalf
routines.sideEffects: $1B8D planted to decrement $A7 (rows going up); $E9 = $A7 + $EC; $A7 incremented.
routines.comment: 27 cycles with the RTS.

routines.name: needleLowerHalf
routines.comment: 23 cycles with the RTS.

routines.name: drawNeedleScanlines
routines.inputs: ($96) shape, $A5 x origin, $A7 first row, patched opcodes
routines.comment: Self-modified: $1B56/$1B59 add or subtract ($96),Y, $1B87 steps X up or down, $1B8D steps $A7 down or up.

routines.name: drawElevatorIndicator
routines.inputs: A = position (caller $2D58: ($50 - elevator hi) >> 3, 8-bit: 0-20 within the key limits $B0..$50, up to 31 beyond)
routines.sideEffects: XOR-erases $0A93's marker, $0A93 = A, draws $0F10 at x 108, row $A9 + A (via $1BC3). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Values over 28 (elevator high byte $51-$68, past the $50 limit of the keys, which give 0-20) reach rows 200-202, past the row tables: bases $0000/$0100/$0200, so the 2x3 block toggles bits of $0068 (eyeRelY low), $0168 (stack page) and $0268 (row-table high byte of window row 104), and the erase toggles them back. Cycles: 21 + 2 x (30 + $1D01). Port: Machine.drawElevatorIndicator.

routines.name: drawAileronIndicator
routines.sideEffects: Erases $0A94's marker, $0A94 = A, draws $0F1D at x $5D + A, row 158. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Cycles: 21 + 2 x (27 + $1D01). Port: Machine.drawAileronIndicator.

routines.name: drawControlPointer
routines.comment: Also reached by fall-through from $1BBB.

routines.name: plotMarkerShape
routines.inputs: A = shape high byte ($9C = low byte), X = x, Y = row
routines.comment: Point list at x < 256 (bit 8 cleared). 12 cycles + $1D01. Port: Machine.plotMarkerShape.

routines.name: plotMarkerShapeXHigh
routines.comment: 7 cycles + $1D01.

routines.name: drawRudderIndicator
routines.sideEffects: Erases $0A96's marker, $0A96 = A, draws $0F1D at x $5D + A, row 196. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Cycles: 21 + 2 x (30 + $1D01). Port: Machine.drawRudderIndicator.

routines.name: drawThrottleIndicator
routines.sideEffects: Erases $0A97's marker, $0A97 = A, draws $1612 at x 225, row $C6 - A. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Cycles: 21 + 2 x (32 + $1D01). Port: Machine.drawThrottleIndicator.

routines.name: drawFlapsIndicator
routines.sideEffects: Erases $0A98's marker, $0A98 = A, draws $161B at x 225, row $73 + A. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Cycles: 21 + 2 x (33 + $1D01). Port: Machine.drawFlapsIndicator.

routines.name: drawTrimIndicator
routines.sideEffects: Erases $0A99's marker, $0A99 = A, draws $161B at x 225, row $94 + A. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Cycles: 21 + 2 x (33 + $1D01). Port: Machine.drawTrimIndicator.

routines.name: drawMixtureIndicator
routines.sideEffects: Erases the marker of the old $0A9A, $0A9A = A (the mixture itself), draws $161B at x 232, row $B9 + A. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Cycles: 21 + 2 x (30 + $1D01). Port: Machine.drawMixtureIndicator.

routines.name: drawSliderMarker
routines.comment: Also reached by fall-through from $1C31.

routines.name: drawTurnBall
routines.sideEffects: When A != $0A95: erases the old ball, $0A95 = A, draws $0F30 at x $0E + A, row 190. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Cycles: 12 unchanged, else 28 + 2 x (30 + $1D01). Port: Machine.drawTurnBall.

routines.name: drawLeftFuelGauge
routines.sideEffects: When $09C2 >> 1 != $0A9B: erases, stores, draws the bar $0F49 at x 260 + v, row 178 (via $1C8F). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Main-loop phase 0. Cycles: 18 unchanged, else 37 + 2 x (29 + $1D01). Port: Machine.drawLeftFuelGauge.

routines.name: drawRightFuelGauge
routines.sideEffects: As $1C5D with x 295 + v (value + $23). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Main-loop phase 1. Cycles: 19 unchanged, else 41 + 2 x (29 + $1D01). Port: Machine.drawRightFuelGauge.

routines.name: drawFuelBar
routines.comment: Also the fall-through end of $1C75. 29 cycles + $1D01.

routines.name: plotEngineBar
routines.comment: Also the fall-through end of $1C8F.

routines.name: drawOilTempGauge
routines.sideEffects: When $09CB != $0A9D: erases, stores, draws the bar at x 260 + v, row 186 (via $1CD7). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Main-loop phase 2. Cycles: 16 unchanged, else 35 + 2 x (32 + $1D01). Port: Machine.drawOilTempGauge.

routines.name: drawOilPressureGauge
routines.sideEffects: As $1CA7 with x 295 + v. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Main-loop phase 3. Cycles: 17 unchanged, else 39 + 2 x (32 + $1D01). Port: Machine.drawOilPressureGauge.

routines.name: drawOilBar
routines.comment: Also the fall-through end of $1CBE. 32 cycles + $1D01.

routines.name: drawFuelSelectorMarker
routines.sideEffects: XORs $1CE7 at x 287, row 179 ($0A90 = 1, via $1BC7). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: A toggle with no state: the tank-select keys call it once per change of $09C6. 26 cycles + $1D01. Port: Machine.drawFuelSelectorMarker.

routines.name: plotPointList
routines.inputs: X = x, Y = row, ($9C) = [count][dx, dy] x count, $0A90 = x bit 8
routines.sideEffects: $0A9F = X, $0AA0 = Y, $0AA1 = index, $F3 = 0, $0A90 += each x + dx carry, $8E/$8F = last row pointer; XORs $0F08[x & 7] into byte x & $F8 of each point's row (+$100 when $0A90 != 0). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Count 0 means 256; rows are 8-bit through the row tables (rows >= 200 read past them). Cycles: 30 + 104 per point (108 when $0A90 != 0) - 1 + page crossings (+1 per point at rows >= 56). Port: Machine.plotPointList.

routines.name: printSigned5
routines.outputs: C = 1 when the terminator is $A0-$FF, 0 for $00-$1F (the end test subtracts $20); $EB25 adds it in (its add does not clear the carry first)
routines.sideEffects: Record bytes +2..+7 = sign and 5 ASCII digits; $B8/$B9 = last remainder (negated value for negatives); $BA/$BB = record+2; $A5-$A7; then as $1DE2. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Sign ' ' or '-' (negating $B8/$B9), digits by repeated subtraction of 10000/1000/100/10 ($1DBB; stops when the high byte goes negative), units digit = $B8 | $30. -32768 stays negative after negation and prints six dashes. Then JMP $1DE2. Port: Machine.printSigned5.

routines.name: printDigit
routines.inputs: A/X = divisor, Y = digit place, $B8/$B9 = value, $BA/$BB = field
routines.comment: One decimal digit of $1D54 by repeated subtraction.

routines.name: drawTextRecord
routines.outputs: C = 1 when the terminator is $A0-$FF, 0 for $00-$1F (the end test subtracts $20); $EB25 adds it in (its add does not clear the carry first)
routines.comment: Draws one text record [row][x][ASCII...][terminator]: row through the row tables, x in multicolor pixels (2 hi-res pixels on the panel), each character an opaque 4x5 pen-3 cell, x += 4. Any byte < $20 or >= $A0 terminates. Port: Machine.drawTextRecord (Sources/FS2Core/Raster/Text.swift).

routines.name: drawTextRecordAt
routines.outputs: C = 1 when the terminator is $A0-$FF, 0 for $00-$1F (the end test subtracts $20); $EB25 adds it in (its add does not clear the carry first)
routines.sideEffects: $C0/$C1 advance past the terminator; $C2 = row, $C3 = x + 4 per character; glyph temporaries $38, $8E/$8F, $A5-$A7, $A9, $AB-$AE. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Reads row and x ($1DEC), then the character loop at $1E8E: fetch, SBC #$20, stop when negative, else draw the glyph ($1E01). Port: Machine.drawTextRecordAt.

routines.name: readRecordPosition
routines.comment: Two $1DF6 fetches (the first kept on the stack).

routines.name: readRecordByte
routines.comment: Fetch and post-increment of the record pointer. Its BNE to $1E00 crosses a page (4 cycles when taken).

routines.name: drawGlyph
routines.inputs: A = character - $20, $C2 = row, $C3 = x, $C0/$C1 = rest of the record
routines.sideEffects: As $1DE2 (continues with the record's next characters).
routines.comment: Glyph word $1634[2A] into $A5/$A6; per row (5): the next 3 bits from the bottom of the word (bit 2 of each group = leftmost pixel) -> $1624 pixel pairs, shifted right 2*(x & 3) across two bytes ($AC, $AB), stored as (byte & $162C/$1630[x & 3]) | pixels at the row pointer + ((x << 1) & $1F8) and +8. Then $C3 += 4, $C2 restored, and on to $1E8E. Codes $5B-$9F index past the 59 glyphs into the code at $16AA. Port: Machine.drawGlyph.

routines.name: drawTextList
routines.inputs: A = low, X = high list address
routines.sideEffects: As $1DE2 per record; $C0/$C1 end at the 00 00.
routines.comment: Draws records until one starts with 00 00 (a record with row 0 and x != 0 is drawn). Port: Machine.drawTextList.
