routines.name: mainLoop
routines.comment: Endless loop, no vsync. Per pass: editor overlay slot $A7E8 if $08BA|$08BB (then the cache bookkeeping: $08BC, $E6DB); $A7F4; $32EE+$E716 (or slew $3660); $F6E2; $E565; $8000; page flip $208B (unless bit 0 of $0E79, shifted out, is set); draw sequence $20D5; phase tasks $210D on $22; $22 + 1. Port: Machine.runMainLoop(fromEntry:) with mainLoopHook before every pass, Machine.mainLoopPass() for one pass (Sources/FS2Core/Game/MainLoop.swift).

routines.name: pageFlip
routines.comment: Page flip: 112 x ($0200+r += $8D) (rows 0-111 to the other bitmap; LDA $01FF,X always crosses a page), $8D ^= $C0; $8D negative: $22B0 = $F0, else the alternate-pass tasks $20A3 and $22B0 = $F8 (the IRQ's $D018 operand: the bitmap just finished is shown). Port: Machine.pageFlip().

routines.name: alternatePassTasks
routines.comment: Every other flip: $E713 (ATIS teletype); $F95D with A = $0834 when $0834 != 0; $F627 when bit 0 of $0E70 (shifted out) is set; in war mode $FD00 when bit 0 of $08D7 (shifted out) is set (empty in this image: a documented no-op in the port, excluded.md); when $0E87 != 0: $0E87 = 0 and the slot $A7FA. Port: Machine.alternatePassTasks().

routines.name: drawSequence
routines.comment: Draw sequence of every pass: $8003, $8006, $3C3F, $3AB9, $8021, $3BAF, $3C1A, $F8AF, $3773, $377C, $3823, $EBA5, war mode: $A7EE (the BEQ at $20FC crosses a page), $ED3C, $CE84, $CF0E, $F35E. Port: Machine.drawSequence().

routines.name: phaseTasks
routines.comment: Phase tasks on $22 & 3: 0 = $EBF2, $8012, $1C5D, $E766, $3A13, and with $22 & 4 also $38D4, $38F5, $EA50, the demo check $2133 ($095B -> $08BB = 3) and the war-exit check $213D ($0E7C set and $0963 != 7 -> JMP $A7E2); 1 = $1C75, $F86F; 2 = $1CA7, $35BD; 3 = $1CBE, $EA84 (with the carry $1CBE leaves); then the odd ($216A) or even ($2185) tasks. Port: Machine.phaseTasks() (returns .coldRestart for the war exit).

routines.name: oddPhaseTasks
routines.comment: Odd phases: $3B32, $3B9B, $CF46, $E7FE, then $0832:$0833 rotated left by one bit (the top bit wraps into bit 0). Port: Machine.oddPhaseTasks().

routines.name: evenPhaseTasks
routines.comment: Even phases: $F996, $F916, $CF79, $EE6B. Port: Machine.evenPhaseTasks().

routines.name: panelRedraw
routines.sideEffects: JSR $38BD, $38D9, $3903, $3A5C, $39D9 (each gated by $3A53). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Redraws the radio and clock readouts at init (the disk's panel bitmap has stale digits). Port: Machine.panelRedraw.

routines.name: waitForKey
routines.comment: Saves $08BA and $08D3 on the stack, $08D3 = 0 and silences the sound ($CC16), $08CC + 1 (pauses the 5 Hz work and the 1 Hz sound/clock tick), $08BA = 1 (text input), then polls the scheduler ($2330) until the dispatcher has stored code|$80 in $08C4; $08C4 &= $7F, restores $08D3 and $08BA, shifts $08CC right, returns A = code & $7F. Used by P/CTRL-P/RUN-STOP (pause; the ending key is consumed), the title prompts, the course plotter menu and the editor (vector $2003). Port: Machine.waitForKey() (the loop calls poll(), the scheduler's $2330); 32 + soundTick + n x (13 + $2330) + 46 cycles.

routines.name: rasterIrq
routines.comment: Two-phase raster IRQ (vector $FFFE from $25EB): saves A, $01 = $35, shifts $4A right. Bit 0 set (line $20, the window): $D018 = [$22B0], border = [$22B5], $D016 = $D8, $D012 = $A3, then the frame tick $22C3. Bit 0 clear (line $A3, the panel): border $0C, $D018 = $F0, $D016 = $C8, $D012 = $20, $D019 = $FF, $4A + 1, $01 = $4B, return from the interrupt. Port: Machine.rasterIrq(), which also latches io.viewRegion / io.panelRegion; entered through Machine.irq() (the 7-cycle entry).

routines.name: frameTick
routines.comment: Per-frame work shared with $2304: $34 + 1, $0E6B + 1, the pattern player $22C8, the keyboard phase $22CD ($08A6 - 1: 0 -> $2418 scan, negative -> $2505 release check and $08A6 = 3; X and Y saved), $D019 = 1, $01 = $4B, A restored, return from the interrupt. Port: Machine.frameTick().

routines.name: patternPlayerFrame
routines.comment: Fragment of the frame tick (not a subroutine): $0E5B - 1; at 0 the step $230A runs (and continues at $22CD); otherwise falls into the keyboard phase at $22CD. Runs every frame in both the raster IRQ $2285 and the alternate IRQ $2304. A countdown that wraps from 0 waits 256 frames. Port: Machine.patternPlayerFrame(); 8 cycles, or 10 plus the step.

routines.name: altIrq
routines.comment: Alternate IRQ (installed by $2673 for text mode and the editor's disk I/O): saves A and enters the frame tick $22C3 (no VIC writes, no $01 = $35 on entry). Port: Machine.altIrq().

routines.name: patternStep
routines.comment: Voice-3 gate pattern step: $0E5B = $0E5A; if ($2308&7)==0 then $2309 = $0E5E; $2308 + 1; $2309 shifted right -> $D412 = $0E60 if the bit was 1, else 0 (written every step). Continues at $22CD. Port: Machine.patternStep(); 43-51 cycles.

routines.name: pollTick
routines.comment: The 10 Hz poll (vector $2012): $0E6B - 6; when negative nothing is due (16 cycles + the caller's call and the vector's jump). Otherwise $0E6B keeps the difference, $01 = $35, the tick body $2348, $01 = $4B. One tick per poll: a backlog is caught up over the following polls. Port: Machine.pollTick: it first calls the replay/scheduler hook pollHandler, then runs the tick body tick10Hz ($2348) when one is due (Sources/FS2Core/Game/Poll.swift).

routines.name: tick10Hz
routines.comment: 10 Hz work: one key ($27D8) unless the ring is empty or $08C3; $E500; slot 3 then 2 held and counter 0: $24EB with the matrix index (else the counter - 1); bomb sweep $2381; $0E6C + 1, even: unless paused ($08CC) $091C - 1, $2F45, $1A32, $1A6A, $2688 if $0E6F|$0E6E, $26EC if $0E7A; then $DC09 compared with $0E6D: changed and not paused: $CC16, the clock ($091A/$0984/$0983 with carries, 24 -> 0), $39B6, and on even seconds $EAE2. Port: Machine.tick10Hz() (reads $DC09 through Machine.readIO).

routines.name: bombWhistleSweep
routines.comment: Fragment of the 10 Hz tick (not a subroutine; continues at $239B): while $0E7E bit 7 is clear, $0E7D/$0E7E -= $F0 and the new value goes to $D40E then $D40F. Runs whether sound is on or off; with sound off the explosion never stops it, so it runs until the value wraps below zero. Port: Machine.bombWhistleSweep(); 7 or 34 cycles.

routines.name: keyScan
routines.sideEffects: $0899, $089A, $089F, $08A0, $08A1-$08A4, $0E6A, via keyPress the slots, counters and ring; $DC00 writes
routines.comment: Frame IRQ keyboard phase 0 (every 4th frame): $0899 = 0, $089A = X = $FE; per column $2574 (a joystick bit low: on to $2557, which ends the scan); clears a pending $0E6A; when the row read is not $FF, every low row bit ($089F row, $08A0 mask) calls keyPress with $0899 + row; then $0899 += 8 and $089A rotated left with a 1 shifted in, until the carry clears. Columns go 0 to 7, so CTRL (column 7) pressed in the same scan as a letter is seen after it. Port: Machine.keyScan().

routines.name: keyPress
routines.comment: A = matrix index seen down. Returns if a slot holds it; else takes the first slot with bit 7 set from 3 down (slot = index, $0E71,X = 5) and falls into requeueKey; with no free slot the key is lost. Port: Machine.keyPress(_:).

routines.name: requeueKey
routines.comment: Y = matrix index. A = $2482,Y; >= $80: only CTRL ($FB) acts, $0E67 = 1. Otherwise minus $40 while $0E67 is set (codes below $40 wrap to $C0-$FF and are dropped by the dispatcher) and JMP $25DC. Entered from keyPress and from the 10 Hz tick for slots 3/2. Port: Machine.requeueKey(_:).

routines.name: keyReleaseCheck
routines.comment: Frame IRQ keyboard phase -1: for each held slot from 3 down, $0898 = index, $08A5 = slot, $2574 with column select $247A[index >> 3] (a joystick bit low: on to $2557, aborting the check, so held keys stay held while a stick is deflected); when $2472[index & 7] masked with $08A1 is nonzero the key is up: slot = $80, and if its code is CTRL $0E67 = 0. The IRQ then reloads $08A6 = 3. Port: Machine.keyReleaseCheck().

routines.name: joystickLatch
routines.comment: Fragment reached by a jump from keyScan and keyReleaseCheck (its return ends them): Y + 1; Y was $FF (the two samples of a port differed): return. Else $0E6A = 1, $0E6E = ~$08A1 & $1F, $0E6F = ~$08A2 & $1F. Port: private Machine.joystickLatch(y:).

routines.name: sampleCia1
routines.outputs: C = joystick active, X = row read, Y = $00 agree / $FF differ
routines.comment: X = column select. $DC00 = $FF; $08A1 = $DC00 (port 2), $08A2 = $DC01 (port 1); $DC00 = X, X = $DC01 (row read); $DC00 = $FF; $08A3 = $DC00, $08A4 = $DC01. No 0 bit in the four samples: $08A1 = X, C = 0 (78 cycles). Else C = 1 and Y = 0 when the samples of each port agree, $FF when not (only if the input changes within the call). Port: Machine.sampleCia1(column:) reading io.keyboard (DDRA = $FF, DDRB = $00).

routines.name: dequeueKey
routines.outputs: A = code, C = 1 (or C = 0, A = read index when empty)
routines.comment: Read index $08A8 = write index $08A7: C = 0, A = the read index. Else INC $08A8, A = $08A9[$08A8 & 7], C = 1. The indices are compared as full bytes. Port: Machine.dequeueKey() (vector $203C).

routines.name: enqueueKey
routines.comment: INC $08A7, $08A9[$08A7 & 7] = A. No overflow check: two repeating keys queue two codes per 10 Hz tick while one is dispatched, so a backlog builds up (the 8 entries wrap over unread codes) and drains one per tick after release. Port: Machine.enqueueKey(_:); 32 cycles.

routines.name: displayInit
routines.sideEffects: VIC, CIA2 port A, $0E89, $7FF8-$7FFB, $FFFE/$FFFF, color RAM, $39/$3A
routines.comment: With interrupts masked: $D011 = $3B; $DD02 = $3F; $DD00 = $96 (bank $4000; shadow $0E89); sprites 0-3 on and multicolor ($D025 = $0B, $D026 = $01, colors $0B) at ($58,$AA) ($68,$AA) ($58,$B5) ($68,$B5), pointers $E8-$EB at $7FF8; $D021 = [$0E69]; IRQ vector $FFFE/$FFFF = $2285 (memory); $D012 = $97, $D01A = 1, $D019 = $0F; then interrupts enabled and color RAM filled white through $7331 (-> $794E). Port: Machine.displayInit() (Sources/FS2Core/Display/InitDisplay.swift).

routines.name: textModeIrqSwap
routines.comment: With interrupts masked: $732E -> $796C (text screen), $0E89 = $97, IRQ vector $2304 (tick only). Port: Machine.textModeIrqSwap (Sources/FS2Core/Display/TextMode.swift).

routines.name: joystickAction
routines.comment: 5 Hz (when $0E6E | $0E6F): LSRs the latches bit by bit: port 1 up = $091C = 0 + T ($2D2B), down = $091C = 0 + B ($2E5C) (so never the 16 step), left = F ($2D6D) + $0E78 = 3, right = H ($2DC2) + $0E78 = 3, fire = '5' ($2C70); port 2 up = $2C1E, down = $2C31, fire = $2C03. A is saved around every call except throttleDown, so with port 2 down and fire the fire test shifts the A that $2C31 returns (bit 2 of the last throttle-marker byte, or of the negative throttle - 8). Then $0E6E = $0E6F = 0, $0E7A = 1. Port: Machine.joystickAction().

routines.name: autoCenter
routines.comment: Shifts $0E78 right; a 1 shifted out returns. Else shifts $0E7A right and centers ailerons and rudder ($2D9D with A = 0). The 6 bytes after it ($26F9) are unreachable. Port: Machine.autoCenter().

routines.name: restoreNmi
routines.comment: NMI handler (vector set at $AB0E): when $089E == $3F (RUN/STOP first in the slots) and $26FF == 0, sets $26FF and restarts through the cold-start slot $A7E2 (the reload clears $26FF); otherwise returns from the interrupt with A preserved. Port: Machine.restoreNmi() -> Bool (true: the caller performs the restart); 22 or 28 cycles (return), 26 (restart).

routines.name: dispatchKey
routines.comment: Takes the next code from $25C4 (A = code, or the read index when empty) and sets $095A = 0 (ends the demo). $08BA != 0: $08C4 = A | $80 and return. Codes >= $60 dropped. Else the jump operand $27FF/$2800 = $2718 + 2*A and an indirect jump through it: the handler's return returns for the dispatcher. Port: Machine.dispatchKey().

routines.name: keyEditor
routines.comment: E, CLR/HOME (codes $45, $1B): $08BA = 1, the main loop runs the editor overlay. Port: Machine.keyEditor(); 12 cycles.

routines.name: key1
routines.comment: '1': $FC = 3: magnetos OFF (setMagnetos A = 0, X = 0); $FC 6/7: $0AB7 = 1 (NAV1); $FC $0C: $0ACB = 1 (OBS1). Port: Machine.key1().

routines.name: setMagnetos
routines.inputs: A = switch code, X = label index
routines.comment: $FC = 0, $EE15 = A >> 1, $EE14 = A & 1, then $2837 (X = label). Codes: 0 OFF, 1 R or L (same bits), 3 BOTH or START. Labels: 0 OFF, 1 L, 2 R, 3 BOTH, 4 START. Callers: '1' '2' '3', '4'/'5' with $FC = 3, vector $2009. Port: Machine.setMagnetos(_:label:).

routines.name: setMagnetoLabel
routines.comment: $0AB6 = X, then the carb heat, lights and magneto labels ($3A71). Also called from the engine's starter ($EECE, X = 3 BOTH). Port: Machine.setMagnetoLabel(_:).

routines.name: key2
routines.comment: '2': $FC = 3: magnetos R (A = 1, X = 2); $FC 6/7: NAV2 ($0AB7 = 2); $FC $0C: OBS2 ($0ACB = 2). Port: Machine.key2().

routines.name: key3
routines.comment: '3': magnetos L (A = 1, X = 1) whatever $FC is (no RETURN prefix needed). Port: Machine.key3().

routines.name: key8
routines.comment: '8': DEC $0AC3, the slew pitch rate. Port: Machine.key8(); 12 cycles.

routines.name: key9
routines.comment: '9': INC $0AC3. Port: Machine.key9(); 12 cycles.

routines.name: decrementSelected
routines.comment: ',': JSR $E9BF (ADF digit / mixture), $091C = 0. War mode ($0969) or $FC = 2: radar zoom out, the 24-bit $0889-$088B shifted left with a 1 in and bit 23 cleared. Else $2891 by $FC: 4 COM MHz down (118 -> 135), 5 COM kHz down ($2963), 6/7 NAV MHz ($2977) / kHz of NAV1 or NAV2 by $0AB7, 8-$0B transponder digit $FC-8 down ('0' -> '7'), $0C OBS1/OBS2 by $0ACB down (0 -> $B3), $10 fuel tank 1 -> 0 ($1CF0); others nothing. Each change redraws ($3903, $38BD/$38D9, $3A5C, $3923/$3976). Port: Machine.decrementSelected().

routines.name: decrementRadio
routines.comment: Part of decrementSelected: the item chain for $FC 4-$10 (A = $FC - 2, X = $FC - 4 ... DEX per item). Port: private Machine.decrementRadio(_:).

routines.name: kHzDown
routines.comment: kHz digits down: A = tenths, X = hundredths: .x5 -> .x0, .x0 -> .(x-1)5, .00 -> .95 (no borrow into MHz). Port: Machine.kHzDown (static); 13/18/21 cycles.

routines.name: navMHzDown
routines.comment: NAV MHz digits down: A = tens, X = units after the painted '1': '0','8' (108) -> '1','7' (117); else X - 1, '/' -> '9' with A = '0'. Port: Machine.navMHzDown (static).

routines.name: incrementSelected
routines.comment: '.': JSR $E9F6, $091C = 0. War mode or $FC = 2: radar zoom in, $088B-$0889 shifted right with a 0 in, then $0889 |= $1F. Else $29B3: COM MHz up (135 -> 118), kHz up ($2AA9), NAV MHz up ($2ABE, 117 -> 108), transponder digit up ('7' -> '0'), OBS up ($B3 -> 0), fuel tank 0 -> 1. Port: Machine.incrementSelected().

routines.name: incrementRadio
routines.comment: Part of incrementSelected: the item chain for $FC 4-$10. Port: private Machine.incrementRadio(_:).

routines.name: kHzUp
routines.comment: kHz digits up: .x0 -> .x5, .x5 -> .(x+1)0, .95 -> .00 (no carry). Port: Machine.kHzUp (static); 13/18/23 cycles.

routines.name: navMHzUp
routines.comment: NAV MHz digits up: '1','7' (117) -> '0','8' (108); else X + 1, ':' -> '0' with A + 1. Port: Machine.navMHzUp (static).

routines.name: keyDeclareWar
routines.comment: W: $0ACC |= 1 (the war overlay shows 'WAR !!!!' and sets 3). The RTS at $2ADE is unreachable. Port: Machine.keyDeclareWar(); 16 cycles.

routines.name: keyCtrlT
routines.comment: CTRL-T: outside slew an always-taken branch (across a page) to $2B0D, the transponder select. In slew: $09DE/$09DF = -$6C/$6D, $09E0/$09E1 = -$6E/$6F (16-bit), $0A13/$0A14 = $70/$71 (copies the view attitude back; 66 cycles). Port: Machine.keyCtrlT().

routines.name: keyTransponderSelect
routines.comment: CTRL-X (CTRL-T outside slew): within the window $091C and $FC in 8-$0B, A = $FC + 1 (the fifth quick press reaches $0C, the OBS); else 8; JMP $2BBC. Port: Machine.keyTransponderSelect().

routines.name: keyAdfSelect
routines.comment: A, CTRL-A, LEFT SHIFT (codes $41, $01): JMP $E9A7 (selectAdfDigit: $FC $0D, then $0E, $0F, $10 on quick repeats, then $0D again). Port: Machine.keyAdfSelect().

routines.name: keyCtrlB
routines.comment: CTRL-B: $09CE-$09D1 = 0 (the altimeter offset and drift that reality mode builds up). Port: Machine.keyCtrlB(); 24 cycles.

routines.name: keyCtrlD
routines.comment: CTRL-D: $08C0/$08C1 = $08C5/$08C6 - $70/$71 + $0848/$0849 + $0846/$0847 (16-bit; the DG realigned to the compass). Port: Machine.keyCtrlD(); 74 cycles.

routines.name: keyCarbHeat
routines.comment: CTRL-I (code $09): $0AA9 inverted, then the labels $3A71. Port: Machine.keyCarbHeat().

routines.name: keyLights
routines.comment: L, CTRL-L (codes $4C, $0C): $0AB5 inverted, then the labels $3A71. Port: Machine.keyLights().

routines.name: keyDropBomb
routines.comment: X: in war mode ($0969) with $08E8 != '0': $08E8 - 1 and the bomb release sound $CD04. Port: Machine.keyDropBomb().

routines.name: keyComSelect
routines.comment: CTRL-C: (a dead load of 1) within the window and $FC = 4: $FC = 5 (kHz; window not renewed). Otherwise $FC = 4 via $2BBC, after $0937 + 1 (COM search request) when $FC was 5 within the window. Port: Machine.keyComSelect().

routines.name: keyObsSelect
routines.comment: CTRL-V: $FC = $0C (OBS; no window). Port: Machine.keyObsSelect(); 11 cycles.

routines.name: keyNavSelect
routines.comment: CTRL-N: within the window and $FC = 6: INC $FC (7, kHz); else $FC = 6 and the window (falls into $2BBC). Port: Machine.keyNavSelect().

routines.name: storeSelected
routines.comment: $FC = A, $091C = 3. Port: Machine.storeSelected(_:); 15 cycles.

routines.name: keyReturn
routines.comment: RETURN: $FC = 3 (the magneto/mixture prefix). Port: Machine.keyReturn(); 11 cycles.

routines.name: keySpace
routines.comment: SPACE: $0A12 = 0 (airborne): a branch (across a page) to fireGuns. On the ground: $0A4D decremented twice; negative: $0A4C = $0A4D = 0. Also called from the ground contact $354A (repositioning). Port: Machine.keySpace().

routines.name: keyRecallMode
routines.comment: '+': $08BB = 1 (the editor overlay reloads mode $0963). Port: Machine.keyRecallMode(); 12 cycles.

routines.name: keySaveMode
routines.comment: S: $08BB = 2 (the editor overlay saves user mode $0963 + 10 and selects it). Port: Machine.keySaveMode(); 15 cycles.

routines.name: keyCoursePlotter
routines.comment: Q: $0E70 = 1. Port: Machine.keyCoursePlotter(); 12 cycles.

routines.name: keyZeroAttitude
routines.comment: Z: in slew zeroes $6E-$71 then $6C/$6D (BEQ across a page when not slewing). Port: Machine.keyZeroAttitude().

routines.name: fireGuns
routines.comment: SPACE airborne, joystick port 2 fire: war mode ($0969) and ammo $0AA5|$0AA6 != 0: $0AB2 = 3, $0E59 = 3, JSR $CCD1 (sfxGun). Port: Machine.fireGuns().

routines.name: throttleUp
routines.comment: ';' (code $15, also CTRL-U), joystick port 2 up: $0AC5 + 1 (slew altitude rate); bit 0 of $08D5 (shifted out) set: throttle $0AC9 = $78; else $0AC9 + 8 unless the sum is negative (return); then $2C43. Port: Machine.throttleUp().

routines.name: throttleDown
routines.comment: ':', DEL, '<-' (code $08), joystick port 2 down: $0AC5 - 1; '/' armed: 0; else $0AC9 - 8 unless negative (returns with A = the difference: 1-7 stay); then $2C43 ($0AC9 = A) and $2C46. Port: Machine.throttleDown() -> UInt8 (A, used by joystickAction).

routines.name: storeThrottle
routines.comment: Part of the throttle keys: STA $0AC9, then $2C46. Port: private Machine.storeThrottle(_:).

routines.name: updateThrottleIndicator
routines.comment: Vector $2027: the marker ($1BE1) at $0AC9 >> 3. Returns A as plotPointList leaves it, the last bitmap byte XORed. Port: Machine.updateThrottleIndicator() -> UInt8.

routines.name: throttleJump
routines.comment: '/': $08D5 = 1, so the next throttle key jumps to $78 or 0. Port: Machine.throttleJump(); 12 cycles.

routines.name: keyFuelTankSelect
routines.comment: CTRL-F: $FC = $10 (fuel tank selector). Port: Machine.keyFuelTankSelect(); 11 cycles.

routines.name: keyRadar
routines.comment: '4': $FC = 3: magnetos BOTH (A = 3, X = 3); else $FC = 2 and $0836 = 1 (radar view). Port: Machine.keyRadar().

routines.name: keyViewSelect
routines.comment: '5', joystick port 1 fire: $FC = 3: magnetos START (A = 3, X = 4); radar on: $0836 = 0 ($FC kept); else $FC = 1 (view prefix). Port: Machine.keyViewSelect().

routines.name: keyTrimUp
routines.comment: V: $2E84 (X = $0A); INC $0AC1; trim $0AAE + 4 unless it makes $54 (max $50); $2CAF marker. Port: Machine.keyTrimUp().

routines.name: keyTrimDown
routines.comment: R: $2E84 (X = $0E); $08D7 = 1 (war-mode $FD00 request); INC $0ABF; trim - 4 unless it makes $AC (min -$50); $2CAF. Port: Machine.keyTrimDown().

routines.name: storeTrim
routines.comment: Part of the trim keys: unless at the limit, $0AAE = A; marker ($50 - $0AAE) >> 4 via $1C10; returns at $2CC1. Port: private Machine.storeTrim(_:limit:).

routines.name: keyIgnored
routines.comment: RTS: the default dispatch target. Port: Machine.keyIgnored(); 6 cycles.

routines.name: keyFlapsUp
routines.comment: Y: $2E84 (X = 2); DEC $0ABF; flaps $0AB0 - $20, floored at 0; $2CD4. Port: Machine.keyFlapsUp().

routines.name: storeFlaps
routines.comment: Part of the flaps keys: STA $0AB0, then $2CD7. Port: private Machine.storeFlaps(_:).

routines.name: updateFlaps
routines.comment: Vector $2045 (editor exit, A = $0AB0): marker A >> 4 ($1BFD); flap lift $0A25 = flaps x $0A7E (Q15 from $C4/$C5); $2F07; flap drag $0A0A = high byte of flaps x $0A6C. Port: Machine.updateFlaps(_:).

routines.name: keyFlapsDown
routines.comment: N: $2E84 (X = 6); $0AC1 - 1; not in slew: flaps + $20, at most $60 (the test branches across a page); $2CD4. Port: Machine.keyFlapsDown().

routines.name: keyElevatorDown
routines.comment: T, joystick port 1 up: $2E84 (X = 0); $0AAC - 4, and - 12 more when $091C != 0 and not slewing; stored; negative below $B0 -> $B0; $2D50: stored, $091C = 3, $2D58. Port: Machine.keyElevatorDown().

routines.name: storeElevator
routines.comment: Part of the elevator keys: STA $0AAC, $091C = 3, then $2D58. Port: private Machine.storeElevator(_:).

routines.name: updateElevatorIndicator
routines.comment: Vector $2024, also called from the reality-mode trim creep $EB08: A = ($50 - $0AAC) >> 3; when it differs from $2715, stores it and draws the marker ($1B92). Port: Machine.updateElevatorIndicator().

routines.name: keyAileronLeft
routines.comment: F, joystick port 1 left: $2E84 (X = $0C); $0AA4 - 4 refused when it gives $80; stored, then $2DD2. Port: Machine.keyAileronLeft().

routines.name: keyCenter
routines.comment: G: $2E84 (X = $FF); in slew $0AAC, $0AC3, $0ABF, $0AC1, $0AC5 = 0; then $2D9D. Port: Machine.keyCenter().

routines.name: centerControls
routines.comment: A = 0 (G, autoCenter): $0AA4 = $0ABD = A; when ($09A9 >> 1) + $09FD (8-bit) >= $09A9 the roll term $09FC/$09FD goes to the roll cancel $0E76/$0E77; then $2DD2 and $2E38. Port: Machine.centerControls().

routines.name: keyAileronRight
routines.comment: H, joystick port 1 right: $2E84 (X = 4); $0AA4 + 4 refused on overflow (the test branches across a page); stored, falls into $2DD2. Port: Machine.keyAileronRight().

routines.name: coordinateRudder
routines.comment: Auto-coordination ($0965): rudder $0ABC/$0ABD = ailerons, JSR $2E4C; then falls into $2DE6. Port: Machine.coordinateRudder().

routines.name: updateAileronIndicator
routines.comment: Vector $202D: position ($0AA4 + $7F) >> 3 into $2716 (the marker $1BAC when it changed); aileron coefficient $0A1D = ailerons x $0A7A (or $0A7C while $0E75 runs), Q15; then $2E92. Port: Machine.updateAileronIndicator().

routines.name: keyRudderLeft
routines.comment: C: $0ABD - 4 refused when it gives $80; $2E35. Port: Machine.keyRudderLeft().

routines.name: keyRudderRight
routines.comment: M: $0ABD + 4 refused on overflow; $2E35. Port: Machine.keyRudderRight().

routines.name: storeRudder
routines.comment: Part of the rudder keys: STA $0ABD, then $2E38. Port: private Machine.storeRudder(_:).

routines.name: coordinateAilerons
routines.comment: Auto-coordination: ailerons = rudder, JSR $2DE6; then falls into $2E4C. Port: private Machine.coordinateAilerons().

routines.name: updateRudderIndicator
routines.comment: Vector $202A: the marker $1BCD with ($0ABD + $7F) >> 3 (always), then $2E92. Port: Machine.updateRudderIndicator().

routines.name: keyElevatorUp
routines.comment: B, joystick port 1 down: $2E84 (X = 8); $0AAC + 4, + 12 more in the window when not slewing; stored; positive $50 or more -> $50; continues at $2D50. Port: Machine.keyElevatorUp().

routines.name: captureViewKey
routines.comment: X = view code. $FC == 1: $FC - 1, $0ACA = X, and the caller's return address dropped (the handler returns at once). Codes: T 0, Y 2, H 4, N 6, B 8, V $0A, F $0C, R $0E, G $FF (down). Port: Machine.captureViewKey(_:) -> Bool (captured); 14 or 30 cycles.

routines.name: controlCoefficients
routines.comment: slip_hi $09F3 = (ailerons_hi ASR 1) - (rudder_hi ASR 1); slipDrag = (0:slip_hi) x $0A70, slipYaw = slip x $0A68, slipTrackOffset = slip x $0A6A, slipRoll = slip x $0A66 (Q15, $17EF); falls into $2F07. The aileron and flap coefficients $0A1D/$0A25/$0A0A are built by the key handlers themselves ($2E15, $2CEE). Port: Machine.controlCoefficients(); 172 cycles + 2 x asr16 + 4 x mulQ15AX + 90.

routines.name: rebuildWingCoefficients
routines.comment: base = flapLift + CL0; CL_R $0A23 = base - aileronCoefficient; CL_L $0A21 = base + aileronCoefficient + slipRoll (16-bit). A positive aileron (H, roll right) lifts the left wing. Port: Machine.rebuildWingCoefficients(); 90 cycles.

routines.name: keyDatabaseInfo
routines.comment: CTRL-E: INC $0E87 (the main loop loads the database info overlay). Port: Machine.keyDatabaseInfo(); 12 cycles.

routines.name: aeroUpdate
routines.inputs: gamma, phi, V, elevator, rudder, CL_L/CL_R, density, thrust, slip terms, $0E7B, $0E75, $0A12, $08D4, altitude, the constants and the $0E10/$0E1A/$0E24/$0E42 tables
routines.comment: 5 Hz aerodynamics (nothing in slew, 13 cycles): trig; AoA proxy = interp($0E10) x elevator; stall lamps/horn (aoa_hi >= $21 -> $0E59 = 1, lamps $12) and stall (aoa_hi >= $24 or <= $E6 -> $0E7B = 15, $0E75 = 6, lift cut while $0E7B counts down); q = V^2; lift; normal force; drag (with the $314B carry quirks); accel; turn rate (rudder ASR 3 on the ground when moving); gamma rate (halved unless $0E75; >= 0 on the ground); V += accel (signed overflow -> $64xx, negative -> 0); gamma += rate, reflected past +/-90 deg via $32A8/$32BA. Port: Machine.aeroUpdate(), exact cycles.

routines.name: negateFlightPath
routines.comment: gamma = -gamma (16-bit). Called once and fallen into once on the negative path of $2F45 (its return then ends $2F45). 28 cycles.

routines.name: reflectFlightPath
routines.comment: If gamma_hi >= $40: gamma = $8000 - gamma (the $19D5 negate, then bit 15 flipped), and bit 7 of bank_hi and heading_hi flipped. 17 cycles, or 54 + negate16 (both including the return).

routines.name: mulQ15Times4
routines.outputs: X:A = 4 x product (16-bit, exact shifts); Y = low << 1; C = bit 6 of the product low byte
routines.comment: JSR $17EF, then the product shifted left twice. Port: Machine.mulQ15Times4(a:x:); 6 + mulQ15AX + 25/26 cycles.

routines.name: integrateFlight
routines.inputs: $34, $08CA, stale $C4, $09FE, V, $0A46, $0A12, heading, gamma trig, lift L/R, $0E76/$0E77, $09DC, $0ACA, $0A0B, $0A2F, $0A83
routines.comment: Per-pass integrator. dt = ((jiffies:stale $C4) x $0222) bits 8-23, high byte -> $7F when bit 7 set; heading += turn x dt; d = V x dt; track = (heading + $0A46 airborne) high byte; position += deltas (north/east 32-bit, altitude $5E-$60 24-bit, negative -> $000300); bank += 2 x (d x rollTerm); $F9C1 + DEC $0A83 while repositioning; view angles; falls into $3515. Port: Machine.integrateFlight(), exact cycles.

routines.name: groundContact
routines.comment: Fall-through tail of $32EE. onGround $0A12 = $FF when altitude < $000301. On the ground: bank, roll term = 0, gamma >= 0; repositioning: keySpace (brakes), no crash check; descending with VS_hi + 8 < 0 or (viewBank_hi + 10) mod 256 >= 20: crash ($0834 = 4, V_hi = 0, $CC68); first contact: $0E59 = 8, $0A11 = $FF, bump $0A2F = VS_hi. Leaving the ground with (north+1 & 3) = 0: $09D0 = sign-extended $22 (+ carry, clear). Then VS = V x sin(gamma).

routines.name: densityAndAutoLevel
routines.comment: Phase 2 (not in slew, 13 cycles): density = $7FFE - (2m + ceil(m/2)) - borrow, normally $7FFD - (2m + ceil(m/2)) with m = MSL meters. Rudder centered: bank + $FFB0 + C (positive) or + $0050 + C (negative), C = the density's carry (normally 1, so 79 or 81 units, ~0.44 deg per pass), 0 when it crosses zero. Falls into $3614. Port: Machine.densityAndAutoLevel().

routines.name: serviceCheck
routines.comment: Tail of $35BD: when $0838 is set and V_hi = 0, JSR $3638 and with $0838 = 2 ammo 100 and bombs '5'; a set request is always cleared.

routines.name: serviceAircraft
routines.comment: Refuel/repair: tanks $20, masks $FF, hits and engine failure bits 0, fuel flags 1, INC $08B8 (the war rearm is in $3614). Also vector $200F (editor $B6FB). Port: Machine.serviceAircraft(); 60 cycles.

routines.name: slewIntegrate
routines.comment: Slew (instead of $32EE): east bytes 1-3 += step(ailerons_hi), north bytes 1-3 += step(-elevator_hi), altitude $5F-$61 += sign-extended $0AC5 (negative -> 0), view pitch_hi += +/-2 x $0AC3 (inverted when (viewBank_hi + $40) < 0), flipping the view over when it leaves $C0..$40, view bank_hi += $0ABF, view heading_hi -= $0AC1; falls into $372B. Port: Machine.slewIntegrate().

routines.name: slewAux
routines.comment: Display position: settingNorth = north bytes 2-3 with $40 added to the high byte; settingEast likewise. Also vector $200C (editor $B3F6 before reading the state). Port: Machine.slewAux(); 42 cycles.

routines.name: slewRateStep
routines.comment: r >= 0: 2^(r/4) - 1 (ones shifted in); r < 0: $FFFFFF shifted left ceil(-r/4) times (-2^n). 35 + 27k or 22 + 23n cycles.

routines.name: headingReadout
routines.comment: 13 cycles when not slewing. Port: Machine.headingReadout.

routines.name: drawDgDigits
routines.sideEffects: $2197, $39, $B8/$B9, $BA/$BB, $A5-$A7, $C0-$C7; draws $219C and $21A2. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: heading = $70/$71 + $08C0 - $0848 - $0846, $8000 -> $8001, degrees by $37EA; nothing drawn when the low byte of the degrees equals $2197 (headings 256 degrees apart look the same); reciprocal = degrees - 180 via $37F5. 14 cycles disabled. Port: Machine.drawDgDigits.

routines.name: headingToDegrees
routines.comment: x 180 through $17EF, then $37F5. Port: Machine.headingToDegrees.

routines.name: wrapDegrees
routines.comment: Adds 360 when negative (the sign test leaves the carry set, so the low-byte add of $67 adds $68). 17 / 23 / 24 cycles. Port: Machine.wrapDegrees.

routines.name: format3Digits
routines.sideEffects: ($BA)+0..2 = three ASCII digits (hundreds, tens via $1DBB; ones = $B8 | '0'); $BA/$BB = field; $A5-$A7; $B8/$B9 = remainder. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Vector $2033 (war overlay). 1000 and more give a first digit past '9'. 49 cycles + two $1DBB. Port: Machine.format3Digits(field:).

routines.name: updateCompass
routines.sideEffects: $08C5 moved; $B8/$B9, $BA/$BB, $C0-$C7, $A5-$A7; draws $21A8 (in the window). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: d = $08C5 - heading + $0848 + $0846: high byte >= $0A: -1200; 0..9: -75; $F6..$FF: +75; below: +1200 (signed compares), every call. 14 cycles disabled. Port: Machine.updateCompass.

routines.name: parseFrequencyDigits
routines.comment: 74 cycles + page crossings. Port: Machine.parseFrequencyDigits(_:).

routines.name: drawNav1Frequency
routines.sideEffects: Draws $21B5; $0925/$0926 = its BCD; falls into $38D4. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Port: Machine.drawNav1Frequency.

routines.name: renewNav1Search
routines.comment: Once per 8 passes (and the tail of $38BD): NAV1 must be found again by the scenery's op 1D, so it is lost out of range. Port: Machine.renewNav1Search.

routines.name: drawNav2Frequency
routines.sideEffects: Unless the ADF is enabled: draws $21BC; $0923/$0924 = its BCD; falls into $38F5. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Port: Machine.drawNav2Frequency.

routines.name: renewNav2Search
routines.comment: Port: Machine.renewNav2Search.

routines.name: renewNavSearch
routines.comment: 20 cycles.

routines.name: drawComFrequency
routines.sideEffects: Draws $21AE; $08B3/$08B4 = its BCD; $0941 = 1; $0937 = 1. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Port: Machine.drawComFrequency.

routines.name: drawObs1
routines.comment: Reciprocal = OBS - 90 units (+180 on a borrow). Port: Machine.drawObs1.

routines.name: obsDigits
routines.comment: 36 + 9 per loop step cycles.

routines.name: drawObs2
routines.sideEffects: Unless the ADF is enabled: $21D1-$21D3, $21D7-$21D9; draws $21CF/$21D5. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Port: Machine.drawObs2.

routines.name: drawClockSeconds
routines.sideEffects: $21F5/$21F6; draws $21F3; at 0 seconds falls into $39D9. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: The 1 Hz clock tick. Port: Machine.drawClockSeconds.

routines.name: drawClock
routines.sideEffects: $21F0/$21F1 and $21EB/$21EC; draws $21EE and $21E9. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Vector $2000. The hours loop's BCS crosses a page. Port: Machine.drawClock.

routines.name: drawDme
routines.sideEffects: LSR $09AC; when a 1 shifts out: $21FA-$21FC (blanks when $09AB != 0); draws $21F8. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Phase 0: the DME readout NN.N (miles $09AE, tenths $09AD; 100 nm and more give tens past '9'). Port: Machine.drawDme.

routines.name: radioGate
routines.sideEffects: When $FE bit 7 is clear it drops its return address, so its return leaves the caller too.
routines.comment: 14 cycles open, 21 closed (the caller's JSR adds 6). Port: Machine.radioGate() (internal).

routines.name: drawTransponder
routines.comment: Port: Machine.drawTransponder.

routines.name: drawMagnetoLabel
routines.sideEffects: Draws 'HT'/'CH' ($2206/$220B) and stores $B8/$FE into the cells $7FE5-$7FE7; '1'/'O' ($21FE/$2202); the magneto label through $3A67. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Port: Machine.drawMagnetoLabel.

routines.name: drawTach
routines.comment: Digits of $09BE >> 1, then '0'/'5' from bit 0 (RPM = $09BE x 50). 14 disabled, 26 unchanged. Port: Machine.drawTach.

routines.name: updateNav1Cdi
routines.inputs: $2196 OBS1 or, for a localizer ($0933 != 0), the low byte of ($0852/$0853 x $1555 >> 15); $0922 b0; station B
routines.sideEffects: $09B5 TO/FROM, $09B0 needle target, then $3DA2. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Odd passes. Port: Machine.updateNav1Cdi.

routines.name: courseDeviation
routines.inputs: A = mask (1/2), X = station (8/0), Y = course
routines.outputs: A = 0 OFF, 1 TO, 2 FR; $B8/$B9 = deviation (3 per degree)
routines.comment: No station: $B8/$B9 = 0, A = 0 (18 cycles). Else course16 = course x 364 ($188A), d = (course16 - bearing $3C8F) x 540 >> 15 ($17EF), then $3D2B. Port: Machine.courseDeviation(mask:station:course:).

routines.name: updateNav2Cdi
routines.sideEffects: $09B6 TO/FROM, $09B2 needle target. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Odd passes. Port: Machine.updateNav2Cdi.

routines.name: drawObi1
routines.sideEffects: TO/FROM change ($09B5 vs $09B7): erase needle and bar, draw the record, redraw both; then one step of the needle $09AF toward $09B0 and of the bar $09B3 toward $09B4; then $3EFC. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: 15 cycles disabled (the BEQ crosses a page). Port: Machine.drawObi1.

routines.name: drawObi2
routines.sideEffects: TO/FROM change: erase needle, draw record $09B6 + 3, redraw; falls into $3C3F. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Port: Machine.drawObi2.

routines.name: stepNav2Needle
routines.sideEffects: One step of the NAV2 needle toward its target (erase, step, draw). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: First in the draw sequence and the tail of $3C1A (so up to two steps per pass); not gated by $FF. Port: Machine.stepNav2Needle.

routines.name: drawGlideslope
routines.sideEffects: XORs $FF into the bytes at $B8, $C0, $C8 of row 126 + A (x 184-207); $B8/$B9 = row base.
routines.comment: 11 cycles for a negative A, else 99 + page crossings (each EOR ($B8),Y crossing from the pointer before that byte's store: positions past 73 use rows beyond the tables, and a $0000 base XORs the pointer $B8 itself). Port: Machine.drawGlideslope(_:).

routines.name: glideslopeXorByte
routines.comment: Also the tail of $3C5D.

routines.name: drawToFrom
routines.sideEffects: Draws the record $2210 + 8 x A (8-bit). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Port: Machine.drawToFrom(_:).

routines.name: stationBearing
routines.outputs: $B8/$B9 = bearing station -> aircraft - $0848 - $0846; carry of the final SBC
routines.comment: Deltas of bytes 1-3 shifted left 4; normalized while both high bytes are in -16..16 (north shifts in 1s, east 0s); angle by $3E46. Port: Machine.stationBearing(station:).

routines.name: shiftLeft4
routines.comment: JSR $3D21 three times, then falls into it: 126 cycles.

routines.name: shiftLeft1
routines.comment: 27 cycles.

routines.name: classifyToFrom
routines.sideEffects: $B8/$B9 = 0 (OFF) or the deviation from the reciprocal (TO).
routines.comment: |d| < 256 (85 deg): FR; < 300 (100 deg): OFF; else TO with 540 - d / -540 - d. Port: Machine.classifyToFrom(_:_:).

routines.name: drawLocalizer2
routines.sideEffects: Unless the ADF is on: $3D73 at row 171.
routines.comment: Port: Machine.drawLocalizer2(_:).

routines.name: drawLocalizer
routines.comment: Port: Machine.drawLocalizer(_:).

routines.name: drawLocalizerNeedle
routines.sideEffects: $9C = $13, JMP $1BC3 with x = A + 180 and the shape $3B13.

routines.name: deviationNeedle
routines.comment: Port: Machine.deviationNeedle.

routines.name: updateGlideslopeAndDme
routines.sideEffects: $09B4 glideslope target (when $0850 != 0), $0850/$0851 = 0, $9E/$9F, $98; $09AB-$09AE; $09AC = 1 on a change. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: h = altitude/2 (m) vs distance (16 m): h >= distance: 18; else ((h/d Q15 - ref/2) >> 8) + 18 clamped 0..35 (above 35: 18 wrapped negative: 0), halved. DME: distance x 283 >> 15 = nm, tenths = 20 x (bits 8-14) >> 8. Port: Machine.updateGlideslopeAndDme.

routines.name: vectorAngle
routines.outputs: A/X = binary angle, clockwise from north
routines.sideEffects: The vector words are negated / swapped in place.
routines.comment: Sign handling $3E46/$3E55, first quadrant $3E6B (equal components: east + 1), arctangent $3E9F. Port: Machine.vectorAngle.

routines.name: arctanRatio
routines.comment: q = $1802; index = bits 11-14 of q; the fraction keeps bits 3-7 and 9-10 of q (bit 8 is dropped); t[i] - frac x (t[i] - t[i+1]).

routines.name: negateZeroPageWord
routines.comment: 28 cycles.

routines.name: markerBeacons
routines.sideEffects: Lamps $7E7B-$7E7D = $BB; the first flag (in that order) whose LSR shifts out a 1 lights $EB/$AB/$1B and sets $0E59 = 5/6/7. Clobbers A, X.
routines.comment: Not in war mode. Port: Machine.markerBeacons.

routines.name: stationDistance
routines.comment: Vector $2030 (also the war overlay's 3D distances). L/S = larger/smaller absolute value. Port: Machine.stationDistance.

routines.name: restoreGraphics
routines.comment: When $0E89 != $97: $D021 = $0E69, $DD00 = $96, $D011 = $3B, color RAM white. Port: Machine.restoreGraphics.

routines.name: printHexDigit
routines.comment: Prints a hex value to the text screen at column Y.

routines.name: diskErrorPrompt
routines.comment: 'DISK ERROR - PRESS A TO RETRY OR B TO IGNORE ERROR'; polls $DC00=$F5: A/G retry (reinit drive, carry set), B/Z ignore (writes $79 at ($0E8A), carry clear). Not ported.

routines.name: loaderFatal
routines.comment: NOT PORTED. Loader API: fatal error with code A.

routines.name: loaderOpen
routines.comment: NOT PORTED. Loader API: open/init (trapped by the lab).

routines.name: loaderRead
routines.comment: NOT PORTED. Loader API: read blocks with retries (trapped by the lab).

routines.name: loaderWriteBlock
routines.comment: NOT PORTED as code (loader). JMP $73B4: writes a block, per sector the 256 bytes to channel 2 (bytes 1-255 then 0, for a buffer pointer at 1) and 'U2:2 0 tt ss'. The port reproduces its memory effects for CTRL-Z: Machine.loaderWriteBlock (ModeLibrary.swift).

routines.name: loaderClose
routines.comment: NOT PORTED. Loader API: close.

routines.name: loaderDosCommand
routines.comment: NOT PORTED as code (loader). JMP $7457: sends the 20-byte command at $7343 ('N0:SUBLOGIC CORP.,FS', a full format) to channel 15, reads the status, then closes ($730F) and reopens ($7306). The port reproduces its memory effects for CTRL-Z: Machine.loaderDosCommand.

routines.name: loaderErrorHook
routines.comment: NOT PORTED. Error path into the disk-error prompt $5FAB.

routines.name: loaderTextModeHook
routines.comment: Stage-2 hook that leads to the text-mode routine $796C. Called by $2673 (vector $203F) when the editor and the error screens switch to text mode; the port calls its setTextMode directly.

routines.name: loaderFillColorRam
routines.comment: Entry used by $25EB to fill color RAM (-> $794E).

routines.name: loaderFindFirstSector
routines.comment: Loader: the first sector of block $731C: $C0/$C1 = block * 4 counts the used sectors (bits of the mask $7473, 3 bytes per track, bit 7 = sector 0) down; $BE/$BF = sector/track in BCD, $37 = the mask byte (current bit at bit 7), $39 = bits left, $3A = next mask byte. The port reproduces it exactly (memory and cycles) for the loader's memory effects. Port: Machine.loaderFindFirstSector (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/Streaming.swift).

routines.name: loaderNextSector
routines.comment: Loader: the next used sector ($C1 = 0, $C0 = 1, JMP $7510). Port: Machine.loaderNextSector (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/Streaming.swift).

routines.name: driveStatusCheck
routines.comment: A drive-status check (copy protection). Not ported.

routines.name: stage2BootEntry
routines.comment: NOT PORTED. Boot: loads stage 3, runs the drive-status check $7848 and enters the cold-start slot $A7E2.

routines.name: loaderNmi
routines.comment: RTI (disabled NMI in loader contexts).

routines.name: systemError
routines.comment: Fatal error: text screen, 'SYSTEM ERROR' with code and caller, hang. Reached via $7303 (e.g. invalid display-list opcode, A=$90).

routines.name: fillColorRam
routines.comment: Fills color RAM $D800-$DBE7 with A, stored downward through $39/$3A from $DBE7 (leaves $39/$3A = $D7FF; 14,050 cycles). Reached from $25EB through the loader hook $7331. Port: Machine.fillColorRam(_:).

routines.name: setTextMode
routines.comment: Text screen: border 8, $D018 = $16, $DD00 = $97, $D011 = $1B, $D016 = 8, $D021 = 1, sprites off, color RAM $0B ($794E), $0400-$07FF spaces. Port: Machine.setTextMode.
