routines.name: navRecordHook
routines.comment: Op 05's handler: a hook that the init code ($AA07) points at ndbHook (the NDB record); on disk it jumps to itself. ndbHook returns through the advance vector $8018 with a length of 9. The port checks the patch and calls Machine.ndbHook.

routines.name: atisHook
routines.comment: Hook that the init code points at composeAtis (called by op 1E).

routines.name: opNavRecord
routines.comment: Op 1D freq16 X32 Z32 (11 bytes): while $0921 (NAV search active): $0920 = 0; a match of the frequency with $0925 copies the 8 coordinate bytes to $092F and sets $0922 bit 0; with $0923 to $0927, bit 1 ($8055, $B8 = the slot offset, then the count). Port: Machine.opNavRecord (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryRecords.swift).

routines.name: navRecordMatch
routines.comment: Compares A:X with the record's frequency; on a match copies 8 bytes to $0927 + Y and ORs $0922 with 1 (Y = 8) or 2 (Y = 0).

routines.name: opAtisRecord
routines.comment: Op 1E len ? com16 params8 text: while $0938: $0937 = 0; when bytes 3-4 equal the COM frequency $08B3/$08B4: the 8 parameter bytes to $0939-$0940, $0958/$0959 = record + 13 (the text), $0941 = 0, the ATIS hook $802D (composeAtis after init). Then PC += len and on to $8742 (which clears $0916/$8A). Byte 2 is not read. Port: Machine.opAtisRecord (the hook $802D calls composeAtis for $F16A) (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryRecords.swift).

routines.name: copyOperandBytes
routines.comment: No caller (a native-call target candidate): copies the four display-list bytes at PC + Y + 1.. to $A5-$A8 ($39 counts down to 0).

routines.name: opLoadBlocks
routines.comment: Op 0D blk cnt rel16 slot: the five bytes to $08FB-$08FF; unless $08D9 bit 7 is set the destination becomes PC + rel16 (else it is absolute; $08D9 &= 3 afterward, so the flag is one-shot); then loadBlockCached (vector $2036). The branch at $80EF crosses a page. Port: Machine.opLoadBlocks (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryRecords.swift).

routines.name: buildViewMatrix
routines.inputs: $6C-$71 pitch/bank/heading, $0ACA view, $0836 radar, $76 (stale yaw low byte in the 8 views)
routines.outputs: $78-$89 matrix ([$78+6j+2i] = world axis j for eye axis i; x row halved, z row quartered), $72-$77 effective angles
routines.sideEffects: Temporaries $38/$39, $98/$99, $AD/$AE, $B8/$B9, $BC/$BD, $C0-$C3 (views), $CD-$D9 sines/cosines, $3F/$40, $DA, $42, $DF, $E1, $E3, $45 and $24/$27 (clobbers the ground base), plus the math routines' $A5-$A8, $BE/$BF, $C4-$C7.
routines.comment: Radar: pitch $4000, bank -heading, yaw 0. Down view: pitch high + $40, bank -heading, yaw 0. Views: with bank high + $40 negative, pitch = $8000 - pitch and bank, heading flipped; pitch' = p cos v - b sin v, bank' = b cos v + p sin v ($16AA), yaw high = heading high + v ($76 not written). Then |pitch'| >= 90 deg folds pitch' to $8000 - pitch' and flips bank'/yaw. 6 x $18C9/$18C2, 12 x $16AA, loop $8306. 4400-8300 cycles. Port: Machine.buildViewMatrix (Sources/FS2Core/Render3D/ViewMatrix.swift), cycles exact.

routines.name: computeGroundBase
routines.outputs: $24-$26, $27-$29, $2A-$2C: per axis the high word ($24/$25) and low byte ($26) of -(2·M·y) >> 8
routines.comment: Three $836A terms. Negated unless M and y differ in sign (tested before |M| is formed). About 2450-2750 cycles. Port: Machine.computeGroundBase.

routines.name: groundBaseTerm
routines.comment: Sign of ($C5 ^ $69) saved; |M| x y by $188A; $C9-$CB shifted left one bit (24-bit); negated unless the signs differ.

routines.name: horizonPass
routines.comment: Vector $8003. $35/$36 = PC (this also invalidates op 07/24's y cache), the line call at $8B89 disabled (no drawing), $EC = $FF, PC = $0AD0 + (((yaw high $77 + $20) >> 2) & $F0), $66/$67 and $6A/$6B saved in $02-$05 and zeroed with the base high words $24/$25, $27/$28, $2A/$2B (not $26, $29, $2C), the interpreter $8742; then the eye words, the line call at $8B89 and the PC restored (not the base), falling into $840F. Port: Machine.horizonPass (then the renderer's horizonFill) (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/HorizonPass.swift).

routines.name: horizonFill
routines.inputs: $EB-$EE horizon endpoints ($EC bit 7: no horizon), $0880/$0882 fill selectors, $73 effective pitch high
routines.outputs: Window rows 0-$6F filled; $0890 = $8458 (or 0 with no horizon), $845A-$845D = the endpoints
routines.sideEffects: $EF/$F0 fill bytes (possibly swapped), $F1/$F2 row range, $E9, $F3, $18/$19, $93, $F4, $F5, $AF, $B4, $8E/$8F, the filler's planted bytes and the Bresenham's patched steps.
routines.comment: Fill bytes: $0882 0/$FF else $AA (below), $0880 0/$FF else $55 (above). No horizon: rows $6F-0 with $EF, swapped when $73 < 0. Otherwise $F1/$F2 = the endpoints' row range ($844B), swaps by which window edges the endpoints lie on (x = 0, $9F; y = 0), rows above whole ($8504), the crossed rows by $8623, the rows below whole unless $F2 = $6F. 41,150 cycles with no horizon, 41,500-61,000 with one. Port: Machine.horizonFill (Sources/FS2Core/Render3D/Horizon.swift), the RTS of $83A4 included.

routines.name: horizonRowRange
routines.comment: Widens the row range to include A: $F1 = A when A < $F1, $F2 = A when A >= $F2.

routines.name: horizonColorSwap
routines.comment: 18 cycles. Port: Machine.horizonColorSwap.

routines.name: fillWholeRows
routines.sideEffects: Rows $E9 down to $E9 - $F3 + 1 filled through $851B; $8E/$8F = last row base + $100. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Per row: row pointer from $02C8/$0200, JSR $851B (all 40 columns). 366 cycles per row, 367 from row $38. Port: Machine.fillWholeRows.

routines.name: unrolledRowFill
routines.inputs: A = pattern, $8E/$8F = row base; entry at a column's LDY
routines.sideEffects: Stores through ($8E) for the columns run; $8F incremented at $859B when passing column 31.
routines.comment: Forty unrolled column stores of A through ($8E) with Y = 8k, the row base's high byte $8F incremented after column 31, then Y = 0 and a return at $85BD. Callers plant a return opcode: $9910 on a column's store ($851D+offset), $85C0 on a column's index load ($851B+offset), and enter at a column's index load. Port (raster unit): Machine.unrolledRowFill(entry:stop:pattern:y:) runs entry up to the planted return at stop; the caller writes the planted byte.

routines.name: horizonSplitRow
routines.inputs: X = boundary x (0-159), $E9 row, $EF left pattern, $F0 right pattern
routines.sideEffects: $8E/$8F row pointer, $F5 = planted offset, $851B+$F5 = $60 then $A0, JSR operand $85FC/$85FD, $B4 = x, $AF.
routines.comment: A return planted on the index load of column (x+4)>>2 (offset (x+4) & $FC, +2 from column 32); $851B runs with $EF up to it; the load restored and the filler re-entered there with $F0. Unless x & 3 = 3 the byte at $14DA[x] is rebuilt: $F0 shifted right 2 bits per pixel 0..x&3 with $EF's low bits rotated in. x > 159 would plant past the filler. Port: Machine.horizonSplitRow (also used by horizonBresenham).

routines.name: horizonBresenham
routines.inputs: $EB-$EE endpoints; whatever $85C0 holds (the split row, or JMP $A4CA from the attitude indicator)
routines.sideEffects: $18/$19 |dx|/|dy|, $93 = 0, $F4 error, $E9 last row, the step opcodes at $8678/$868C (x up or down) and $8679/$869A ($E9 up or down). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Calls $85C0 with X = x1 on row y1, then: dy >= dx: count = error = dy; per step error -= dx, on borrow error += dy and x steps; the row steps and $85C0 runs. Else count = dx, error = dx - dy; per step x steps, error -= dy, on borrow error += dx, the row steps and $85C0 runs (only then). Port: Machine.horizonBresenham (reads $85C0 to dispatch to horizonSplitRow or aiSpan).

routines.name: runScenery
routines.comment: Vector $8006. Copies the search requests to the per-pass flags ($0920 -> $0921, $0937 -> $0938, $08BD -> $08BE), then falls into $8742. Also entered (JSR) by the runway op for its template. Port: Machine.runScenery (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryVM.swift).

routines.name: dlInterpreter
routines.comment: Clears $0916 and $8A (the line driver's clip flags), then $8749 with A = 0 (11 cycles) and the loop. Entered by the horizon pass ($83EF) and by op 1E ($80CE). Port: Machine.dlInterpreter (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryVM.swift).

routines.name: dlAdvance
routines.comment: PC += A (11 or 15 cycles), then falls into $8752. Handlers end by passing their length here; also vector $8018. Port: Machine.dlAdvance (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryVM.swift).

routines.name: dlLoop
routines.comment: Per opcode: the poll (vector $2012, pollTick), then the opcode at PC; $46 and above: END ($0938/$0921/$08BE = 0, return). Otherwise the handler address $86A4[2 op] to $A5/$A6 (+2 cycles from op $2E, the page crossings) and an indirect jump through it with Y = 0, X = 2 op. 59 cycles per opcode (61 from $2E) with the poll and the call, 57 for END. Calls (ops 18/09/0A, the runway) recurse into it; op 19 and END return. Port: Machine.dlLoop (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryVM.swift).

routines.name: dlInvalidOpcode
routines.comment: The handler of the 30 unused opcodes: the loader's fatal SYSTEM ERROR ($7303 with A = $90). The port throws Scenery.Fault.invalidOpcode instead of the text screen.

routines.name: opCall
routines.comment: Op 18 rel16: pushes PC + 3, $0904 + 1, PC = PC + rel16, a nested $8752 loop; then $0904 - 1, PC = the pushed value, on to $8752. Port: Machine.opCall (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryVM.swift).

routines.name: opCallIndirect
routines.comment: Op 09 abs16: like op 18, but PC = the word at abs16 ($A5/$A6 = abs16); a zero word is skipped. '09 90 08' draws the horizon line list through $0890. Port: Machine.opCallIndirect (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryVM.swift).

routines.name: opCallNative
routines.comment: Op 0A abs16: calls native code at the address stored in the word at abs16 (the JSR at $880B with its operand $880C/$880D patched), entered with A = low | high byte of that address, X = $14, Y = 1; a zero word is skipped. No scenery data on the disk uses it. Port: Machine.opCallNative and nativeCall (ported targets by address; any other target would need the development bridge, which only tests install; no list on the disk reaches it) (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryVM.swift).

routines.name: opReturn
routines.comment: Op 19: RTS (returns from the current interpreter invocation; END also clears the search flags, 19 does not).

routines.name: opBeginPolygon
routines.comment: Op 2F: $23 = $FF (polygon open), $B7 = 0; falls into $8823 (advance 1). Port: Machine.opBeginPolygon (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryGeometry.swift).

routines.name: opNop
routines.comment: Op 11 (and the tail of op 2F): advances 1 byte through $8749.

routines.name: opEndPolygon
routines.comment: Op 29. In a polygon: unless $D5 is negative (every vertex z behind the eye) or $B7 - 1 is negative, $8FE8 (clip, project, fill) with $B7 = count - 1; $23 = 0; advance 1. Outside a polygon: the closing line: B = the saved start point $08-$10, PC += 1, on to $8B40. Port: Machine.opEndPolygon (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryGeometry.swift).

routines.name: dlStep
routines.comment: PC += A, return: 17 or 21 cycles. Used by the handlers and by the point transforms ($A240 with 7, $A1B6 with 5). Port: Machine.dlStep (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryVM.swift).

routines.name: dlPointB
routines.comment: Calls the transform at the self-modified operand $8863/$8864 ($9FD0 ground or $A1CE 3D) with Y = $D6. In a polygon: appended at $B7 unless $B7 >= 60 ($3C), $D5 &= z high byte. Else: outcode ($941B), projected ($9D21) when 0. Port: Machine.dlPointB (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryGeometry.swift).

routines.name: dlPointBVisible
routines.comment: The outcode of point B, projected when 0 (also called by the dashed line).

routines.name: dlPointA
routines.comment: Calls the transform at $88A4/$88A5 with Y = $CD. In a polygon: appended at $B7 (no 60-vertex check), $D5 = z high byte. Else $88D1. Port: Machine.dlPointA (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryGeometry.swift).

routines.name: dlPointAVisible
routines.comment: The outcode of point A, projected when 0, and A ($CC-$D4) copied to $08-$10 (the start of the path).

routines.name: opMove3D
routines.comment: Op 01 x y z: 3D moveto (point A, transform $A1CE, PC += 7).

routines.name: opMoveGround
routines.comment: Op 40 x z: ground moveto (point A, transform $9FD0, y = 0, PC += 5).

routines.name: opLine3D
routines.comment: Op 02 x y z: 3D lineto (point B, PC += 7), then the line driver $8B40 unless a polygon is open.

routines.name: opLineGround
routines.comment: Op 41 x z: ground lineto (point B, PC += 5), then $8B40 unless a polygon is open. The BNE at $8912 to $88F9 crosses a page (4 cycles).

routines.name: opCacheMove
routines.comment: Op 32 i: moveto cache entry i: A = the entry (outcode = byte 6 when byte 7 is negative), copied to $08-$10; in a polygon the entry is appended ($8976).

routines.name: opCacheLine
routines.comment: Op 33 i: lineto cache entry i: B = the entry, then $8B40; in a polygon the entry is appended.

routines.name: dlCacheToPolygon
routines.comment: Appends cache entry $2D to the polygon arrays at $B7 (no 60-vertex check), $D5 &= its z high byte. 92 cycles.

routines.name: opCachePoint3D
routines.comment: Op 31 i x y z: transforms a 3D point as point B ($8860, B saved in $DE-$E6 and restored, $DD = $FF first) and stores x, y, z and (screen x, y) or (outcode, $FF) in entry i.

routines.name: opCachePointGround
routines.comment: Op 42 i x z: as op 31 with the ground transform.

routines.name: vertexCacheEntry
routines.comment: $2D/$2E = $0400 + 8 * (the index byte at PC + Y + 1), PC += 1 ($89E7 takes the index in A). Port: Machine.vertexCacheEntry / vertexCacheSetEntry (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryGeometry.swift).

routines.name: opCacheDot
routines.comment: Op 35 i: a dot at cache entry i (A = the entry, plotted when its outcode is 0).

routines.name: opPoint3D
routines.comment: Op 00 x y z: a 3D dot: point A transformed ($88A1), then when $CC = 0 projected again and plotted (JSR $99FD with the screen x, y).

routines.name: opDashedLine
routines.comment: Op 2B x1 z1 x2 z2: both points through the ground transform (A, then with the PC stepped back by one, B); nothing when their outcodes share a bit; the exponents reconciled (the larger one's point halved by $8B2A, its exponent decremented); delta = (B - A) >> 4 in $9E-$A3; with the jump at $8BAC turned into a return, $0AA2 = 8 times: B = A + delta, $8B40, A += delta; then $8BAC restored. Eight 1/16 dashes with equal gaps. The branch at $8B20 crosses a page. Port: Machine.opDashedLine (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryGeometry.swift).

routines.name: halvePoint
routines.comment: Halves the three words at zero page X (each shifted right with its sign kept; zp,X wraps). 60 cycles with the return. Used by the dashed line and the clip planes ($96C9). Port: Machine.halvePoint (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryGeometry.swift).

routines.name: lineClipDriver
routines.comment: Line A -> B: rejected when $CC & $D5; A clipped by $9464 ($0916 + 1), B (saved to $DE-$E4) by $9478 ($8A + 1); re-projected; $EB-$EE = the screen points; the line call at $8B89 (disabled by the horizon pass: endpoints only). Then B becomes the current point A (the unclipped copy when B was clipped), $8A = $0916 = 0, and on to $8752 through the jump at $8BAC (a return while the dashed line runs). Port: Machine.lineClipDriver (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryGeometry.swift).

routines.name: opScreenLine
routines.comment: Op 06 x1 y1 x2 y2: a screen line with the current pen (no clipping): the bytes to $EB-$EE, then $9A1D.

routines.name: opOriginHigh
routines.comment: Op 24 s Xhi Yhi Zhi: as op 07 with the origin at whole high words: the eye's low words go to $3F/$40, $42/$43, $45/$46 unchanged ($AD = $FF) and only the high words are subtracted. Port: Machine.opOriginHigh (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryOrigin.swift).

routines.name: opOrigin
routines.comment: Op 07 s X32 Y32 Z32: eye - origin in 32 bits ($3F/$40:$66/$67 x, $42/$43:$68/$69 y (radar: from $0888-$088B), $45/$46:$6A/$6B z), then 16 bits by s - 2 ($8C9C): s 0 (and 1, and $82-$FF) bits 0-15, 2 bits 4-19, 4 bits 8-23, 6 bits 12-27, any other value bits 16-31. y = 0 becomes 1; a y different from $35/$36 recomputes the ground base ($8324). Port: Machine.opOrigin (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryOrigin.swift).

routines.name: originBody
routines.comment: The subtractions, the scale selection and the y update of ops 07/24 (entered with X = s, $AD = 0 or $FF).

routines.name: opJump
routines.comment: Op 0B rel16: PC += rel16 (relative to the opcode).

routines.name: dlRelativeTarget
routines.comment: $A5/$A6 = PC + the rel16 at PC + Y + 1 (Y += 2). 34 cycles + page crossings, with the RTS.

routines.name: opCopyWord
routines.comment: Op 1A dst16 src16: [dst] = [src] (two bytes through ($A5),Y / ($A7),Y; the pointers are read again for the second byte; $B5 = 4).

routines.name: opStoreWord
routines.comment: Op 25 dst16 v16: [dst] = v (two indirect stores through $A7/$A8; $B5 = 4).

routines.name: opCull
routines.comment: Op 04 rel16 i1 i2 ... term: $DE = $F8; per index (until a byte with bit 7 set) a valid cache entry (byte 7 positive) clears $DE, an invalid one ANDs its outcode (byte 6) in; then PC moves past the terminator and jumps when $DE != 0. Port: Machine.opCull (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryConditions.swift).

routines.name: opRangeJump
routines.comment: Op 13 rel16 R z x: $8E74 jumps when |z - $64/$65| > R or |x - $5C/$5D| > R; else PC += 9. Port: Machine.opRangeJump (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryConditions.swift).

routines.name: opRangeAltitudeJump
routines.comment: Op 14 rel16 R z x: op 13's box, then inside it also jumps when the altitude high word ($60/$61; radar $088A/$088B) - R is not negative.

routines.name: rangeBoxTest
routines.comment: $A5/$A6 = target, $98/$99 = R, $8EA1 for z ($8EA6/$8EAD patched to $64/$65) and x ($5C/$5D), then PC += 9. A failing $8EA1 pops both return addresses (PLA x 4, $8ECC) and jumps.

routines.name: rangeAxisTest
routines.comment: d = the word at PC + Y + 1 - the eye word ($AB/$AC); out when R - d (d >= 0) or R + d (d < 0) has bit 15 set (the sign of the high byte, no overflow correction).

routines.name: opBoxJump1
routines.comment: Op 20 rel16 addr lo hi: jumps unless lo <= [addr] <= hi (signed, overflow-correct: N != V). 9 bytes.

routines.name: opBoxJump2
routines.comment: Op 21 rel16, 2 x (addr lo hi): every triple must hold. 15 bytes.

routines.name: opBoxJump3
routines.comment: Op 22 rel16, 3 x (addr lo hi). 21 bytes.

routines.name: variableRangeTest
routines.comment: One (addr, lo, hi) triple: $8E/$8F = addr (then + 1), the low byte of [addr] patched into the immediate subtract at $8F31; a failure drops one return address ($8F41) and jumps.

routines.name: opBitTestJump
routines.comment: Op 23 rel16 addr16 mask16: jumps when [addr] & mask = 0 (the high bytes tested first; $8E/$8F = addr, $A9 = mask low, $B5 = 6).

routines.name: opCompareJump
routines.comment: Op 28 type rel16 a16 b16: type 0 jumps when [a] = [b], type 2 when [a] >= [b], any other type when [a] < [b] (signed, overflow-correct). The rel16 is at bytes 2-3, relative to the opcode. $A9 = type, $AB/$AC = a, $AD/$AE = b, $B5 = 7.

routines.name: clipPolygon
routines.inputs: $B7 = vertex count - 1, vertices in $0B10-$0C8F (x/y/z lo/hi arrays of 64)
routines.outputs: $B7 = vertices left after a pass (0: nothing drawn), then the polygon filled ($96D4)
routines.sideEffects: $0C90-$0E0F copies, $B6, $B2/$B3, $CD-$DB (points of the clipped edges), the plane routines' $A9/$AA, $C4-$C7, $A7/$A8; $96D4's state.
routines.comment: Four Sutherland-Hodgman passes: x = z (to $0C90), y = z (back), x = -z, y = -z, then on to $96D4. Each pass closes the polygon at index n and walks n-1 down to 0 (8-bit, until negative); inside = sign clear of z - x / z - y / x + z / y + z; on a change the edge (B = vertex i, A = vertex i + 1) is clipped and the point appended unless its z = 0 (its z high byte is stored either way); an inside vertex is appended after. The first flag reads index 0 (absolute), equal to index n after the closing copies. Indices are unbounded: a pass writes up to 1.5 times its input (193 from 129) past index 63 into the next arrays and past $0E0F up to $0E91; a pass of 130+ vertices handles only its last one (the 8-bit index goes negative at once; 129 start at index $80 and walk them all). Never reached by scenery polygons; see render3d.md, Overflow. Port: Machine.clipPolygon (Sources/FS2Core/Render3D/Polygon.swift).

routines.name: computeOutcodeA
routines.comment: $80 z < 0, $40 x + z < 0, $20 z - x < 0, $10 y + z < 0, $08 z - y < 0 (signs of 16-bit sums, overflow ignored). 85-104 cycles. Port: Machine.computeOutcodeA (Sources/FS2Core/Render3D/Clip.swift).

routines.name: computeOutcodeB
routines.comment: As $93D2 for point B. Port: Machine.computeOutcodeB.

routines.name: clipLine
routines.comment: Swaps the endpoints ($946A), clips the far point ($9478), then falls into $946A to swap them back. Port: Machine.clipLine.

routines.name: swapClipEndpoints
routines.comment: 7 bytes (outcode and point), 154 cycles. Port: Machine.swapClipEndpoints.

routines.name: clipLineEnd
routines.outputs: Point B moved onto the planes, $D5 recomputed
routines.comment: Planes in the order $40 (x = -z, $9644), $20 (x = z, $95C6), $10 (y = -z, $953E), $08 (y = z, $94C0, ending in $941B); after each, the outcode is recomputed and the routine returns when ($D5 AND $CC) != 0. Port: Machine.clipLineEnd.

routines.name: clipPlaneYPos
routines.outputs: B on y = z: xB += t(xA - xB), zB += t(zA - zB), yB = zB
routines.comment: t = $1802((zB - yB) / ((yA - yB) - (zA - zB))). When the denominator's subtraction overflows, both points are halved ($96C9) and the routine starts over. Port: Machine.clipPlaneYPos.

routines.name: clipPlaneYNeg
routines.outputs: B on y = -z: xB += t(xA - xB), zB += t(zA - zB), yB = -zB
routines.comment: t = (zB + yB) / ((yB - yA) - (zA - zB)). Port: Machine.clipPlaneYNeg.

routines.name: clipPlaneXPos
routines.outputs: B on x = z: zB += t(zA - zB), xB = zB, yB += t(yA - yB)
routines.comment: t = (zB - xB) / ((xA - xB) - (zA - zB)). Port: Machine.clipPlaneXPos.

routines.name: clipPlaneXNeg
routines.outputs: B on x = -z: yB += t(yA - yB), zB += t(zA - zB), xB = -zB
routines.comment: t = (zB + xB) / ((xB - xA) - (zA - zB)). Port: Machine.clipPlaneXNeg.

routines.name: halveClipPoints
routines.comment: JSR $8B2A with X = $CD and X = $D6 (the scenery unit's point halving). Port: private Machine.halveClipPoints (calls halvePoint twice).

routines.name: projectAndFillPolygon
routines.inputs: Y = vertex count, vertices in $0B10-$0C8F, $0876 color
routines.sideEffects: Projected x/y in $0CD0/$0D50 ($0CCF/$0D4F and [n], [n+1] close the loop), edge tables $0B10-$0C8F, $B7, $F1/$F2, $B3, $B2, $B4, $1C, $1D, $C8/$C9, $F6-$FB, $AF, $02+ crossings, $98AD, the span routines' state.
routines.comment: Y = 0 or 129+ returns (Y - 1 negative). Projection by $9F94 per vertex (row range $F1/$F2), edge setup $9748, span color $9C93, scan loop $986E. Port: Machine.projectAndFillPolygon.

routines.name: polygonEdgeSetup
routines.inputs: X = edge, Y = vertex (from 0), projected vertices
routines.comment: Sloped edge Y -> Y+1: $0B10 top row, $0B50 rows (- 1 when the polygon goes on downward or level past the edge's lower vertex, flagged in $0B90), $0BD0 top x, $0C10/$0C50 signed 8.8 slope (|dx|·256 / rows by the division at $97C3, divisor high byte $F9). $0B90 is never cleared after the flag and doubles as the x fraction, starting at 0 or 1. Equal y: a horizontal run over the following equal-row vertices, $0B50 = $FF, $0BD0 = max x, $0C50 = max - min; a run at a top of the polygon (both neighbors below it: the compare with y[Y-1] leaves the carry clear and the next vertex is lower) is dropped (the indices not advanced, its slot reused). Loop until the index compared with $B7 gives a positive difference.

routines.name: polygonEdgeSlope
routines.comment: Sign saved; |dx|; $F6/$F7 = |dx|·256, 16 shift-subtract steps by $F8/$F9; $0B50,X - 1 when $0B90,X != 0; sign restored; slope negated for dx < 0.

routines.name: polygonScanLoop
routines.sideEffects: Crossings at $02+ through the self-modified STA operand $98AD; $1D; $C8/$C9 += crossings - 1.
routines.comment: Per row: edges $1C..0 on this row: horizontal runs spanned ($9996), sloped edges deposit their x and step (x += slope with the fraction carry, rows - 1, row + 1 while rows >= 0). Crossings bubble-sorted descending (the compare is indexed from $0002, so Y = $FE/$FF reads $0100/$0101) and spanned in pairs from $1D down by 2. One crossing (n = 0) makes the sort run 256 passes over $0002-$0101 and scrambles the zero page (degenerate polygons only); 129+ crossings skip the sort and the spans (a negative count). With overflowing polygons: 27+ crossings on a row reach $1C (read by the next row), $1D and $1E; garbage crossings past x = 159 send long spans past the row filler's end (render3d.md, Overflow).

routines.name: longSpan
routines.inputs: $F3 = length-1 (>= $18), $1E = right x, $8E/$8F = row base, $1A = pattern
routines.sideEffects: Writes the row; $AF = left x advanced to the byte boundary; $9B = saved $8F (restored to $8F); $F5 = planted-return offset; the call operand $996B/$996C; $851D+$F5 = a return opcode, then the store restored. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Long span: left partial byte through the patched ops at $992A ($AF counts x up to the boundary, +$100 to $8F at x = 128), whole bytes by a call into $851B + ($AF & $FC) (+2 from column 32) with a return planted on the store of x's column, right partial byte through $9986 (stored whole when x & 3 = 3). Port: Machine.longSpan (Sources/FS2Core/Raster/Span.swift).

routines.name: span
routines.inputs: A = length-1, $1E = right x (inclusive), $8E/$8F = row base from the row tables, $1A = pattern, span ops patched by $9C9C
routines.outputs: $F3 = 0 for a short span (A < $18); a long span leaves $F3 = A
routines.sideEffects: Short spans walk a copy of the pointer in $9A/$9B (+$100 when x >= 128); $8E/$8F unchanged. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Fills A+1 pixels leftward from x = $1E: partial bytes pixel by pixel through the patched ops at $99BC, whole bytes with $1A. A >= $18 (25+ pixels) jumps to $9910. Port: Machine.span; cycles exact (pixel cost includes the LDA (zp),Y page-cross cycle).

routines.name: plot
routines.outputs: A = byte stored, X = x & 3, Y = $14DA[x] (drawLine saves X/Y to $B2/$B3)
routines.sideEffects: $8E/$8F = row base (+$100 when x >= 128); one pixel through the ops at $9A14/$9A17.
routines.comment: Plots (X, Y) with the plot-site pen, which the dotted patch never touches (the first pixel of a dotted line is always drawn). Port: Machine.plot.

routines.name: drawLine
routines.sideEffects: Swaps the endpoints in memory so $EB is the larger x; $18 = |dx|, $19 = |dy|, $B2/$B3 = start pixel index/byte offset, $F3 = 0, $F4 = final error, $8E/$8F = last pixel's row pointer, $AF (dotted mode only). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Multicolor Bresenham from the right endpoint (plotted first via $99FD): count $F3 = major, error $F4 = major >> 1; each step error -= minor, on borrow error += major and the minor axis steps. dx = dy = 0 plots one pixel. dy >= dx is y-major. Loops $9A7C/$9ABD (y-major, rows up/down), $9AFE/$9B3F (x-major up/down). Row steps change only $8E/$8F: down $8E + 1, then +$138 when ($8E & [$1B]) = 0; up -$138 when ($8E & [$1B]) = 0, then $8E - 1 (both without carry into $8F on the single steps). x steps: pixel index wraps 0 -> 3 with Y -= 8 ($8F - 1 on borrow). Port: Machine.drawLine; cycles exact.

routines.name: dottedPlot
routines.inputs: A = byte after op1, X = pixel index, ($8E),Y = target, $F3 = steps remaining
routines.comment: Op2 of the four line loops in dotted mode (JSR planted by $9B9B). When ($F3 & 3) = 0 applies the op at $9B8D (patched by $9BF5) to the saved byte; otherwise re-reads the target byte, so the pixel stays unchanged. Port: the dotted case of PixelWriter (Sources/FS2Core/Raster/RasterPen.swift).

routines.name: opPen3
routines.comment: Display-list op $1B: pen 3, then JMP $8749 with A = 1. Port: Machine.opPen3 returns the length.

routines.name: opDottedPen
routines.sideEffects: When $083C bit 0 is clear: $9BF5 with pen 1, then op2 of the four line loops ($9AB3, $9AF4, $9B35, $9B76) becomes JSR $9B80.
routines.comment: Display-list op $1C: dotted lines at dusk and night (pixels where $F3 & 3 = 0). Any later $9BF5 rewrites op2 and cancels it. Port: Machine.opDottedPen.

routines.name: opPen
routines.inputs: Y = 0, display-list PC $8B/$8C (operand byte n at +1)
routines.sideEffects: As $9BF5 with pen $9BD6[n] (n is not masked).
routines.comment: Display-list op $12 n: pen = colorMap[n]. Port: Machine.opPen.

routines.name: setPen
routines.sideEffects: Patches op1 ($9A14, $9AB0, $9AF1, $9B32, $9B73) and op2 ($9A17, $9AB3, $9AF4, $9B35, $9B76, $9B8D) with operands. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: op1 sets bits from $157A,X if A & [$0F00], else masks with $1582,X; op2 sets bits from $157E,X if A & [$0F01], else masks with $1586,X; with bit 7 both ops flip bits instead, the operands chosen the same way (the pixel is XORed with mask1 ^ mask2: $80 and $83 both XOR it with 11; $81/$82 flip the byte's other three pixels). Port: Machine.setPen writes the same bytes; drawing derives its pen from them (Machine.sitePen).

routines.name: setSpanColorFromPalette
routines.comment: Span color from the scenery color; falls into $9C9C. Port: Machine.setSpanColorFromPalette.

routines.name: setSpanColor
routines.sideEffects: $1A = $158A[X]; patches op1/op2 at $99BC/$99BF, $992A/$992D, $9986/$9989 with operands. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: op1 sets bits from $157A,X or masks with $1582,X by X & [$0F00], op2 sets bits from $157E,X or masks with $1586,X by X & [$0F01]; never flips. Until the first call the span sites hold the disk operands (op2 masks with $1583,X). Port: Machine.setSpanColor.

routines.name: projectPointA
routines.comment: 190-820 cycles. Port: Machine.projectPointA (Sources/FS2Core/Render3D/Projection.swift).

routines.name: projectPointB
routines.comment: Port: Machine.projectPointB.

routines.name: projectionDivide
routines.inputs: A:Y numerator (A high), $C6/$C7 z, table operand $9E89/$9E8A
routines.outputs: A = table[q] (complemented for a negative numerator), X = q, Y = $A6
routines.sideEffects: $A5 quotient bits, $A6 = numerator high byte (0 or $FF for n = z / -z).
routines.comment: n = z or -z: q = $7F. Else 8 unrolled steps R = 2R -/+ z (subtract after R >= 0, add after R < 0; bit 15 of 2R lost), each step's carry rotated into $A5 by the next (the first gets the sign); q = $A5 bits 6-0 (inverted for negative n). The add chain's last step falls into the fifth subtract step when it ends negative with carry set (overflow only). Port: Machine.projectionDivide.

routines.name: project
routines.outputs: A = sx, X = q(x), Y = sy
routines.comment: sy = $37 - TY[q] (y >= 0) or $38 + TY[q]; sx = $50 + TX[q] or $4F - TX[q]. Port: Machine.project.

routines.name: transformGround
routines.inputs: Y = destination ($CD/$D6), ($8B)+1..4 = x, z words, $66/$6A eye-relative origin, $24-$2C base, matrix $79/$7B/$7D/$85/$87/$89 (high bytes)
routines.outputs: Three eye-space words at Y, $2F exponent ($0905 = previous), display-list PC + 5
routines.comment: Block floating point (see render3d.md): overflow halves d and the base high words (exponent - 1); else d and base shift left while all < $4000 (exponent + 1; all zero would never stop); 2 x $196D high-byte products per axis with an extension byte; renormalize 3/2/1/0 times. Ends by advancing 5 bytes through $8851. 1300-2000 cycles. Port: Machine.transformGround (Sources/FS2Core/Render3D/GroundTransform.swift; the tail is dlStep(5)).

routines.name: groundNormalize
routines.outputs: Shifted left until one is >= $4000 in magnitude; $2F incremented per shift
routines.comment: Checks $9F, $A3, $40, $43, $46 (high byte + $40 negative); the 24-bit bases shift as $40:$3F:$41. Leaves the carry clear.

routines.name: renormalizeGround
routines.outputs: Each $41:$40:$3F (etc.) >> 1 with LSR of the extension byte; $2F - 1
routines.comment: 56 cycles. Port: Machine.renormalizeGround.

routines.name: transform3D
routines.inputs: Y = destination ($CD/$D6), ($8B)+1..6 = x, y, z words, $66-$6B eye-relative origin, matrix $78-$89
routines.outputs: Three eye-space words at Y, display-list PC + 7
routines.sideEffects: $E7, $9E-$A3 differences, $A9-$AC products, $2F = 0, $30 overflow count, the math routines' state.
routines.comment: d = P - origin; any overflow halves all three (true 17-bit values); |d| >= $4000 halves all again. PC += 7 by $8851. Per axis $16AA, $16AA, $16C9 summed ($A332); any sum >= $4000 in magnitude halves all three results. 3400-4200 cycles. Port: Machine.transform3D (Sources/FS2Core/Render3D/Transform.swift; the step is dlStep(7)).

routines.name: transformAccumulate
routines.sideEffects: $30 incremented when the high byte + $40 is negative.
routines.comment: 62 or 66 cycles.

routines.name: drawAttitudeIndicator
routines.inputs: $6D pitch high, $6F bank high, $A354/$A355 last drawn
routines.sideEffects: $A354/$A355, $98, $AD, $8A, $B7, $E9, $EB-$EE, $85C0-$85C2 patched and restored, the span color sites, the Bresenham's state.
routines.comment: Returns (34 cycles) unless a high byte moved outside -2..+1 of the last drawn. Background (X = 0 pitch >= 0, else 3) on all 32 rows; for |pitch| < 45 deg the chord ends at angles bank - off and (bank ^ $80) + off (off = $A356[(pitch + $20) / 2]): x = $29 + hi(mul8Half(cos_hi, $12)), y = $88 + (sin_hi >> 3); $8A = sign side; spans per row through $8623 with $85C0 = JMP $A4CA; then the rows outside the chord. 4800-10400 cycles. Port: Machine.drawAttitudeIndicator (Sources/FS2Core/Render3D/AttitudeIndicator.swift).

routines.name: aiFillRows
routines.comment: Row offsets $40, $48, $50, $58, $60. Port: Machine.aiFillRows.

routines.name: aiSpan
routines.comment: $8A = 0: span x..$33, else $20..x. Reached by the JMP $A4CA planted over $85C0. Port: Machine.aiSpan.

routines.name: drawTurnCoordinator
routines.comment: Index = ((rate << 1) high byte) + 8, negative -> 0, >= $10 (signed compare) -> 15. Unchanged: 41 cycles; else the old wings XORed away and the new drawn (about 3400-3700 cycles). Port: Machine.drawTurnCoordinator (Sources/FS2Core/Render3D/TurnCoordinator.swift).

routines.name: turnCoordinatorHelper
routines.sideEffects: The wings of state A XORed in.
routines.comment: The cold start draws state 8. Port: Machine.turnCoordinatorHelper.

routines.name: opRunway
routines.comment: Op 03 hdg8 len16 wid16: theta = $40 - (hdg + $0849 + $0847, high bytes) ($F4); c = cos8 ($A9/$AA), s = sin8 ($C0/$C1); L = len ($39/$3A), W = wid ($9A/$9B); L s ($3F/$40), L c ($42/$43), W s ($45/$46), W c ($A9/$AA) by $16C9; corners V1 = (Lc - Ws, Wc + Ls), V2 = (Lc + Ws, Ls - Wc), V3 = -V1, V4 = -V2 and the centerline (Lc, Ls)-(-Lc, -Ls) patched into the template $A5A7, which runs as a nested pass (JSR $8730: the search requests are copied again) with $0876 = $0877 = 0; PC restored, advance 6. Half-extents: the runway is 2L x 2W. Port: Machine.opRunway (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/Runway.swift).

routines.name: opJumpAbsolute
routines.comment: No opcode table entry: a handler-style absolute jump that reads the two bytes after the opcode into $A5/$A6 and continues at $8DA8 (PC = $A5/$A6, then $8752). As an op 0A target (Y = 1) it reads the op's high byte and the next byte. Port: Machine.opJumpAbsolute (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/SceneryVM.swift).

routines.name: slotColdInit
routines.comment: Overlay slot 0 (cold init; enters coldInit in the stage-3 image). Every overlay has the same five slots.

routines.name: slotEditor
routines.comment: Overlay slot 1 (editor); the main loop calls it when $08BA|$08BB.

routines.name: slotWar
routines.comment: Overlay slot 2 (war); called every pass in Europe 1917.

routines.name: slotFlight
routines.comment: Overlay slot 3 (flight); called every pass, returns at once when resident.

routines.name: slotDatabaseInfo
routines.comment: Overlay slot 4 (database info); called when $0E87.

routines.name: soundTick
routines.comment: 1 Hz effect state machine (first 10 Hz tick after the CIA1 TOD seconds change, suspended while $08CC): if $08D3==0 write 0 to $D404/$D40B/$D412/$2309/$0E5E and return ($0E5C is not shifted); $0E5C shifted right, return when a 1 comes out; else $CC00[2*$0E59] copied into the jump operand $CC44 and the jump taken. Port: Machine.soundTick(); 34 / 22 / 42 cycles plus the handler.

routines.name: sfxStallHorn
routines.comment: State 1: V3 sawtooth, only $D40F=$18 written (low byte left over), AD 0, SR $A0, pattern $FF; exits to state 9 (re-armed at 5 Hz by $2F45).

routines.name: sfxGun
routines.comment: State 3: V3 noise $1770, AD 0, SR $90, period 2, pattern $55 (15 bursts/s), $0E60=$81, $0E5C=1; no direct $D412 write (the pattern player gates it). Quirk: CMP $0E5A compares the pattern $55 with the period just set to 2 (probably meant $0E5E), so $2309/$0E5E are always reloaded.

routines.name: sfxBombRelease
routines.comment: State 4 (called directly): $0E7D/$0E7E = $4A38 (no SID frequency write here; the sweep's first write is $4948), V3 AD 0, SR $60, $0E5E=$2309=$FF, $0E60=$D412=$21, $0E59=10; ends with its own RTS (no skip delay).

routines.name: sfxOuterMarker
routines.comment: State 5: 400 Hz ($19A1), pattern $55, period 15.

routines.name: sfxMiddleMarker
routines.comment: State 6: 1300 Hz ($534B), pattern $27 (dash-dot), period 5.

routines.name: sfxInnerMarker
routines.comment: State 7: 3000 Hz ($C037), AD $20, SR $62, pattern $55, period 5.

routines.name: sfxTouchdown
routines.comment: State 8: V3 noise ($D40F=$FF only, AD $44) + V2 saw ($D408=$FF only, AD $72, retrigger), $D417=$81, $0E5C=3.

routines.name: sfxExit
routines.comment: Common effect exit: $0E59=9.

routines.name: sfxReset
routines.comment: State 9: $D404=$D40B=0, $0E59=0, INC $09BE (forces the engine frequency rewrite), falls into $CE07.

routines.name: sfxIdle
routines.comment: State 0: V1/V2 gate on ($21), $D412=0, filter $D417=$83, $D416=$70, $D418=$1B (LP, vol 11), $0E5A=$28, SR $B2 on all voices.

routines.name: sfxBombWait
routines.comment: State 10: returns until the whistle high byte $0E7E < $30 (unsigned, so a sweep that already wrapped to $FFxx never explodes). Explosion: $0E7E=$FF (sweep off), V3 noise $0380, AD $2D, SR 0, $D417=$77, $D418=$1F, $D416=$80, $D412=$80 then $81, pattern $FF, $0E5C=3, exit to state 9.

routines.name: altimeterUpdate
routines.inputs: $FD bit 3, $5F/$60 altitude, $0A87 field elevation, $09CE altimeter offset
routines.sideEffects: $0A8A/$0A8B = $5F/$60, $0830 = MSL altitude, $C4-$C7 and the multiply's scratch, $A5/$A6 = steps mod 880, $20 short hand, $1F long hand, then JMP $1A0B. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Every pass. steps = mulQ15(MSL + offset, $24F4) (88 per 1000 ft); reduced by subtracting 880 while the result stays >= 0 (negative products are kept); short = 21 - mulQ15(steps, $0CCC), long = 21 - (steps mod 88), each +88 when negative and capped at 87. Port: Machine.altimeterUpdate.

routines.name: airspeedUpdate
routines.sideEffects: $B8 = $14C2[i], $0A84 = target; mul8Half scratch. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Every pass. v = min(V_hi, $5A), i = v >> 2, f = ((v << 1) | bit 7 of V_lo) & 7; target = t[i] + high byte of mul8Half(x: f x 16, y: t[i+1] - t[i], carry 0), i.e. only half the table step. Cycles: 13 disabled, else 91 (92 when clamped) + mul8Half. Port: Machine.airspeedUpdate.

routines.name: vsiUpdate
routines.sideEffects: $21 = target. Y = ($0A50 << 1) | carry in. Clobbers A, Y.
routines.comment: Odd passes. h = V/S high byte clamped to -9..9; a = (h << 2) | (clamp-compare carry << 1) | bit 6 of V/S low (CPY #$80 on the shifted low byte, not bit 7); target = ($83 - a) mod 88. Port: Machine.vsiUpdate.

routines.name: slipBallUpdate
routines.sideEffects: Then JMP $1C3D with the position. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Even passes. Input: slip hi airborne; 0 at standstill on the ground, else -rudder hi. Position = clamp(((input + $7F) >> 2) - $1F, -8, 8) + 9 (9 and up give 8). Port: Machine.slipBallUpdate.

routines.name: engineSoundSlew
routines.comment: E=$09BE slews toward T=$0E58 by 2 (8-bit wrap kept); down: T if E-2 < T or E-2 >= $F0 (E >= $F2 snaps to T); up: T if E+2 >= T. Returns without SID writes when E == T. V1 = (E>>1)*16 built in $0E52, V2 = 2*V1+1 built in $0E54. Port: Machine.engineSoundSlew(); 17 or 114-119 cycles.

routines.name: setSceneryRoot
routines.comment: $8B/$8C = [$A7E0] (the root list at the overlay's end; $A800 in flight). The rest ($E56F-$E58C) belongs to the drive-status check (copy protection): not ported; its pass-through path (7 cycles) is charged as plain time. Port: Machine.setSceneryRoot (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/Streaming.swift).

routines.name: loadBlockCached
routines.comment: Vector $2036 (op 0D). Unless $0900[slot] = blk (21 cycles): $0900[slot] = blk, the higher slots zeroed, $9E = blk, $9F = cnt, $731E/$731F = destination, JSR $E63C. Port: Machine.loadBlockCached (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/Streaming.swift).

routines.name: loadOverlayColdStart
routines.comment: Vector $2015: the pair at $E559 (blocks 2-4) through $E5F6. Port: Machine.loadOverlay(.coldStart) (Sources/FS2Core/Game/Overlays.swift).

routines.name: loadOverlayEditor
routines.comment: Vector $2018: with $08BC = 1 on to $E6DB (the cached editor swapped in, no root reload); else the pair at $E55B (blocks 42-47) through $E5F6. Port: Machine.loadOverlay(.editor) (Sources/FS2Core/Game/Overlays.swift).

routines.name: loadOverlayWar
routines.comment: Vector $201B: the pair at $E55D (blocks 158-160). Port: Machine.loadOverlay(.war) (Sources/FS2Core/Game/Overlays.swift).

routines.name: loadOverlayFlight
routines.comment: Vector $201E: the pair at $E55F (block 65). Port: Machine.loadOverlay(.flight) (Sources/FS2Core/Game/Overlays.swift).

routines.name: loadOverlayDatabaseInfo
routines.comment: Vector $2021: the pair at $E561 (block 64). Port: Machine.loadOverlay(.databaseInfo) (Sources/FS2Core/Game/Overlays.swift).

routines.name: loadOverlay
routines.comment: A = first block, X = count: $9E/$9F, $731E/$731F = $A7E0, $E63C; for the editor's pair (first block = [$E55B]) $E6D8 (copy to the $D000 cache) unless $08BC = 2; falls into $E618. Port: Machine.loadOverlay(first:count:) (Sources/FS2Core/Game/Overlays.swift).

routines.name: loadRootBlock
routines.comment: $0900-$0903 = 0; $9E/$9F = the pair at $E563 (block 66, 1 block); $731E/$731F = [$A7E0]; falls into $E63C. With the editor resident ($BC6B) the loader's guard drops the root block's bytes from $C000. Port: Machine.loadRootBlock (Sources/FS2Core/Game/Overlays.swift).

routines.name: readBlocks
routines.comment: Reads $9F blocks from $9E to [$731E]: $0E8A/$0E8B = destination, $0E8C/$0E8D = $9E/$9F, $731C = $9E; $D015 saved and 0; $08DA = $7327 = 1; interrupts masked; $D018 = $F0, $D016 = $D8; loader open ($7306); per block $0E88 + 1 and $D020 = $0E88, read ($7309), $9F - 1; loader close ($730F); interrupts enabled; $08DA = $7327 = 0; $D015 restored. Every loader call is followed by $732B (on to $5FAB: the disk-error prompt when carry is set; retries at $E6A6). The port copies from Machine.diskBlocks and reproduces the loader's memory effects (Scenery.Loader) and its measured time: open 58,650, per sector 382,690 (+/- the guard's skipped bytes) plus the exact walk of the sector mask, close 37,260 cycles. Port: Machine.readBlocks (Sources/FS2Core/Scenery/Streaming.swift).

routines.name: cacheHelper
routines.comment: Vector $2039 (after the editor's own block I/O): closes the channels ($730F); on error the fatal path $E6C4 (not ported); returns. Port: Machine.cacheHelper (Sources/FS2Core/Game/Overlays.swift).

routines.name: swapEditorCacheIn
routines.comment: Enters $E6DC with the carry clear: copies $A7E0-$BCDF to $D000-$E4FF ($01 = $30 during, then $01 = $4B; interrupts masked). Port: Machine.swapEditorCacheIn (Sources/FS2Core/Game/Overlays.swift).

routines.name: swapEditorCache
routines.comment: SEC: exchanges $A7E0-$BCDF with $D000-$E4FF (21 pages, Y = 0, $FF .. 1; the BNEs back to $E6F5 cross a page). Port: Machine.swapEditorCache (Sources/FS2Core/Game/Overlays.swift).

routines.name: atisTeletypeJump
routines.comment: JMP $F239 (main loop, every flip pass). Port: Machine.atisTeletypeJump(); 3 cycles + $F239.

routines.name: windDrift
routines.comment: Airborne: east -= $09D3, north -= $09D5 (32-bit, sign through $A5). Port: Machine.windDrift(); 13 cycles on the ground, else 116-118.

routines.name: windLayer
routines.comment: Phase 0. Record: >= shear3 $0994, >= shear2 $0998, >= shear1 $099C, else surface $09A0 ($09D7 + 1). dir = rec[3] + $0847 (+ $0849 when bit 0 of $09D7, shifted out, is set); drift east/north = $1961(dt_hi, $196D(rec[0], sin/cos8(dir)_hi)_hi) with the carries chained. Port: Machine.windLayer().

routines.name: updateAdf
routines.sideEffects: First call draws the face ($E936); needle (gauge 4) redrawn when it moves, then $E860. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Odd passes. Needle = $57 - (relative bearing + 90 deg)/2 x 88 >> 15. Uses the carry $3C8F leaves (the subtract does not set the carry first). Port: Machine.updateAdf.

routines.name: drawAdfBearing
routines.sideEffects: $C4/$C5, $B8/$B9 = degrees, $E932-$E934; draws $E930. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: The relative bearing to the NDB in degrees inside the ADF face. Port: Machine.drawAdfBearing.

routines.name: drawAdfPanel
routines.comment: Port: Machine.drawAdfPanel.

routines.name: ndbHook
routines.sideEffects: $08BD = 0; on a match station A = (0, X24, 0, Z24), $E7F3 = 1.
routines.comment: Op 05 through the hook $802A (patched at init). Ends by advancing 9 bytes through the vector $8018 (the interpreter's advance). Port: Machine.ndbHook (returns 9 to the interpreter).

routines.name: selectAdfDigit
routines.sideEffects: JMP $2BBC with $0D, or $FC + 1 when repeated quickly within $0D-$0F.
routines.comment: A, CTRL-A, left SHIFT. Port: Machine.selectAdfDigit (tail JMP $2BBC: storeSelected).

routines.name: tuneDecrementPre
routines.sideEffects: ADF digit - 1 ('0' -> '9') via $EA2B; mixture + 1 (up to 7) via $1C23.
routines.comment: Port: Machine.tuneDecrementPre.

routines.name: tuneIncrementPre
routines.sideEffects: ADF digit + 1 ('9' -> '0') via $EA2B; mixture - 1 (down to 0) via $1C23.
routines.comment: The ADF-off BEQ crosses a page. Port: Machine.tuneIncrementPre.

routines.name: renewAdfSearch
routines.comment: Once per 8 passes and after a tune. Port: Machine.renewAdfSearch.

routines.name: realityFailures
routines.comment: Phase 3. Not reality: zero $09CE/$09CF and $08C0/$08C1 (33 cycles). Reality: when DEC $08CD goes negative (reload 10), (north+1 + east+1 + C) < 100 and >= reliability triggers $EB1B. Altimeter drift with the quirky compare h = $09CF - $09D0 (low byte!): +2 if h < 0, -2 if h | $09CE != 0. DG +2. Port: Machine.realityFailures(carry:).

routines.name: trimCreep
routines.comment: 1 Hz tick, even TOD seconds, reality mode: elevator_hi moves 2 toward the trim (signed compare through V), then the elevator indicator ($2D58) is refreshed even when equal. 15 cycles outside reality mode. Port: Machine.trimCreep().

routines.name: clearRealityDrift
routines.comment: Jump target of $EA84 outside reality mode: zeroes the altimeter and DG offsets. 24 cycles including the return.

routines.name: triggerFailure
routines.sideEffects: $1EAF clear window, $1DDE 'AIRCRAFT PROBLEM !!!!' ($EA6C), $BC/$BD = handler, then the handler
routines.comment: Handler index = ($22 + $5F + C) & $0E into $EA5C; jumps through $BC/$BD. The handler's return returns to $EAA6.

routines.name: failureHandler0
routines.comment: Clears bit 0 of $0942.

routines.name: failureHandler1
routines.comment: Sets bits 0-1 of $09BF (engine).

routines.name: failureHandler2
routines.comment: Clears bit 2 of $0942.

routines.name: failureHandler3
routines.comment: Clears bit 3 of $0942.

routines.name: failureHandler4
routines.comment: Sets bits 2-3 of $09BF (fuel leak).

routines.name: failureHandler5
routines.comment: Clears bit 5 of $0942.

routines.name: failureHandler6
routines.comment: Clears bit 6 of $0942.

routines.name: failureHandler7
routines.comment: Clears bit 7 of $0942.

routines.name: drawSlewReadout
routines.sideEffects: Prints both settings via $1D54 into $EB63/$EB73 (drawn in the window).
routines.comment: Port: Machine.drawSlewReadout.

routines.name: updateLightingMasks
routines.sideEffects: $0945-$0947 = $08DC-$08DE by day or with the lights on; $10/$80/$01 at dusk or night with the lights off.
routines.comment: Port: Machine.updateLightingMasks.

routines.name: selectTimeOfDay
routines.comment: Before T1 night, T2 dusk, T3 day, T4 dusk, else night; minutes always from the season-0 row. Port: Machine.selectTimeOfDay.

routines.name: applyPalette
routines.sideEffects: $083C = A; on a change $22B5 = border and $EC7C with the screen byte; $0884 = 1 << (season - 1).
routines.comment: Season 0 runs the $0884 loop 256 times (leaves 0). Port: Machine.applyPalette(_:).

routines.name: fillWindowColors
routines.comment: 7884 cycles. Port: Machine.fillWindowColors(_:).

routines.name: drawViewOverlay
routines.sideEffects: $BA/$BB, the airframe state and span state.
routines.comment: Radar: the $ED1F pixel list ORed in; down view + Europe 1917: the $ECE1 list; else the airframe of entry $0ACA·4 ($40 for the down view). Port: Machine.drawViewOverlay (Sources/FS2Core/Render3D/ViewOverlay.swift).

routines.name: drawAirframe
routines.comment: Color 9 via $801E; zero width returns; per row a span through $801B, then the 8.8 steps of x and width. The loop branch crosses a page (4 cycles). Port: Machine.drawAirframe.

routines.name: engineModel
routines.comment: Even phases. Stop: reality mode (not war) with mixture 7 or both magneto/fuel pairs 0, or the selected tank empty. Start: automatic outside reality; windmill restart V_hi >= $25; starter (label 4) busy-waits 586,756 cycles then $2837 X=3 (BOTH). Throttle: 0 stopped, carb heat -8/-$20 (floor 0), cap $10 with failure bits 0-1, -4 (floor 0) with a dead pair. Target $0E58 = $EE17[thr>>2]; thrust = ((target < $0E ? 0 : target):0 x $07D0) x density; target = $BC unless $BC - target is negative (N); outside reality >= $0D. Oil temp +/-$19/256 toward 0/9/18, pressure +/-$FA/256 toward 0/10. Fuel when $22 bit 1: burn = $1961(-5 or -40 in war, throttle) into $A5/$A6; leaks; 24-bit tank amounts (a non-negative burn high byte returns before the right tank). Port: Machine.engineModel(), exact cycles.

routines.name: stopEngine
routines.comment: engineRunning = 0. 12 cycles with the RTS.

routines.name: composeAtis
routines.inputs: $0985 season, $093C+season, $095F, $09A0-$09A3 surface wind, $0983 hours, $0854 Zulu offset, $0856/$0857 cloud base (m), $0939-$093C runways by quadrant
routines.comment: Writes the live values into the phrase strings: temperature $093C[season] + $095F (tens/units); wind direction ($09A2/$09A3 x 360) >> 16 and speed $09A0 (leading '0' as ' '); Zulu hour hours + $0854 (minus 24 once when >= 24); ceiling ($0856/$0857 x 2150) >> 16 hundreds of feet ($F133 = 0 drops the phrase when 0; leading zeros as ' '); runway $0939[$09A3 >> 6]. Reached from op 1E through the hook $802D (patched to point here). Port: Machine.composeAtis(); about 2,800-3,500 cycles (2,778 at the Meigs match; the no-ceiling branch at $F1E8 crosses a page).

routines.name: atisFormatByte
routines.outputs: Y = hundreds, A = tens, X = units (ASCII)
routines.comment: LDX #0, then $F223. Port: private Machine.atisFormat(byteEntry: true); 36 + $3804 cycles.

routines.name: atisFormatWord
routines.outputs: Y = hundreds, A = tens, X = units (ASCII)
routines.comment: Formats A:X as three digits at $F21E through format3Digits $3804, then loads them into Y/A/X. Port: private Machine.atisFormat(byteEntry: false); 34 + $3804 cycles.

routines.name: atisTeletype
routines.sideEffects: $0941 = 1, window bitmap, $B8-$BD, $C0-$C3 and the glyph scratch; ends in busyDelay(4). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Once per tune: returns at once (13 cycles) when $0941 is set; else sets it, clears the window and types the text at $0958 from (x 3, row 3) as one-character records at $BA-$BD (row, x, char, 0): a character = drawTextRecord + (256 - $096A) mod 256 passes of 606 cycles (0 = 256) + x += 4; a space = the next cell ($F2C5); tokens $80-$8C = ' ' + phrase $F087+[$EFFA+n] + a cell. Lines break only at cells (x >= $64: row += 8, x = 3), pages at row >= $5A (clearWindow). Then LDY #4 and the fall-through into $F25B (1,826,849 cycles). Port: Machine.atisTeletype(), delays charged one pass at a time.

routines.name: busyDelay
routines.comment: Pure delay: three nested countdown loops (Y outer, then two from $FF): Y x 456,711 + 5 cycles with the return (Y = 4 at the ATIS end: 1,826,849; Y = 5 for the crash message: 2,283,560). Port: Machine.busyDelay(y:), charged one X pass (1,791 cycles) at a time.

routines.name: atisTypeText
routines.comment: Types bytes from the cursor until a 0 (RTS $F278); the token path recurses through $F275. $F29D tests the restored cursor's high byte, so a text in zero page falls into the character path with A = 0 after a token. Port: private Machine.atisTypeText().

routines.name: atisTypeByte
routines.comment: Entry of $F26B with the byte in A: the token path calls it with A = ' ' so a phrase starts with a space cell, then the phrase's bytes follow until its 0. Port: atisTypeText(entry:).

routines.name: atisNextCell
routines.comment: x < $64: x += 4 ($F2DE, 24 cycles). Else row += 8 (ADC #7 with the compare's carry) and x = 3 (34), or a new page when that row is >= $5A: clearWindow, row 3 (41 + $1EAF). Port: private Machine.atisNextCell().

routines.name: atisAdvanceColumn
routines.comment: x += 4 (16 cycles). Port: private Machine.atisAdvanceColumn().

routines.name: updateInstrumentMasks
routines.sideEffects: For each mask that changed: $9E = new, $A0 = old, store, $F3B3 over its area table. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Every pass, after the gauge drivers. 60 cycles with no change. Port: Machine.updateInstrumentMasks.

routines.name: applyMaskChanges
routines.inputs: A/X = area table, $9E = new mask, $A0 = old mask
routines.sideEffects: $BE/$BF = table (+6 per bit), $A2 = bits left; per bit $B8 = old bit, $B9 = new bit, $BA/$BB = entry, $F3F0; $9E/$A0 shifted right 8 times. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Bits in order 0-7. Port: Machine.applyMaskChanges.

routines.name: toggleInstrumentArea
routines.inputs: $B8 = old bit, $B9 = new bit, ($BA) = 6-byte area entry
routines.sideEffects: $F3E6-$F3EF, $BC/$BD save buffer, $BA/$BB, $A5, $A7; the panel area and its save buffer. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Equal bits: nothing. 1 -> 0 (failure): walks the area row by row, left to right; each pixel's bit is read and cleared ($F493) and pushed into the buffer ($F4E0); then the last byte is shifted so its first bit is bit 7. 0 -> 1 (repair): each pixel XORs in the next popped bit ($F502, $F4A9). Restoring rotates the buffer bytes to $80 (the first to $00). Port: Machine.toggleInstrumentArea.

routines.name: clearAreaBit
routines.inputs: X = x low, Y = row, $A5 = x bit 8
routines.outputs: A = the pixel's bit (0/1), also in $A7

routines.name: restoreAreaBit
routines.inputs: A = bit, X = x low, Y = row, $A5 = x bit 8
routines.sideEffects: XORs the bit into the pixel (a 0 stores the byte back); $BA/$BB.

routines.name: bitmapBitAddress
routines.inputs: X = x low, Y = row, $A5 = x bit 8
routines.comment: 43 cycles (+1 for rows >= 56). Port: Machine.bitmapBitAddress.

routines.name: pushSavedBit
routines.comment: Port: Machine.pushSavedBit.

routines.name: popSavedBit
routines.outputs: A = bit 7 of the buffer byte
routines.sideEffects: $F3EF += 1 (at 9: 1 and $BC/$BD += 1); ($BC) = ($BC) << 1 | carry of the CMP #9 (1 on a new byte).
routines.comment: Port: Machine.popSavedBit.

routines.name: coursePlotterMenu
routines.sideEffects: Window; per key below. Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: COURSE PLOTTER SYSTEM menu: each round clearWindow, drawTextList($F522), JSR $2250 (wait for a key); A $F649 and C $F671 start a recording, B $F654 displays, D $F666 turns it off (each JMPs back to $F627), E returns, other keys redraw. Port: Machine.coursePlotterMenu() (the key wait is waitForKey $2250).

routines.name: plotterRecord
routines.comment: A: begin normal recording (scale 6, interval 10). 13 cycles to $F67A. Port: plotterStartRecording(normal: true).

routines.name: plotterDisplayKey
routines.comment: B: display the plot when a recording exists. 13 or 21 cycles. Port: private Machine.plotterDisplayKey().

routines.name: plotterOffKey
routines.comment: D: plotter off; $08BC = 0 (the editor is reloaded from disk next time). 13 cycles. Port: private Machine.plotterOff().

routines.name: plotterPrecisionKey
routines.comment: C: begin precision recording (scale 4, interval 2). 10 cycles to $F67A. Port: plotterStartRecording(normal: false).

routines.name: plotterStartRecording
routines.comment: Writes the list header at $D000 with I/O banked out and points $0E83 at the end marker; JMP $F627. 20 + 17 + 371 + 14 + 3 cycles. Port: private Machine.plotterStartRecording(normal:).

routines.name: plotterDisplay
routines.sideEffects: Mode 1: $0E81, the list at $0E83, $B9/$BE/$BF, $BA/$BB, $01/$4B. Mode 2: $8B/$8C = $D000 and the scenery interpreter's effects.
routines.comment: Every main-loop pass: mode 0 returns (12 cycles), 3+ returns (21), 1 records ($F703; the BEQ at $F6EA crosses a page), 2 runs the list at $D000 through $8006 between the bank switches ($F6F1). Port: Machine.plotterDisplay() (the list runs through runScenery $8730).

routines.name: plotterDrawList
routines.comment: Mode 2: $8B/$8C = $D000, then $F7B0, the scenery vector $8006 and $F7B4. Part of Machine.plotterDisplay().

routines.name: plotterRecordStep
routines.sideEffects: $0E81; with room: a 7-byte lineto (02 dx dy dz) + $79 at the pointer, $0E83/$0E84 += 7, $B9/$BE/$BF, $BA/$BB, $01/$4B
routines.comment: DEC $0E81; at 0 reload it from $0E80 and, while $DFE0 - pointer is not negative (16-bit sign: pointers $5FE1-$DFE0; 578 points from $D016), append a point: bytes 1-3 of each coordinate minus the origin's, >> 4 unless the scale is 4, low 16 bits. 14 / 39 / 40 + 17 + 26 + 3 x (38 + $F7BB + 22) + 34 + 14 + 6 cycles. Port: private Machine.plotterRecordStep().

routines.name: bankOutIo
routines.comment: I/O and ROMs out ($D000 is RAM). 17 cycles. Port: Machine.bankOutIo() (stores kept; the port's $D000 is always RAM).

routines.name: bankInIo
routines.comment: I/O back in. 14 cycles. Port: Machine.bankInIo().

routines.name: plotterScaleDelta
routines.comment: 15 cycles at scale 4, else 74. Port: private Machine.plotterScaleDelta().

routines.name: draw10kMarker
routines.sideEffects: When the index changes: erases the old shape (unless $F7DB is negative), $F7DB = index, draws the new one ($F89E). Clobbers A, X, Y.
routines.comment: Main-loop phase 1. index = min(8, (($60 + 2) & $FF) / 6), one step per 1536 m. Port: Machine.draw10kMarker.

routines.name: draw10kMarkerShape
routines.comment: Also the fall-through end of $F86F. 22 cycles + $1BC3.

routines.name: trackGroundElevation
routines.comment: Every pass. V_hi < $0A: field = target. Then $F8C5 twice: field +/-1 toward the target (unsigned compare), altitude meters the other way, floor 3 m. Port: Machine.trackGroundElevation().

routines.name: stepFieldElevation
routines.comment: One 1 m step of $F8AF (JSR'd, then fallen into).

routines.name: maneuverRegimeTimer
routines.comment: Even phases: DEC $0E75 unless it would go negative; then reload 6 when (gamma_hi + $0F) >= $1E (gamma_hi in $0F..$F0: >= 15 or <= -16), (bank_hi + $16) >= $2C (>= 22 or <= -23) or (V_hi + $49) >= $92 (V_hi >= $49). Port: Machine.maneuverRegimeTimer().

routines.name: crashMessage
routines.comment: Flip passes with $0834 set: 'SPLASH !!!' for A = 8, else 'CRASH !!!'; $0E59 = 2, $CC68, $0834 = 0, $1EAF, $1DDE at (50, 20), $F25B with Y = 5 (~2.3 s), $08BB = 1. Port: Machine.crashMessage(code:).

routines.name: splashDetect
routines.comment: Even phases: on the ground, window byte $50DE = $55 (water), front view, not radar, not repositioning for 3 consecutive checks -> $0834 = 8; otherwise $0E7F = 3. Reads the rendered bitmap. Port: Machine.splashDetect().

routines.name: setAltitudeFromEditor
routines.comment: meters = (($096F + 9) x $4E0C) bits 16-31 - field elevation, at least 3; $5E = $61 = 0. Also vector $2006 (editor $B5A0). Port: Machine.setAltitudeFromEditor().

routines.name: coldInit
routines.comment: Cold init chain: stack $3F, interrupts masked, $D015 = 0, $7306 (loader open), $A988 boot loads, $AAF7 (stub, not ported), $E6D2, $ABB0; at $A970 (where the lab and the port blank the non-original title and disk-error bytes) $AAFA, $AAF9 (stub), $AA1C (title and prompts), $AA91, $AA07, $AB66, $AB88, then the main loop entry $2048. Port: Machine.coldInit(); Machine.coldStart() = the slot $A7E2, the chain and the main loop (Sources/FS2Core/Game/ColdStart.swift).

routines.name: bootLoads
routines.comment: The five boot loads of the table $A800 ($0A x 16 to $0200, $06 x 4 to $5000, $1A x 12 to $77E0, $26 x 4 to $C000, $96 x 8 to $E000): $731E/$731F = destination, $731C = block, $A4 = count; per block JSR $7309 and the border = $731C. Port: Machine.bootLoads() (the loader's read as loaderRead: its memory effects).

routines.name: patchRadioHooks
routines.comment: Patches the renderer table's hooks: $802E/$802F = $F16A (ATIS composer, op 1E), $802B/$802C = $E956 (NDB hook, op 05). Port: Machine.patchRadioHooks().

routines.name: titleScreen
routines.comment: Clears the window, draws the title list $A80C (the two non-original records are blank), waits for A or B ($2250): A the color palette ($0E61 = $65, $0E63 = $6C, $0E65 = $EA, $0E69 = $0B), B black and white ($FC/$CB/$CB/$00); both $0E62/$0E64/$0E66 = $0E/$06/$00, $083C = 0, $EBF2; falls into $AA71. Port: Machine.titleScreen().

routines.name: modePromptScreen
routines.comment: Clears the window, draws 'SELECT OPERATING MODE' ($A8F4), waits for A (INC $095B: demo) or B; $08BA = 0. Port: Machine.modePromptScreen().

routines.name: initPanelState
routines.sideEffects: $08CF, the indicator states $0A93-$0A9E, $0F62-$0F65, $0A91, the panel bitmap, SID
routines.comment: $08CF = 1; draws the panel indicators at their starting values through the second halves of their routines: $1A20 (altimeter hands at $20/$1F), $1A5C (airspeed needle at the value in $21), $1A82 (VSI at 0), $8027 (turn coordinator 8), $1B9A elevator $0A, $1BB4 ailerons $0F, $1BD5 rudder $0F, $1BE9 throttle 0, $1C05 flaps 0, $1C18 trim 5, $1C2B mixture 0, $1C4B slip ball 0, $1C6F/$1C89 fuel 0, $1CB8/$1CD1 oil 0; then $3923, $3976, $2240, $3A71, $AB58. Port: Machine.initPanelState().

routines.name: protectionStubCarry
routines.comment: NOT PORTED. Stub that returns with the carry clear (probably copy protection).

routines.name: protectionStubReturn
routines.comment: NOT PORTED. Stub that returns at once (probably copy protection).

routines.name: interruptAndTimingSetup
routines.comment: $AB78; $089B-$089E = $80; $25EB; NMI vector $FFFA/$FFFB = $2700; $DC0E = $DC0F = 0, TOD tenths = 0; $A5/$A6 = 0; with interrupts masked, waits for two TOD tenth edges and counts loop passes during the next tenth into $A5/$A6; interrupts enabled again; a count >= $1ABD sets $DC0E = $80 (PAL 50 Hz TOD; the physics constants are not patched). Port: Machine.interruptAndTimingSetup(): NTSC only, it waits the time on the virtual TOD and stores the lab's NTSC count $18CB (MainLoop.ntscCalibrationCount).

routines.name: sidInit
routines.comment: Writes 0 to $D418 down to $D400, then $CDF9 (reset + idle). Port: Machine.sidInit(); 349 cycles in all.

routines.name: copyPanelRow
routines.comment: Copies $5180-$52BF to $7180-$72BF (panel row 14 into bitmap B, so the split line 112 shows the panel whichever bitmap is displayed). Port: Machine.copyPanelRow().

routines.name: maskInterrupts
routines.comment: SEI; $DC0D = $DD0D = $1F (CIA interrupt sources off); both ICRs read. Port: Machine.maskInterrupts().

routines.name: initUserLibrary
routines.comment: Fills the 15 user-mode records (65 bytes from [$0961] = $C800, pointer $BA/$BB) with their numbers $0A-$18. Port: Machine.initUserLibrary().

routines.name: copyZeroPage
routines.comment: Copies $AC02-$ACFF to $02-$FF. Port: Machine.copyZeroPage().

routines.name: editorEntry
routines.inputs: $08BB mode request (1 reload, 2 save, other nonzero: demo mode 2), $0963
routines.sideEffects: everything the conversions and the page drawing touch
routines.comment: stateToRecord, the text screen ($203F), page 0 ($B114); a mode request is served without keys and exits; else the field loop $B0C5: editorKeys, an edited field is accepted ($B371; on the USER MODE line the cursor stays), E exits (JMP $B559), '-' and RETURN move the cursor. Port: Machine.editorEntry (Sources/FS2Core/Modes/Editor.swift).

routines.name: cursorNextLine
routines.comment: RETURN: erase the arrow, move the cursor one screen LINE down ($094D += 2; 21 stops per page, lines 1-21, including blank and heading lines); past line 21 switch pages (page 0 <-> 1, $B803/$B3C0 redraw) and start at line 1; draw the arrow (screen codes $40 $40 $3E). Lab: re/sessions/editor.txt.

routines.name: editorFirstPage
routines.comment: Entry inside cursorNextLine: LDA #0, then page 0 drawn ($B803) and printed ($B3C0), the arrow on line 1. Port: Machine.editorFirstPage.

routines.name: drawCursorArrow
routines.comment: Tail of the cursor moves: $094D = A, the arrow $40 $40 $3E at column 26. Port: Machine.drawCursorArrow.

routines.name: cursorPreviousLine
routines.comment: '-': move the cursor one line up; from line 1 go to line 21 of the other page (from page 0 to page 1). Lab: the radios and failures sessions reach page 1, line 21 (ADF ENABLE) with one '-'.

routines.name: eraseCursor
routines.comment: Writes three spaces over the arrow at column 26 of the cursor line.

routines.name: fieldLinePointer
routines.comment: Looks the cursor line up in the screen line table $AFD4.

routines.name: editorKeys
routines.comment: Starts a field and reads keys ($2003) until RETURN, '-' (sets $0949) or E (increments $0948), which parse the digits ($B29B). '+' ($B7C3) and S ($B7A5) start over; CTRL-X ($B1F1) and CTRL-Z ($B223) keep reading; DEL takes back a digit; digits echo in reverse video. Port: Machine.editorKeys.

routines.name: fieldInput
routines.comment: The key loop of editorKeys: JSR $2003, then the compare chain $0D, $2D, $45, $08, $2B, $53, $18, $1A, digits. Port: inside Machine.editorKeys.

routines.name: libraryLoad
routines.sideEffects: [$0961]..+1023, the loader variables, the record, screen
routines.comment: CTRL-X: with interrupts masked: open, read block 64 to [$0961], reload mode $0963 and reprint (cursor line kept in $A9), close ($2039), interrupts enabled. An open or read error copies the disk-error line $0E8E to row 24 ($B216; no close). Port: the library goes through Machine.modeLibraryIO.load (ModeLibrary.swift).

routines.name: librarySave
routines.comment: CTRL-Z: with interrupts masked: open, DOS 'N0:SUBLOGIC CORP.,FS' ($7312: formats the disk in the drive, closes and reopens), write [$0961]..+1023 as block 64 ($730C), close ($2039), interrupts enabled; errors as $B1F1. Port: Machine.modeLibraryIO.formatAndSave.

routines.name: fieldKeyEntry
routines.comment: Tail of the editor key chain (reached from $B225 when the key is not CTRL+Z): the keys '0'-'9' are shifted into $0952-$0957 (at most 6) and echoed in reverse video; anything else returns to fieldInput.

routines.name: setLibraryBlock
routines.comment: Points the loader at the user-mode library: buffer [$0961] ($C800), block $40 (64). Used by CTRL+X (load) and CTRL+Z (format and save); lab: re/sessions/library.txt.

routines.name: parseFieldValue
routines.comment: Decimal to 24-bit binary by repeated addition of the powers of ten at $B006.

routines.name: printFieldValue
routines.comment: Prints a field value as up to 6 decimal places at column 31 of the line, leading zeros suppressed (repeated subtraction of the powers of ten at $B006).

routines.name: copyEditorPage
routines.comment: Copies a 1000-byte page image to the text screen $0400. Port: Machine.copyEditorPage.

routines.name: acceptField
routines.comment: After an edited field: every field of the page read back from the screen ($B813); then USER MODE: >= 210 or the current mode: nothing; 110+: save to n - 100 if below $0960 ($B98D); else load n if below $0960 ($B998); refused entries get the current mode back. Page reprinted ($B3C0), $094D restored. Port: Machine.acceptField.

routines.name: printPageFields
routines.comment: Prints every field of the page from the record: per descriptor ($B01C list) the size, $B7D2, the 1-2 record bytes into $094A, $B2D6. Port: Machine.printPageFields.

routines.name: stateToRecord
routines.comment: State -> record: $200C (north/east), altitude ((m + field elevation) x $D1EB) >> 14 - 9 ft, heading/bank/pitch x 360 >> 16, airspeed x $0200 >> 16, controls + $7FFF, $0ACD/$0ACE kept unless demo, winds $B865 (Y = 0), shears x $0348 >> 8. Port: Machine.stateToRecord (EditorConversions.swift).

routines.name: recordToState
routines.comment: Record -> state (the exit): EUROPE 1917 forces mode 7 ($09A5 = $0963 = $0E7C = 7), $2042 bitmap display, $2000 clock, the conversions back, $0ACF hook, reality mode with throttle low 0: magnetos OFF (X = FLAPS high byte as the label), $095A = $095B, war counters reset, $200F, $0A83 = 20, clouds in meters, $2024-$202D, requests cleared, SOUND to $08D3, $0E86 = $08BC - 2 unless 0, $2045. Port: Machine.recordToState.

routines.name: saveUserMode
routines.comment: A built-in mode n becomes user mode n + 10 (current); below $0960 the record is stored ($B98D) and recalled ($B7C3). Lab: editor and library sessions. Port: Machine.saveUserMode (ModeLibrary.swift).

routines.name: recallKey
routines.comment: '+' in the editor: reload mode $0963 ($B998) and reprint the page ($B3C0), the cursor line pushed and pulled. Port: Machine.recallKey.

routines.name: fieldPointers
routines.comment: One field descriptor step of the walks $B3C0/$B813. Port: Machine.fieldPointers.

routines.name: drawPage
routines.comment: Copies page $094E's image (pointer at $A800 + X) to the screen ($B346). Port: Machine.drawPage.

routines.name: readPageFields

routines.name: warMain

Then warServiceCheck, drawWarScope, gunsAndTracers, bombImpact; with $0ACC != 0 enemyUpdate for X = 0, $1C .. $8C; in the front view ($0ACA = 0) outside the radar ($0836 != 1) the gunsight (6 lines from $A8A7 with pen $A817); warStatusLines. routines.name: enemyUpdate

routines.comment: State 0: return. Dormant (1): attacking when the aircraft is west of the trigger and not south of it; delta toward the base. routines.name: plotEnemyScope

routines.name: warServiceCheck

routines.name: printHitsTaken

routines.name: warStatusLines

routines.name: gunsAndTracers

routines.name: spendRound

notes.text: Native engine presenter: the jiffy unchanged since the last frame presented means no raster IRQ ran (a load held it): the frame shows the registers as the last handler left them on every line.

Native engine, Smooth pacing: the camera interpolated between the last two main-loop tops is the eye position $5A-$65 (three 32-bit words, along their signed difference) and the attitude $6C-$71 (re/docs/engine.md).
Native engine, Smooth pacing: pitch, bank, heading $6C-$71 interpolated the shorter way round (16-bit binary angles).
Native engine, Smooth pacing: window row 0's high byte decides the bitmap drawn into ($40xx/$60xx); unchanged since $204B means the pass has not flipped yet (the real window is shown).
Native engine, shared joysticks: a pressed key in no held-key slot (scan) or a slot whose key is up (release check) gives that frame to the keyboard.
Native engine, shared joysticks: 1 = the next frame IRQ scans, 0 = it checks releases; the joysticks are hidden from the CIA on such a frame when the keyboard needs it (re/docs/engine.md).
Native engine, key-wait stops (runToKeyWait, headless pc:2250): a move of the read index since the last stop means a new key wait.
Native and lab engines: $00 (the black and white display chosen at the title) sets FrameOutput.monochrome.
Native engine, Smooth pacing: set to 0 on the scratch copy, so the scenery interpreter's polls run no 10 Hz tick there.
Positive m: ones' complement, so $C4:$C5 = ~|m|. Negative m: decrement (also ~|m|); $8000 survives the decrement/increment pair and acts as |m| = 32767.
A set bit 0 of ~|m| clears A; a clear one keeps A = |n| high byte from the sign code ($80, not $7F, for n = -32768).
End of the 8-bit phase: this LSR's bit is lost; A:$A7 = 16-bit accumulator from here on.
Quotient overflow (|n| >= |d|): two separate DECs. $8000 -> $7FFF; other values lose 257.
Angle $8000 has no positive twin: it becomes $7FFF.
LSR shifts in 0: the carry out of the high-byte add is dropped, so a sum of two negative entries halves to a large positive value.
The rotate brings the incoming carry into product bit 0: the caller's carry (x, y >= 0), 1 (y < 0, from the subtract of 1) or 0 (x < 0, from the add of 1). Origin of the 8x8 bias.
Arithmetic shift right by 2 of the needle-to-target difference (the sign copied into the carry before each rotate).
Self-modified by $1AFE/$1B17: carry cleared (right half) or set (left half).
Self-modified opcode: add ($96),Y (right half) or subtract ($96),Y (left half).
Self-modified: X steps up (runs drawn rightward) or down (leftward).
Self-modified: $A7 decremented (upper half, rows going up) or incremented (lower half).
ADC #0 adds each point's x carry into $0A90, which is never cleared within a list.
Character loop of $1DE2/$1E01: fetch, subtract $20, a negative result ends the record.
Editor cache check ($08BC): first editor entry caches the overlay via $E6DB ($2063).
Page flip: unless LSR $0E79 sets carry, add $8D to $0200-$026F, $8D ^= $C0, store $F0/$F8 into $22B0.
Europe 1917: JSR $FD00 when $08D7 is set (the hook is empty in this image: port as a no-op).
JSR $FD00 (war mode, after R). See the notes at $FD00 and $FFF2 for what it does in this image.
Demo check ($095B -> $08BB=3): runs only once per 8 passes ($22&4 block).
Leaving Europe 1917 -> cold restart (JMP $A7E2 at $2149); once per 8 passes.
Window phase (raster $20): $22B0 is the immediate operand of LDA #$F0/#$F8 (double-buffer select).

Native engine: while the draw bitmap ($0200) is the one this operand names, the alternate-pass tasks draw into the bitmap on display (ATIS, crash message, plotter menu, database info): Smooth shows the real window. When it already names the other bitmap but the window phase latched the draw bitmap (a pass flipped after line $20), the frame shows the window rows kept at the last frame end (the C64's beam shows mostly the old picture).
$22B5 is the immediate operand holding the time-of-day border color.
DEC $08A6: 4-frame keyboard cycle (scan on 0, release check on -1, reload 3) = 15 Hz.
Bomb whistle sweep: $0E7D/$0E7E -= $F0 every 6 frames while $0E7E bit 7 is clear.
TOD seconds changed: JSR $CC16 (1 Hz sound tick) and the clock.
CTRL held: subtract $40 from the code.
BNE crosses a page ($24FF -> $2504): 4 cycles when taken.
Joystick samples agree: latch $0E6E/$0E6F, $0E6A=1, abort the keyboard scan.
IRQ vector set to $2285.
A is not saved around throttleDown: the fire test at $26D6 shifts the A that $2C31 returns.
Unreferenced: a call and a jump (6 bytes) after autoCenter's exit; no session executes it.
Self-modified JMP operand (dispatch target).
Unreachable RTS after keyDeclareWar.
ADC #1 with C = 0: $FC $0B + 1 = $0C, so the fifth quick CTRL-X selects the OBS.
Dead LDA #$01 (overwritten at once).

Code reading (no session reaches it): when limiter/2 + roll term high byte >= the OVER-CONTROL LIMITER $09A9, centering stores the roll term $09FC into the roll cancel $0E76/$0E77; the integrator subtracts it at $3400 and sets $0E79 (skip the next page flip) at $3424.
Stall horn trigger ($09DD >= $21) inside the 5 Hz aero routine; lights $7E3D/$7E3E.
Ground effect: below 20 m (altitude+1 - $14 with borrow into altitude+2 negative) the lift scale high byte gets +$0B.
Drag sum quirk: the carry of sqR+sqL low increments X, the next carry reaches the high byte once, and the slip-drag and flap-drag high bytes are added with the carries dropped (CLC).
V += accel: signed overflow (BVC) forces the high byte to $64 (keeping the low byte); a negative result zeroes both bytes.
dt constant $0222 (~32768/60), loaded as immediates, multiplied by jiffies via $188A.
Writes $0E79 (skip next page flip).
On-ground flag $0A12 set when altitude < 3 m.
While repositioning ($0A83) on the ground: JSR $2BC9 (brakes) instead of the crash check.
Crash: VS hi <= -9 or |bank hi| >= 10 -> $0834=4, airspeed 0, sound $CC68.
Touchdown chirp: $0E59=8 when $0A12 goes from 0 to nonzero.
Auto-level adds $FFB0/$0050 plus the carry left by the density subtraction (normally 1).
Only the low byte of the DG degrees is compared with $2197.
LSR $09AC: the DME redraws only when the nav code set the flag.
RPM digits from $09BE.
Normalization: a 1 shifted into north (carry set first), a 0 into east.
ROR: carry = NAV1 found ($0922 bit 0).
The interpolation fraction drops bit 8 of the ratio (bits 1-2 of $C5 go to bits 5-6).
Part of the drive-status check (copy protection); not ported.
No resident caller: copies 4 display-list operand bytes to $A5-$A8. Possibly a native-call (op 0A) target of scenery not visited; no session executes it.
BMI to $8104 crosses a page: 4 cycles when taken.
Down view: pitch + $4000.
View yaw offset $0ACA<<4 added to the heading high byte.
Loop halving eye-x and quartering eye-z matrix terms (frustum 53.13 x 28.07 deg).
Continuation of horizonPass ($83A4) after the embedded horizonLineList table; entered by the BPL at $8433.
Dead code: y2 is known to be non-zero here ($848F), so the BNE at $8499 is always taken.
Patched to jump to $A4CA by the attitude indicator ($A433-$A43F) around its call of $8623, restored at $A445-$A451.
Self-modified JSR operand: $851B + the planted offset, re-entering the row filler for the right-hand part.
